### [1] [MechReason: Benchmarking Multi-Image Multi-Hop Reasoning in Mechanical Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16012)
*Tengyue Wang,Kang An,Chenxu Du,Zhongyu Yang,Yuanchi Zhu,Xinqi Yang,Hebao Zhu,Ziliang Wang,FaQiang Qian,Yunli Yang,Qibing Ren*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出MechReason，一个源自真实机械工程论文的多模态推理基准，包含12k问答对、21k视觉材料和显式推理链标注，覆盖九类证据与四个推理维度、八种任务类型，构建流程分四阶段，最强模型仅达62.89%准确率，凸显评测难度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型在通用视觉问答与跨模态理解上进展显著，但在机械工程领域的复杂推理评测存在明显空白。已有基准多局限于图纸识别、CAD解读或单图表查询等基础任务，无法考察模型是否能整合多图像、文本条件、物理原理与工程约束，完成面向真实复杂机械问题的多步推理。

Method: 构建面向机械工程的多模态推理基准MechReason：数据源自真实机械工程论文，包含12k问答对（带显式推理链标注）与21k视觉材料，覆盖统计图表、参数表格、工程图纸、显微图像、仿真图像、系统架构图、真实机械场景照片、CAD模型图、制造流程图九类证据；任务涵盖解释、预测、设计、诊断四个推理维度下的八类任务。采用四阶段构建流程：先提取核心工程主张并将其支撑证据分解为前提、推理过程、结论与佐证证据；再通过掩蔽后验验证信息生成防捷径问题；最后进行多模态质量校验，确保任务质量与多跳推理特性。

Result: 大量实验表明MechReason具有高度挑战性，即使最先进的模型也仅达到62.89%的准确率。

Conclusion: MechReason填补了机械工程领域复杂多模态推理评测的空白，通过真实论文来源、推理链标注、多类型证据与多维度任务设计，揭示了当前多模态大语言模型在工程推理上的显著能力缺口，为后续研究提供了具有挑战性的评测基准。

Abstract: Despite significant progress in general visual question answering and cross-modal understanding, multimodal large language models still face a pronounced gap in evaluation for complex reasoning within the mechanical engineering domain. Existing benchmarks predominantly focus on rudimentary tasks such as drawing recognition, CAD interpretation, or single-chart querying, falling short of assessing whether models can integrate multiple images, textual conditions, physical principles, and engineering constraints to perform multi-step reasoning when confronted with authentic, intricate mechanical problems. To address this, we introduce MechReason, a benchmark derived from real mechanical engineering papers, comprising 12k question-answer pairs with explicit reasoning-chain annotations and 21k visual materials spanning nine evidence types, including statistical charts, parameter tables, engineering drawings, microscopic images, simulation images, system architectures, real mechanical scene photos, CAD model images and manufacturing flowcharts. MechReason covers eight task types across four reasoning dimensions: explanation, prediction, design, and diagnosis. We devise a four-stage construction pipeline: we first extract core engineering claims and decompose their supporting evidence into premises, reasoning processes, conclusions, and corroborative evidence; we then generate shortcut-preventing questions by masking posterior verification information; finally, we apply multimodal quality validation to ensure task quality and multi-hop nature. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that MechReason is highly challenging, with even the most advanced models achieving only 62.89\% accuracy.

</details>


### [2] [DenseFace: Bias Mitigation in Face Recognition via Density-Aware Probabilistic Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16149)
*Mansur Bultygov,Vadim Seliutin,Dmitry Nekhaev,Ivan Laptev*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DenseFace，一种基于von Mises-Fisher分布的概率人脸匹配方法，在不牺牲识别精度的前提下减少预训练人脸识别模型的种族偏见，且无需重训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有人脸识别模型存在显著的人口统计偏见。已有偏见缓解方法往往对训练过程施加约束，并导致识别精度下降，因此需要一种在不损失精度、且无需重训练的前提下缓解偏见的方案。

Method: 将每个人的面部嵌入建模为von Mises-Fisher（MF）分布；观察到人口统计属性与MF分布密度之间存在依赖关系；据此提出DenseFace——一种考虑MF分布差异的概率人脸匹配过程。

Result: 大量实验表明，DenseFace在不同网络架构、训练数据集和损失函数的强人脸识别模型上均能持续降低种族偏见；同时保持识别精度，且无需重新训练底层人脸识别模型。此外，研究还考察了既有偏见度量方法并给出建议。

Conclusion: DenseFace通过概率匹配有效缓解预训练人脸识别模型的种族偏见，兼顾精度且无需重训练，并为人脸识别偏见度量提供了改进建议。

Abstract: Despite steady progress in face recognition, current face recognition models still suffer from significant demographic biases. While approaches for bias mitigation have been proposed, existing methods often impose constraints on the training procedure and result in the degradation of recognition accuracy. To address this issue, we here introduce a method that reduces racial bias in pre-trained face recognition models without compromising their accuracy. To this end, we model face embeddings of each person by von Mises-Fisher (MF) distribution. We next observe the dependency between demographic attributes and the density of MF distributions, and propose DenseFace, a probabilistic face matching procedure that accounts for differences in MF distributions. Our extensive experiments demonstrate DenseFace to consistently reduce racial bias in strong face recognition models varying in network architectures, training datasets and loss functions. Notably, DenseFace preserves recognition accuracy and requires no retraining of the underlying face recognition model. Our work also investigates previously adopted bias measures and makes suggestions.

</details>


### [3] [Hyperbolic Contrastive Learning with Entailment for Spatial Transcriptomics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16207)
*Daniela Vega,Paula Cárdenas,Hannah Ceballos,Leonardo Manrique,Pablo Arbelaéz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HyCLoST，一种基于双曲几何与蕴含损失的对比学习模型，从组织病理图像预测空间基因表达，在26个ST数据集上实现MSE降低6%、PCC提升8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ST技术成本高、设备专业、易受噪声干扰，限制了可及性与可扩展性。基于计算机视觉的替代方案虽能从病理图像直接预测空间基因表达，但普遍存在基因表达过度平滑（over-smoothing）与跨组织区域预测过于均匀的问题。作者认为突破瓶颈的关键在于学习能够反映基因调控与组织形态学中层级化、非对称结构的表征。

Method: 提出HyCLoST（Hyperbolic Contrastive Learning with Entailment for Spatial Transcriptomics）。方法利用双曲几何（hyperbolic geometry）来建模ST数据中固有的层级关系，并引入基因到图像的蕴含损失（gene-to-image entailment loss），在对比学习框架下学习结构化、具有生物学依据的表征。

Result: 在26个空间转录组数据集上，相较于此前的先进方法，MSE降低6%，PCC提升8%。

Conclusion: 学习符合ST数据内在层级与非对称结构的表征，可有效缓解基因表达过度平滑与区域预测同质化问题，从而提升从病理图像预测空间基因表达的准确性与结构性。代码已开源（https://github.com/BCV-Uniandes/HyCLoST）。

Abstract: Spatial Transcriptomics (ST) has transformed biomedical research by enabling the spatial mapping of gene expression across tissue sections. However, high operational costs, specialized equipment requirements, and sensitivity to experimental noise limit the accessibility and scalability of ST. Recent computer vision approaches aim to overcome these limitations by predicting spatial gene expression directly from histopathology images. While effective, current approaches often suffer from gene expression over-smoothing and overly uniform predictions across tissue regions, suggesting that further progress depends on learning representations that reflect the hierarchical and asymmetric structure of gene regulation and tissue morphology. To address these issues, we propose Hyperbolic Contrastive Learning with Entailment for Spatial Transcriptomics (HyCLoST), a hyperbolic contrastive learning model that captures the intrinsic hierarchical relationships within ST data. By leveraging hyperbolic geometry and a gene-to-image entailment loss, HyCLoST learns structured, biologically grounded representations that improve gene expression prediction accuracy, achieving a 6% reduction in MSE and an 8% increase in PCC across 26 ST datasets, over previous methods. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/BCV-Uniandes/HyCLoST

</details>


### [4] [SceneBench: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Vision-Language Understanding of 3D Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16233)
*Anubhav Khanal,Prabigya Acharya,Roshni Poudel,Sujan Kapali,Bigyan Bhatta,Pramish Paudel,Francois Rameau,Danda Pani Paudel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了SceneBench基准，包含966个基于Gaussian Splatting重建的逼真3D场景，具有跨场景、房间、功能区、物体组和个体的层级语义标注（18.3万+节点），定义了存在性问答、空间智能问答和基于定位的QRA三元组三类任务，揭示了现有视觉语言模型在层级与组合推理上的显著不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在2D图像理解上表现出色，但在3D空间推理上受限。现有3D基准存在三大局限：（1）依赖点云，捕获几何但丢失纹理、文字、材质等丰富视觉特征；（2）标注将物体孤立处理，忽略现实世界的层级组织（场景、房间、功能区、物体组）；（3）评测任务局限于基础识别，缺乏多步空间推理。

Method: 构建SceneBench基准：使用Gaussian Splatting重建966个逼真3D场景；通过人机协同（human-in-the-loop）流程结合视觉语言模型与约1500小时人工迭代精修与验证，生成跨五级层级的密集语义标注，共18.3万+带文本描述和3D边界框的节点。基于该表示定义三类评测任务：存在性问答（探询物体属性）、空间智能问答（计数、尺寸比较、距离、方向关系）、以及需跨语义层级多步推理的定位式QRA三元组。

Result: 对最先进视觉语言模型的实验表明，模型在基础识别任务上表现良好（如检测准确率高达85%），但在层级与组合推理上性能大幅下降（如计数降至60%），揭示了现有基准未能捕捉的局限性。

Conclusion: SceneBench为在逼真3D环境中开发和评测具备细粒度空间推理能力的模型提供了真实的测试平台。

Abstract: Vision-language models excel at 2D image understanding but remain limited in 3D spatial reasoning. Progress is hindered by limitations in current benchmarks. First, 3D datasets often rely on point clouds that capture geometry but discard rich visual features like texture, text, and materials. Second, annotations treat objects in isolation while ignoring real-world hierarchical organization (scenes, rooms, functional areas, object groups). Third, evaluation tasks focus narrowly on basic recognition rather than multi-step spatial reasoning.
  In this context, we introduce SceneBench, a benchmark of 966 photorealistic 3D scenes reconstructed with Gaussian Splatting and densely annotated with hierarchical semantics spanning scenes, rooms, functional areas, object groups, and individual objects. These annotations are produced through a human-in-the-loop pipeline combining vision-language models with roughly 1,500 human-hours of iterative refinement and verification, producing over 183K annotated nodes with textual descriptions and 3D bounding boxes. Building on this representation, we define three evaluation tasks: Existence-Based Questions probing object attributes, Spatial Intelligence Questions covering counting, size comparison, distance, and directional relations, and Grounded Question-Reasoning-Answer (QRA) triplets requiring multi-step reasoning across semantic levels. Experiments with state-of-the-art vision-language models show that while models perform well on basic recognition tasks (e.g., up to 85% accuracy for detection), performance drops substantially on hierarchical and compositional reasoning (e.g., down to 60% for counting), revealing limitations not captured by existing benchmarks. SceneBench provides a realistic testbed for developing and evaluating models capable of fine-grained spatial reasoning in photorealistic 3D environments.

</details>


### [5] [ProtoLIP: From Sentence-Level to Object-Level Evidence Disentanglement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16284)
*Yan Zhu,Yongbo Chen,Zhengming Ding,Rebecca Faust*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ProtoLIP，一种轻量级的原型中介证据层，通过将可复用视觉原型组织为文本派生的语义族并进行查询相关的族路由，解决了VLM中对象级查询证据混杂的问题，提升了证据定位与分离能力且保持竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有查询条件化的视觉-语言模型虽能揭示视觉证据随文本查询的变化，但基于完整描述的条件化证据不必然解析为对象特定的证据，且暴露的证据图也未必能识别构成模型预测的证据。跨多种VLM架构和独立基准发现，对象级查询常保留来自共现对象和共享上下文的证据，导致证据混杂。

Method: 提出ProtoLIP：一个轻量级的原型中介证据层。它将可复用的视觉原型组织为文本派生的语义族，并利用查询相关的族路由来约束哪些原型可以提供证据。该方法无需空间标注或骨干网络重训练，仅使用文本派生弱监督。其匹配分数直接由局部化的原型证据构建，可精确分解为语义族和原型贡献。

Result: ProtoLIP在不同查询粒度上提升了证据定位与分离能力；定位增益可迁移至具有良好对齐的patch-text表示的独立预训练VLM；尽管仅用文本派生弱监督，其性能与空间监督的grounding模型相比仍具竞争力，同时保持强匹配和竞争力的图文检索性能。

Conclusion: ProtoLIP通过原型中介与查询相关路由有效约束了证据来源，解决了对象级查询证据混杂问题，并实现了匹配分数对语义族与原型贡献的可分解性，为VLM的细粒度可解释性提供了新途径。

Abstract: Query-conditioned vision--language models enable fine-grained interpretation by revealing how visual evidence changes with textual queries. However, evidence conditioned on complete descriptions does not necessarily resolve into object-specific evidence, nor does an exposed evidence map necessarily identify the evidence that constitutes the model's prediction. Across multiple VLM architectures and independent benchmarks, we find that object-level queries often retain evidence from co-occurring objects and shared context. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{ProtoLIP}, a lightweight prototype-mediated evidence layer that organizes reusable visual prototypes into text-derived semantic families and uses query-dependent family routing to constrain which prototypes may provide evidence. Without spatial annotations or backbone retraining, ProtoLIP improves evidence localization and separation across query granularities, with localization gains transferring to independently pretrained VLMs with well-aligned patch--text representations. Despite using only text-derived weak supervision, ProtoLIP remains competitive with a spatially supervised grounding model while maintaining strong matching and competitive image--text retrieval. Crucially, ProtoLIP constructs its matching score directly from localized prototype evidence, enabling the score to be exactly decomposed into semantic-family and prototype contributions.

</details>


### [6] [Sequence Recognition in Bharatnatyam dance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16306)
*Himadri Bhuyan,Rohit Dhaipule,Partha Pratim Das*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对印度古典舞 Bharatanatyam 中 Adavu 动作序列识别，提出用 CNN 识别关键姿态、SVM 识别动作，再用编辑距离比对序列，CNN 达 99%、SVM 达 84%、序列匹配达 98%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adavu 是 Bharatanatyam 的核心，包含 15 种 Adavu 及 58 种变体，每种变体由有序的关键姿态与动作（舞步）构成，学习时不仅要掌握舞步还需掌握其出现顺序。已有工作多仅基于关键姿态识别，且只使用一两种变体，缺乏对动作序列、预测时间与可扩展性的系统研究，因此需要面向数字遗产与舞蹈教学系统提出更完整的序列识别方法。

Method: 首先使用卷积神经网络（CNN）识别 Adavu 中涉及的关键姿态（KPs），使用支持向量机（SVM）识别动作（motions）；随后将识别得到的 KP 序列与动作序列同真实标注（ground truth）进行比对，采用编辑距离（Edit Distance）算法寻找最佳匹配以完成 Adavu 变体序列识别。

Result: CNN 的关键姿态识别准确率达到 99%，SVM 的动作识别准确率为 84%，基于编辑距离的序列最佳匹配准确率为 98%；同时论文还分析了每个序列的预测时间，并与处理相同问题的先前工作进行了对比。

Conclusion: 该方法可有效识别 Adavu 的关键姿态与动作序列，并在数字遗产、舞蹈教学系统等方面具有应用价值。论文提出三点新颖性：(a) 同时基于关键姿态与动作识别序列，而非仅依赖关键姿态；(b) 通过每序列预测时间衡量性能并与已有工作比较；(c) 纳入全部 Adavu 变体以测试可扩展性，而非仅使用一两种变体。

Abstract: Bharatanatyam is the oldest Indian Classical Dance (ICD) which is learned and practiced across India and the world. Adavu is the core of this dance form. There exist 15 Adavus and 58 variations. Each Adavu variation comprises a well-defined set of motions and postures (called dance steps) that occur in a particular order. So, while learning Adavus, students not only learn the dance steps but also take care of its sequence of occurrences. This paper proposed a method to recognize these sequences. In this work, firstly, we recognize the involved Key Postures (KPs) and motions in the Adavu using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Support Vector Machine (SVM), respectively. In this, CNN achieves 99% and SVM's recognition accuracy becomes 84%. Next, we compare these KP and motion sequences with the ground truth to find the best match using the Edit Distance algorithm with an accuracy of 98%. The paper contributes hugely to the state-of-the-art in the form of digital heritage, dance tutoring system, and many more. The paper addresses three novelties; (a) Recognizing the sequences based on the KPs and motions rather than only KPs as reported in the earlier works. (b) The performance of the proposed work is measured by analyzing the prediction time per sequence. We also compare our proposed approach with the previous works that deal with the same problem statement. (c) It tests the scalability of the proposed approach by including all the Adavu variations, unlike the earlier literature, which uses only one/two variations.

</details>


### [7] [Racing in Volume with Flow Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16310)
*Saswat Subhajyoti Mallick,Riu Cherdchusakulchai,Marc Ruiz Olle,Albert Mosella-Montoro,Jose Ribeiro-Gomes,Francisco Vicente Carrasco,Fernando De la Torre*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FastFlowGS 流式 4D 高斯泼溅方法与 Monaco4D 高速户外重建基准，解决稀疏环视相机下快速运动主体的流式重建问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流式 4D 重建多限于室内密集相机阵列与常速运动主体；户外方案依赖车载相机或有限覆盖的离线阵列观测准静态主体。观众关心的"快速运动主体 + 稀疏环视外置相机 + 流式"场景尚无方法与基准。

Method: FastFlowGS 融合稀疏匹配、半稠密轨迹与稠密光流，将每种信号以几何不确定度提升至 3D，并通过 Kalman 式时序更新进行组合；同时构建 Monaco4D——基于 UE5 的光真实感高速户外重建基准，提供多变光照下赛道边、车载与无人机视角的 F1 序列及密集真值。

Result: CMU-Panoptic 上 VMAF 领先最强基线 12.6%，效率提升 35%；Monaco4D 上动态区域 PSNR 最高提升 18.6%，每帧优化时间降低 28.3%。

Conclusion: FastFlowGS 与 Monaco4D 填补了稀疏环视流式高速 4D 重建的方法与评测空白，在精度与效率上均显著优于现有流式方案。

Abstract: Streaming 4D reconstruction has been demonstrated only indoors, on dense camera rigs surrounding subjects that move at human pace. Outdoor 4D reconstruction exists but relies either on cameras mounted on the moving vehicle itself, or on limited-coverage arrays observing quasi-static subjects offline. The case that actually matters for spectators is a fast-moving subject, watched from a sparse ring of allocentric cameras, streaming. No method targets this, and no benchmark exists to evaluate one. To this end, we introduce FastFlowGS, a streaming 4D Gaussian Splatting method for reconstructing fast-moving subjects from a small set of fixed external cameras, and Monaco4D, a photorealistic Unreal Engine 5 benchmark for high-speed outdoor reconstruction. FastFlowGS fuses sparse matches, semi-dense tracks, and dense optical flow by lifting each signal to 3D with geometric uncertainty and combining them through a Kalman-style temporal update. Monaco4D provides Formula 1 sequences under varied illumination from trackside, onboard, and drone viewpoints with dense ground truth. On CMU-Panoptic, FastFlowGS exceeds the strongest baseline by 12.6% VMAF at 35% greater efficiency. On Monaco4D, where existing streaming methods degrade severely, it improves dynamic-region PSNR by up to 18.6% with 28.3% lower per-frame optimization time. Dataset and additional details can be found at https://humansensinglab.github.io/monaco4d/.

</details>


### [8] [Reasoning with Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16409)
*Nishad Singhi,Hector Garcia Rodriguez,Aditya Arora,Marcus Rohrbach,Anna Rohrbach*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ReImaGin，将图像生成模型作为多模态大模型的灵活视觉推理机制，在六项视觉推理任务上比纯文本推理和专用视觉工具基线最高提升 25%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Breast histopathology analysis increasingly relies on distributed learning because direct data pooling across institutions is often restricted by privacy, governance, and communication constraints.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Multi subject video editing modifies designated subjects while preserving non target content, but faces cross subject attribute leakage, and occlusion ambiguity. </details>


### [12] [VPRef: A Cross-Domain Benchmark for Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16486)
*Quanwei Liu,Tao Huang,Jiaqi Yang,Wei Xiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出首个跨域RRSIS基准VPRef数据集，并基于SAM3+LoRA构建参数高效域适应基线，仅调参1.08%即实现优越跨域分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation（RRSIS）在实际部署中面临"耦合双漂移"：跨空间分辨率不匹配与光谱差异导致的视觉域漂移，以及用户输入粒度不受约束导致的文本逻辑漂移，性能严重退化；同时缺乏跨域评测基准。

Method: 1）构建首个跨域RRSIS基准VPRef数据集，含46,972个"语言-图像-标注"三元组，按三层语言层级组织；2）以SAM3为骨干，通过LoRA实现参数高效域适应；3）针对视觉分布差异采用伪标签驱动的自训练；4）针对文本逻辑漂移采用随机多粒度文本提示混合。

Result: 在多项基准上取得更优的跨域分割边界，且仅修改基础模型1.08%的参数；消融实验的经验指标分布提示：跨模态语义鲁棒化与视觉域对齐可能存在解耦——语言方差驱动细粒度语义不变性，伪标签传播主导宏观尺度空间网格对齐。

Conclusion: 本文为多模态遥感域适应研究建立了稳健基准，数据集与代码将开源（GitHub链接）。

Abstract: Rapid advancements in vision-language models have propelled Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation (RRSIS) to the forefront of Earth observation. However, practical deployments suffer severe performance degradation under a coupled dual-drift paradigm: visual domain drift from cross-spatial-resolution mismatches and spectral variations, alongside textual logic drift from unconstrained, variable user-input granularities. To mitigate these bottlenecks, this paper establishes the first cross-domain RRSIS benchmark, designated as the Vaihingen-Potsdam Referring (VPRef) dataset, comprising 46,972 language-image-annotation triplets organized into a three-tier linguistic hierarchy. Building upon this benchmark, we develop a tailored parameter-efficient domain adaptation baseline anchored on the Segment Anything Model (SAM3) via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). Our framework counteracts visual distribution discrepancies through pseudo-label-driven self-training and addresses textual logic drift via random multi-granularity text prompt mixing. Crucially, the distribution of empirical metrics across ablative variants suggests a potential decoupling between cross-modal semantic robustification and visual domain alignment, demonstrating that linguistic variance drives fine-grained semantic invariance while pseudo-label propagation governs macro-scale spatial grid alignment. Extensive benchmarks demonstrate the proposed framework achieves superior cross-domain segmentation boundaries while modifying merely 1.08\% of the foundational parameter footprint, establishing a robust baseline for future multi-modal remote sensing domain adaptation research. The dataset and code will be available at https://github.com/quanweiliu/VPRef.

</details>

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在统一编码器、预训练语料、优化方案与冻结评估协议下，对比对比学习、掩码重建与JEPA三类自监督目标在肺部超声（LUS）上的表现。结果显示：POCUS线性探针下VideoMAE与V-JEPA领先，但在独立Mendeley-Uganda数据集上排名反转，MoCo最优，V-JEPA接近随机水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督学习可减少医学图像对标注的依赖，但肺部超声中预训练任务（pretext objective）的选择尚不明确。对比学习、掩码重建与联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的目标定义空间不同，而已有超声研究在语料、骨干网络与评估协议上不一致，导致无法公平比较。本文旨在控制变量，公平比较三类目标家族的迁移能力。

Method: 使用同一编码器骨干、同一预训练语料（COVID-BLUeS LUS视频）、相同优化schedule与冻结评估协议，对比三类目标：对比学习（MoCo）、掩码重建（VideoMAE）、JEPA（V-JEPA）。评估采用linear、kNN与attentive探针，标签预算为5%、10%、50%、100%；POCUS使用患者级五折交叉验证，Mendeley-Uganda作为独立外部数据集（不参与预训练与探针拟合）。

Result: 100%标签预算、线性探针下，POCUS上VideoMAE与V-JEPA分别达到66.5±13.1与65.4±11.7平衡准确率，MoCo仅42.1±1.2。在Mendeley-Uganda上排名反转：MoCo最优62.7±1.0，VideoMAE为53.8±2.8，V-JEPA接近随机35.1±4.9。

Conclusion: 仅凭POCUS探针准确率无法识别哪个自监督目标具有最佳跨数据集迁移性，存在明显的域间排名反转现象。作者计划进一步开展表示层分析以解释该反转，代码已公开。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) can reduce the need for labelled medical images, but the choice of pretext objective remains unclear for lung ultrasound (LUS). Contrastive learning, masked reconstruction, and joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPA) differ in the space in which their targets are defined, yet existing ultrasound studies compare them under different corpora, backbones, and evaluation protocols. We compare these three objective families using the same encoder backbone, pretraining corpus, optimisation schedule, and frozen-evaluation protocol. Encoders are pretrained on COVID-BLUeS LUS videos and evaluated with linear, $k$NN, and attentive probes at 5\%, 10\%, 50\%, and 100\% label budgets. Evaluation is performed on POCUS using patient-level five-fold cross-validation and on the independently acquired Mendeley-Uganda dataset, which is excluded from both pretraining and probe fitting. At the full label budget under linear probing, VideoMAE and V-JEPA achieve $66.5 \pm 13.1$ and $65.4 \pm 11.7$ balanced accuracy on POCUS, while MoCo achieves $42.1 \pm 1.2$. On Mendeley-Uganda, the ranking reverses: MoCo performs best at $62.7 \pm 1.0$, followed by VideoMAE at $53.8 \pm 2.8$, while V-JEPA falls near chance at $35.1 \pm 4.9$. These results show that POCUS probe accuracy alone does not identify the objective that transfers best across datasets. We also outline planned representation-level analyses to examine this reversal. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/LUSVideoSSL.

</details>

Abstract: Answerability on Visual Question Answering is a novel and attractive task to predict answerable scores between images and questions in multi-modal data. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VQA模型易利用训练数据中的虚假相关性，因语言偏差导致分布外泛化能力差；已有反事实学习方法在引导注意力关注因果证据、增强特征判别性方面仍有改进空间。

Method: 提出增强反事实对比学习框架，包含三项贡献：(1) 三阶段课程学习以实现稳定的多目标优化；(2) 增强的批对比损失以获得更具判别性的特征；(3) 两个新正则化项——答案对比损失精炼预测空间，梯度差异损失强化因果视觉 grounding。

Abstract: Modern Visual Question Answering (VQA) models often exploit spurious correlations in training data, leading to poor out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization due to language bias. Although counterfactual learning has shown promise, existing methods can be improved to better guide attention toward causal evidence and strengthen feature discrimination. To address this, we propose a novel training framework that enhances counterfactual contrastive learning for VQA. Our framework introduces three key contributions: (1) a three-stage curriculum for stable multi-objective optimization, (2) an enhanced Batch-Contrastive loss for more discriminative feature learning, and (3) two novel regularizers, Answer-Contrastive (AC) loss to refine the prediction space and Gradient-Discrepancy (GD) loss to enforce causal visual grounding. Our model achieves a competitive accuracy of 61.64% on the bias-sensitive VQA-CP v2 benchmark while maintaining 62.80% on the standard VQA v2 dataset, yielding a small generalization gap of 1.16%. This demonstrates a strong balance between OOD robustness and in-distribution performance.

</details>

*Kuluhan Binici,Cihan Acar,Shivam Aggarwal,Siying Liu,Tulika Mitra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应扩散控制器，无需额外训练即可根据文本提示复杂度动态调整去噪步数，在COCO和DiffusionDB上兼顾推理效率与图像质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型通常采用固定去噪步数来平衡时间成本与图像质量，但最优步数实际取决于输入文本提示的复杂度，固定步数难以适应不同提示的需求。

Method: 提出自适应扩散控制器：利用多种不同步长的步数调度（mixture of step schedules），并在每个时间步评估误差项差异（error term discrepancy），据此在不同调度之间切换，从而动态调整去噪步数，且无需额外模型训练。

Result: 在COCO和DiffusionDB数据集上的实验表明，该方法在保持视觉保真度的同时减少了推理时间。

Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models often use a fixed number of denoising steps, balancing time costs and image quality. However, the optimal number of steps depends on the complexity of the input text prompt. By leveraging a mixture of step schedules with varying step sizes and evaluating the error term discrepancy at each timestep, our method transitions between schedules to optimize performance. Experiments on COCO and DiffusionDB show that our approach reduces inference time while maintaining visual fidelity, offering a more efficient alternative for text-to-image diffusion models.

</details>

*Hu Gao,Lizhuang Ma,Yulong Chen*

TL;DR: 提出GraLoD，将图像复原的有效尺度建模为随空间位置与解码阶段连续变化的LOD场，通过复用编码器层级、预测阶段条件LOD并查询相邻两个表示层级，实现即插即用的自适应尺度复原。

Abstract: The spatial support required for image restoration varies across degradation types, image regions, and reconstruction stages. However, most existing methods rely on predefined multi-scale hierarchies and aggregate features through fixed fusion or attention, leaving the representation scale itself largely determined by the network architecture. Abstract: Generative models trained on a single image often struggle to balance global structural integrity and local diversity. The core of FRPSS is the Manifold Structural Rearrangement with Feature Augmentation on Geodesic Surface (MSR-FAGS) module. MSR-FAGS replaces the randomly initialized features of the low-scale generator with rearranged Pre-Shape features and uses the features to guide image generation at subsequent scales, thereby reducing the risk of structural misalignment. To support downstream tasks such as stylization, a Scale-adaptive Sliding-window Patch Extraction (SSPE) strategy is further designed, and a directional Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training supervision module with SSPE (CLIP-SSPE) is constructed. Abstract: Background Non-invasive presurgical diagnosis of brain tumor types from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is essential but challenging due to overlapping imaging features across tumor types, inter-observer variability, and the extensive training required for expertise. We further conducted two proof-of-concept studies to validate its clinical utility in AI-clinician workflows: 1) a blinded multi-reader study where 12 neuroradiologists across varying experience levels interpreted 248 retrospective cases with or without AI assistance, and 2) a real-world prospective study in which 1,009 patients were independently and blindly assessed by BrainVLM and radiologists before surgery. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made strong progress on visual question answering and image captioning, yet they still produce fluent claims about objects, attributes, or relations that are not grounded in the image. Many remedies either modify decoding at test time, which adds latency, or fine tune with preferences such as DPO variants, which teach which answer is preferred but not when the model's own answer is unreliable. We argue that calibrated self assessment is the missing signal. We introduce Savor, a training framework that (i) augments the output schema with token and answer confidence, (ii) optimises the policy with a Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) objective that penalises calibration error and poor abstention decisions, and (iii) uses the learned confidence at inference time to revisit visual evidence only when the model is uncertain. Experiments on POPE, HallusionBench, AMBER and MMHal-Bench across two recent backbones (InternVL3-8B and Qwen3-VL-8B) show that Savor reduces hallucination while preserving general capability on MME and MMBench, with lower Expected Calibration Error than DPO and decoding baselines.

Abstract: Full-context neural visual geometry is impractical for thousands of images, while sequence-based chunking poorly captures irregular non-local overlap in multi-sequence aerial collections. Before local inference, G3AR builds a geometrically verified image-proximity graph that guides bounded overlapping chunks and induces a chunk graph whose maximum spanning tree defines alignment topology. Compatible backbones process chunks independently; shared-image predictions then estimate three-dimensional similarity (Sim(3)) transforms that register local cameras and geometry in a common frame. Across four real aerial scenes, G3AR improves pose error and runtime in matched VGGT- and Pi3-backed comparisons, while its DA3 variant achieves the lowest pose error among evaluated neural-geometry methods.

Abstract: Zero-shot waypoint navigation requires vision-language models to select, from the current first-person observation, a sequence of spatial actions that is feasible for the agent and reaches the goal, placing joint demands on the integrated spatial intelligence of today's foundation VLMs. Existing spatial-intelligence benchmarks primarily evaluate isolated judgments of relations, directions, or targets and therefore do not directly measure the integrated navigation ability required to combine target recognition, action-consequence assessment, distance estimation, and path planning. Each question presents an egocentric RGB image, a natural-language goal, and numbered visible waypoints; a model returns traversable candidates or an ordered route. The top-ranked model reaches 35.9% success on Point Path, but only 2.9% and 4.0% on Embodied Path and Intent Path, respectively, showing that current models remain limited in forming complete, goal-consistent routes under embodiment constraints. Abstract: Virtual try-on (VTON) enables customers to visualize how fashion products appear when worn and has become an important technology for online shopping. </details>

*Yanick C. Tchenko,Felix Mohr,Hicham Hadj-Abdelkader,Hedi Tabia*

Main category: cs.CV

Abstract: Efficient perception is central to robotic systems operating under constrained computation, memory, and latency budgets. Knowledge transfer from larger pretrained models offers a practical route to stronger compact perception networks, but existing approaches commonly rely on fixed distillation objectives or manually designed interaction mechanisms. ### [26] [What Do Hallucinations Reveal About Multimodal Reasoning? Diagnosing Visual Grounding Failures via Contrastive Decoding Probes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16646)
*Zhipeng Zhao,Wenxu Wang,Peishun Liu,Ruichun Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: When strong multimodal models are widely available, progress requires new scientific methodologies beyond benchmark scores---using models as instruments for understanding behavior. We address this by asking: can we use large vision-language models (LVLMs) as experimental instruments for studying their own failure dynamics? Focusing on visual hallucination, we introduce SAFE, a training-free decoding framework that contrasts visually-grounded and vision-ablated generation paths to produce a token-level contrastive grounding score that identifies when the model favors linguistic priors over visual evidence. This signal serves dual roles: as a practical proxy for detecting visually-ungrounded tokens, and as the basis for decoding-time penalties. Our analysis yields three empirical observations: visual dependency decays over generation, hallucinations co-occur in temporal clusters, and early intervention reduces clustering without substantially degrading fluency. On MMHalBench, SAFE substantially outperforms all compared baselines; results elsewhere are more mixed. We argue that designing contrastive probes exemplifies a broader mission: using models as instruments for scientific understanding. Code: https://github.com/zhaozhipeng1997/SAFE_public.

</details>


### [27] [ViD: Vision-Dominant Gender Bias Mitigation for Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16647)
*Zhipeng Zhao,Zhaoqiang Wei,Peishun Liu,Youwei Zhao,Ruichun Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ViD框架，通过因果启发的注意力机制分析与双重建模（后门调整+精炼Token选择），在无需额外训练开销的前提下显著缓解大型视觉语言模型的性别偏见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）中的性别偏见损害公平性与可靠性，威胁输出可信度。现有缓解方法依赖训练阶段调整或事后校准，存在三重局限：无法捕捉实时视觉-文本不一致、依赖预定义的性别偏见分类体系、跨模态对齐在涌现偏见模式下退化，因而难以实现动态视觉偏见缓解。

Method: 提出ViD（因果启发的框架），分析五类注意力模式，揭示强语言先验带来的混杂效应，并证明视觉到语言的交叉注意力能有效抑制偏见且不损失通用推理与文本生成质量。ViD包含双重机制：后门调整（backdoor adjustment）对抗强语言先验；解码层中的精炼Token选择优化处理过程，从而提升模型鲁棒性与推理效率。

Result: 跨基准验证显示：在单属性评估（FACET）上性别偏见降低14.7%；在图像描述任务（MS COCO）上取得显著提升，LLaVA的性别偏见得分从0.6708提升至0.9978。同时改善视觉接地能力与输出公平性。

Conclusion: ViD在无需额外训练开销的情况下实现了显著的性别偏见缓解，是一种可扩展、实用的LVLMs偏见缓解方案。

Abstract: Gender bias in large vision-language models (LVLMs) undermines their fairness and reliability, compromising output trustworthiness. Current mitigation methods rely on training-phase adjustments or post-hoc calibration, but face limitations in dynamic visual bias mitigation. These include inability to capture real-time visual-textual incongruence, dependence on predefined gender bias taxonomies, and degraded cross-modal alignment with emergent bias patterns. To address these challenges, we propose ViD, a causally-inspired framework that analyzes attention mechanisms across five distinct patterns, revealing confounding effects from strong language priors. ViD demonstrates that visual-to-language cross-attention effectively suppresses bias while preserving general reasoning capabilities and text generation quality. ViD incorporates dual mechanisms: backdoor adjustment counters strong language priors, while refined token selection in decoding layers optimizes processing. This enhances model robustness and inference efficiency. Our integrated approach significantly mitigates gender bias across multidimensional social attributes in LVLMs, improving visual grounding and output fairness. Cross-benchmark validation shows ViD reduces gender bias by 14.7\% on single-attribute evaluations (FACET) and achieves significant improvements on image captioning tasks (MS COCO), with gender bias score improving from 0.6708 to 0.9978 for LLaVA. </details>

*Jonghyeon Lim,Changhoon Yim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究VSSD（Visual State Space Duality）在低比特训练后量化（PTQ）下的行为，指出激活量化为主要瓶颈，并提出CTOAC方法学习逐输入通道的裁剪边界，在保持精度的同时实现最高1.42倍端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 状态空间模型（SSM），尤其是Mamba及其视觉扩展（ViM、VMamba、VSSD），已成为注意力架构的高效替代方案，但VSSD在低比特训练后量化（PTQ）下的行为尚缺乏充分理解，制约了其在实际部署中的压缩与加速。

Method: 1）对VSSD-Tiny进行权重-激活分离分析，识别激活量化为低比特主要瓶颈，并发现选定VSSD骨干线性层的代表性输入存在强通道级幅度变化和token局部极值；2）提出Channel-wise Token-balanced Output-Aware Clipping（CTOAC）方法，通过最小化对应线性输出的token平衡重建损失，学习逐输入通道的裁剪边界；3）量化范围仅限选定线性层及其输入激活，其余骨干操作保持原始精度。

Result: 在VSSD-Tiny、VSSD-Small、VSSD-Base上，CTOAC在ImageNet-1K上保持精度，且在更激进的精度设置下显著优于对比基线；相同量化范围应用于COCO和ADE20K上的VSSD骨干，保持了强目标检测、实例分割和语义分割性能；优化后的RTX 4090部署配置实现最高1.42倍相对FP32的端到端加速。

Conclusion: CTOAC通过输出感知的逐通道裁剪有效缓解VSSD激活量化瓶颈，在分类、检测与分割任务上兼顾精度与效率，为视觉状态空间模型的低比特部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: State space models (SSMs), particularly Mamba, have emerged as efficient alternatives to attention-based architectures and have been extended to vision through ViM, VMamba, and Visual State Space Duality (VSSD). Yet the low-bit post-training quantization (PTQ) behavior of VSSD remains insufficiently understood. A weight-activation split on VSSD-Tiny identifies activation quantization as the dominant low-bit bottleneck, while representative inputs to selected VSSD-backbone linear layers exhibit strong channel-wise magnitude variation and token-localized extremes. We propose the Channel-wise Token-balanced Output-Aware Clipping (CTOAC) method, which learns per-input-channel clipping bounds by minimizing a token-balanced reconstruction loss on the corresponding linear outputs. Only the selected linear layers and their input activations are quantized; other backbone operations retain their original precision. Across VSSD-Tiny, VSSD-Small, and VSSD-Base, the proposed CTOAC method retains ImageNet-1K accuracy and remains substantially more robust than the evaluated baselines at more aggressive precision settings. Applying the same quantization scope to VSSD backbones on COCO and ADE20K preserves strong object detection, instance segmentation, and semantic segmentation performance. An optimized RTX 4090 deployment configuration achieves up to 1.42x end-to-end speedup over FP32.

</details>


### [29] [SAVTrack: Selective Vote Aggregation for Reliability-Aware Point Cloud Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16662)
*Sifan Zhou,Linyue Tan,Qiwei Wang,Ziyu Zhao,Xiaobo Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SAVTrack框架，通过选择性投票聚合（SAV）在聚类前剔除低置信度投票，提升稀疏点云下3D单目标跟踪的定位精度，兼顾效率与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LiDAR点云稀疏且不完整，目标不同点对中心约束强度差异大，导致部分点到中心投票可靠性低；现有基于点的跟踪器直接聚合这些假设，未显式建模其可靠性，使不准确的投票污染提案聚类并降低定位精度。

Method: 提出运动感知跟踪框架SAVTrack及选择性投票聚合（SAV）。SAV从局部种子特征与帧间运动上下文两方面估计每个候选投票的可靠性，在提案聚类前移除低置信度假设。该聚合前门控机制阻止不可靠假设影响聚类形成，且仅带来少量计算开销。

Result: 在KITTI上达到68.4/87.4，在nuScenes上达到58.44/69.82（Success/Precision），运行速度82 FPS；候选投票保留量不足密集聚合的六分之一，在稀疏目标观测下尤其有效。

Conclusion: SAVTrack通过显式建模并筛选投票可靠性，有效缓解了投票噪声对聚类和定位的干扰，在保持高实时性的同时取得有竞争力的跟踪性能，并显著降低候选投票数量，在稀疏观测场景下优势明显。

Abstract: 3D single object tracking (SOT) in LiDAR point clouds is essential for autonomous systems, but remains challenging under sparse and incomplete observations. In such cases, different target points provide highly uneven constraints on the object center, causing some point-to-center votes to be substantially less reliable than others. Existing point-based trackers typically aggregate these hypotheses without explicitly modeling their reliability, allowing inaccurate votes to contaminate proposal clustering and degrade localization accuracy. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{SAVTrack}, a motion-aware tracking framework with \textbf{Selective Vote Aggregation (SAV)}. SAVTrack estimates the reliability of each candidate vote from both local seed features and inter-frame motion context, and removes low-confidence hypotheses before proposal clustering. This pre-aggregation gating prevents unreliable hypotheses from affecting cluster formation while introducing only modest computational overhead. SAVTrack achieves competitive performance on KITTI and nuScenes, reaching 68.4/87.4 and 58.44/69.82 Success/Precision, respectively, while running at 82 FPS. It retains fewer than one-sixth of the candidate votes used by dense aggregation and remains particularly effective under sparse target observations.

</details>


### [30] [Bridging the Perceptual Gap: Residual-Enhanced Downscaling and Manifold-Aware Perception Alignment Adaptation for NR-IQA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16664)
*Yu Li,Zhengran Shen,Yachun Mi,Puchao Zhou,Shaohui Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出跨模态感知对齐适配器（CMPA），通过流形感知框架从CLIP的语义表示中分离出被淹没的感知失真信号，在多个NR-IQA基准上显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP类大视觉语言模型在无参考图像质量评估（NR-IQA）中表现优异，但其对比预训练优先保证语义不变性，会压制细微的感知信号（即"感知淹没"现象）；同时标准预处理（裁剪、插值）进一步加剧高频质量线索的丢失。

Method: 提出流形感知框架CMPA，包含三部分：(1) 感知敏感特征提取器（PFE），将CLIP特征投影到紧凑低维子空间，放大失真引起的离流形偏差；(2) 跨模态感知对齐注入器（PAI），将特征与质量感知的文本锚点对齐并重新注入主干网络；(3) 残差增强感知降采样策略，基于恰可察觉差异（JND）引导的频率重注入，自适应补偿分辨率导致的信息损失。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量评估表明，该方法显著优于现有最先进方法，能有效恢复被淹没在语义密集表示中的感知信号。

Conclusion: CMPA通过流形感知的跨模态对齐有效解决了CLIP语义不变性带来的感知信号淹没问题，验证了在NR-IQA任务中挖掘被语义掩盖的失真线索的可行性与优越性。

Abstract: Leveraging Large Vision-Language Models like CLIP has recently set new benchmarks for No-Reference Image Quality Assessment (NR-IQA). However, the contrastive pretraining of CLIP inherently prioritizes semantic invariance, which often suppresses subtle perceptual signals, a phenomenon we term perceptual submergence. Furthermore, standard preprocessing techniques (e.g., cropping and interpolation) further exacerbate the loss of critical high-frequency quality cues. In this paper, we propose the Cross-modal Perception Alignment Adapter (CMPA), a manifold-aware framework designed to disentangle perceptual distortions from dominant semantics. CMPA introduces a Perception-Sensitive Feature Extractor (PFE) that projects CLIP features into a compact, low-dimensional subspace, explicitly magnifying distortion-induced off-manifold deviations. Subsequently, a Cross-Modal Perception Alignment Injector (PAI) aligns these features with quality-aware text anchors and re-injects them into the backbone. To ensure input fidelity, we also devise a Residual-enhanced Perceptual Downscaling strategy that adaptively compensates for resolution-induced information loss using Just Noticeable Difference (JND) guided frequency re-injection. Extensive evaluations on several benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, effectively recovering the perceptual signals submerged in semantic-dense representations.

</details>


### [31] [Lesion-centered 3D mapping of colonoscopy procedures: validation of a hierarchical ensemble pipeline on public benchmark videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16672)
*Hyunjun Kim,Hyeonwoo Na,Jaewoo Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出并验证了一种以病灶为中心的空间记录流程，无需全结肠3D重建即可实现重访检测、病灶身份归并与局部3D重建，在四个公开视频上取得了可量化的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结肠镜检查目前仅保留文本报告和静态图像，而视频中蕴含的空间信息（进镜路径、病灶位置、是否重复观察）在检查结束后即被丢弃。研究旨在探索能否在不进行全结肠3D重建的前提下，构建并验证以病灶为中心的空间记录。

Method: 采用四层分级流程：(1) 全局拓扑图；(2) 病灶级时空轨迹；(3) 按需局部3D重建；(4) 重复观察下的持久病灶身份。各组件均为已发表且单独验证过的方法，本文贡献在于其以病灶为中心的集成、链接规则与评估。在四个公开视频（两个带真值深度的C3VDv2序列和两个完整REAL-Colon检查，共40,245帧）上端到端运行。

Result: 基于入口图贝叶斯定位检测到重访事件（前向单向建图在结构上无法实现）：两个完整检查分别检出5,614和4,043次重访事件（56和68个不同节点）。采用阈值0.5的病灶身份归并保持真值纯度1.0，同时自动归并231个候选对中的20个。专用内镜几何引擎在所有指标上优于通用基础模型（整体绝对相对误差AbsRel为0.2276 vs. 0.3523）。

Conclusion: 结果虽为阶段性，但确立了可行的近期路径：重访检测、病灶身份和局部3D均在有完整几何重建之前即返回可量化、可复现的输出；在临床数据上验证该记录是下一步工作。

Abstract: Background and Objective: Colonoscopy recording practice preserves text reports and still photographs, while the spatial information already present in the recorded video - where the scope traveled, where a lesion was observed, and whether the same lesion was seen again - is discarded when the procedure ends. This study determines whether a lesion-centered spatial record can be assembled and validated without full-colon 3D reconstruction. Methods: A four-layer hierarchical pipeline was assembled - (1) a global topological map, (2) lesion-level spatio-temporal tracks, (3) on-demand local 3D reconstruction, and (4) persistent lesion identity across repeated observations - and ran end to end on four public videos (two C3VDv2 sequences with ground-truth depth and two full REAL-Colon procedures; 40,245 frames). Abstract: Large-scale pre-training has transformed representation learning in 2D vision, yet its transferability to 3D single object tracking (SOT) remains insufficiently understood. Directly fine-tuning self-supervised 3D encoders, such as masked autoencoders (MAE), often leads to sub-optimal adaptation because the reconstruction objective is not fully aligned with the spatial-temporal matching requirements of tracking. In this paper, we observe that this difficulty can be interpreted as a layer-wise transfer mismatch: shallow layers tend to preserve transferable geometric cues, while deeper layers become increasingly specialized to the reconstruction pretext task and are less suitable for downstream tracking. Based on this observation, we propose MAETrack, a lightweight adaptation framework for transferring pre-training MAE representations to 3D SOT. MAETrack includes Layer-Selective Initialization (LSI), which initializes only the shallow stages of the tracking backbone from pre-trained weights while re-initializing deeper stages, and Geometric Residual Gating (GRG), which reinforces structurally salient regions in the search BEV features before template-search fusion through residual spatial modulation. These inconsistencies across studies limit direct comparisons across methods and muddle the overall picture of local watermark robustness. *Jie Yang,Yingdong Pi,Qiyan Luo,Xiaoyu Wang,Lekang Wen,Mi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HLC-GS，一种风险图引导的高度层一致性3D高斯泼溅方法，用于光学卫星影像的DSM重建，缓解高度层混合误差并提升几何质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS在DSM重建中因alpha加权聚合会把同一像素处不同高度层的高斯splat混合，产生非物理的中间高程与高度层混合误差。

Method: HLC-GS包含三个模块：风险图模块（定位高程离散异常、主层响应不可靠的高风险像素）、主层可靠性校正模块（正则化不可靠的主层响应）、次层抑制模块（压制支撑不足的远距离次层响应）。

Conclusion: 显式建模逐像素高度层一致性可缓解高度层混合，提升基于3DGS的光学卫星影像DSM重建几何质量。

Abstract: A Digital Surface Model (DSM) is a fundamental geospatial data product for representing the elevation of the Earth's surface. Recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has shown considerable potential for DSM reconstruction from multi-view optical satellite imagery due to its explicit scene representation and efficient optimization. However, in 3DGS-based DSM generation, alpha-weighted aggregation of Gaussian altitudes may blend splats from different height layers at the same rendered pixel or DSM sampling location, producing non-physical intermediate elevations and height-layer mixing errors. To address this problem, we propose HLC-GS, a risk-map-guided height-layer consistency Gaussian Splatting method for DSM reconstruction from optical satellite imagery. HLC-GS consists of a risk map module, a dominant-layer reliability correction module, and a secondary-layer suppression module. The risk map localizes high-risk pixels with abnormal height dispersion and unreliable dominant-layer responses, while the latter two modules regularize unreliable dominant-layer responses and suppress weakly supported far secondary-layer responses. Extensive experiments are conducted on the DFC2019 and IARPA2016 datasets. Compared with six state-of-the-art DSM reconstruction methods, HLC-GS achieves better overall accuracy. Compared with the latest and precision-enhanced EOGS, HLC-GS reduces the average MAE from 1.46 m to 1.18 m and the average RMSE from 2.78 m to 2.58 m over the evaluated scenes, while improving PAG$_{2.5}$ from 86.09\% to 88.61\%. Overall, these results demonstrate that explicitly modeling per-pixel height-layer consistency alleviates height-layer mixing and improves the geometric quality of 3DGS-based DSM reconstruction from optical satellite imagery.

</details>


### [40] [FSANet: Frequency-Spatial Aware Network for Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16773)
*Ruibo Wang,Ziyi Shen,Huaming Wu,Dong Liang,Kun Shang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出频率空间感知网络FSANet，通过结构先验、双域感知和边缘估计三模块融合先验知识与双域求解器，并发布涵盖10种非理想场景的SceneX数据集，提升分割鲁棒性与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像分割在遮挡、弱光和不规则结构下仍有挑战。基于Transformer的方法精度高，但依赖长程空间特征，计算成本高，且忽视先验知识与噪声模式，导致细节缺失、边界不清。此外，缺乏覆盖多种真实场景的综合分割数据集，限制了现有方法的性能。

Method: 提出FSANet，融合先验知识与双域求解器以顺序适应多样分割任务，包含三个关键模块：(1) Structure Prior Module，恢复被忽略的细节；(2) Dual-Domain Awareness Module，捕捉显著特征并解耦噪声；(3) Edge Estimation Module，增强边缘感知以获得更精确的分割。同时构建并开源SceneX数据集，覆盖10种具有挑战性的非理想场景。

Result: 大量实验证明了FSANet的高效性与有效性；SceneX为评估和提升分割模型的鲁棒性与真实场景适用性建立了新的基准。

Conclusion: FSANet通过融合先验知识与双域感知机制，在提升分割精度的同时兼顾效率；SceneX数据集弥补了非理想场景基准的不足，为分割模型的鲁棒性和实际应用提供了新的评测平台。

Abstract: Image segmentation remains challenging due to occlusions, poor lighting, and irregular structures. Although transformer-based methods achieve high accuracy, they rely heavily on long-range spatial features, leading to high computational costs and neglecting prior knowledge or noise patterns, resulting in missing details and unclear boundaries. To address these issues, we propose Frequency Spatial Aware Network (FSANet), which integrates prior knowledge with a dual-domain solver to sequentially adapt to diverse segmentation tasks. Specifically, we design three key modules: (1) Structure Prior Module, which recovers overlooked details; (2) Dual-Domain Awareness Module, which captures salient features while disentangling noise; and (3) Edge Estimation Module, which enhances edge awareness for more precise segmentation. In addition, the limited availability of comprehensive segmentation datasets covering various real-world scenarios hinders the performance of existing methods. To address this, we introduce SceneX, a novel open-source dataset featuring 10 challenging non-ideal scenarios, establishing a new benchmark for evaluating and improving the robustness and real-world applicability of the segmentation models. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of FSANet.

</details>


### [41] [IMVS: Interactive Medical Volume Segmentation with Test-Time Adaptation - A New Method for Annotating Radiology Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16775)
*Abhilaksh Singh Reen,Kushal Borkar,Ritvik Mahapatra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: IMVS 是一个人在环的 3D 医学图像标注框架，通过在线适配的切片掩码适配器、冻结的体掩码跟踪器与软教师-学生对齐组成闭环，在保证分割质量的同时大幅降低标注交互成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模放射数据集标注受限于逐切片手动勾画结构的成本。现有交互方法效率低：切片级方法忽略层间连续性；3D/视频方法使用固定传播器，无法适应目标体积，在低对比或病变结构上易漂移，需反复重新提示。

Method: 提出 IMVS，将三个组件组成闭环而非新的分割原语：(1) 轻量 2D Slice Mask Adapter (SMA)，由用户涂鸦在线微调；(2) 冻结的 Volume Mask Tracker (VMT)，将修正后的掩码传播到相邻切片；(3) 软教师-学生对齐，限制遗忘。SMA 与骨干网络无关（UNet++、DeepLabV3、TransUNet）。

Result: 在 8 个公开 CT/MRI 数据集上，IMVS 质量与强交互基线相当，但显著减少标注工作量：比熟练的复制式手动流程快 14.4 倍（比朴素手动快 22.3 倍），比切片级交互方法快 4.6 倍，比 3D 交互方法快 1.9 倍。MedSAM2 和 ScribblePrompt 在边界清晰器官上表现相当或更强；IMVS 在困难目标和交互效率上优势最大。

Conclusion: IMVS 通过闭环的人机协作设计，有效解决了交互式 3D 标注中的传播漂移与交互低效问题，在多种数据集和骨干网络上具备通用性，尤其在困难目标与交互效率方面优势显著。源码与演示视频已公开。

Abstract: Annotating large radiology datasets is bottlenecked by the manual effort of delineating structures slice-by-slice in 3D volumes. Interactive methods reduce this effort but stay interaction-inefficient: slice-wise methods (including many foundation models) ignore inter-slice continuity, while 3D and video-based methods propagate a prompt with a \emph{fixed} propagator that never adapts to the target volume, so it drifts on low-contrast or pathological structures and must be re-prompted. We present IMVS, a human-in-the-loop annotation framework that composes three components into a closed loop rather than a new segmentation primitive: a lightweight 2D Slice Mask Adapter (SMA) fine-tuned online from user scribbles, a frozen Volume Mask Tracker (VMT) that propagates corrected masks across adjacent slices, and a soft teacher--student alignment that limits forgetting. The SMA is backbone-agnostic (UNet++, DeepLabV3, TransUNet). Across 8 public CT/MRI datasets, IMVS matches strong interactive baselines in quality while sharply cutting annotation effort: $14.4\times$ faster than a proficient copy-based manual workflow ($22.3\times$ over naive manual), $4.6\times$ over slice-wise and $1.9\times$ over 3D interactive methods. MedSAM2 and ScribblePrompt stay competitive or stronger on well-delineated organs; IMVS's advantage is largest on challenging targets and on interaction efficiency. Source code and Demo Video: https://github.com/AbhilakshSinghReen/imvs.

</details>


### [42] [Unifying Semantic Priors and High-Frequency Traces: Enhancing V-JEPA with Mixture-of-Experts for Robust Synthetic Image Forensics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16778)
*Simone Teglia,Irene Amerini*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文首次将JEPA世界模型引入深度伪造检测，提出双流架构MoE-JEPA，在SID-Set基准上以95.54%准确率刷新SOTA，超越更大规模模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体上被篡改图像的无节制扩散加剧了虚假信息传播，威胁公众信任与信息完整性。现有基于ViT的深度伪造检测器依赖低层不一致特征，其全局理解不足以单独区分真假内容，尤其在图像经压缩或社交媒体传输等困难场景下表现受限。

Method: 作者假设并实证JEPA模型内在的"视觉现实"世界理解可作为深度伪造检测的强先验。为此提出MoE-JEPA双流检测架构：以V-JEPA 2为主干，引入残差混合专家（MoE）机制，并增加噪声流分支以动态内化取证知识；同时采用门控注意力多实例学习（MIL）模块实现精确的空间语义理解。

Result: 在包含30万张AI生成、篡改与真实图像的SID-Set基准上评估，MoE-JEPA取得95.54%的准确率，建立新的SOTA，成功超越参数量远大于自身的模型。

Conclusion: JEPA世界模型的广义视觉现实表征可作为深度伪造检测的有效先验；结合MoE机制、噪声流与门控注意力MIL，能够在压缩及社交媒体传播等挑战场景下实现高精度检测，并具备优于大规模模型的效率优势。

Abstract: The unchecked proliferation of manipulated images on social media platforms has increased the spread of misinformation, posing a severe threat to public trust and information integrity. Modern deepfake detectors typically rely on Vision Transformers (ViTs) to capture the low-level inconsistencies that characterize fully synthetic or locally tampered images. However, the global understanding of such foundation models is not enough to discriminate alone between real and fake multimedia content, especially in challenging scenarios where images are compressed or transmitted through social media. In this paper we pioneer the application of Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) models to deepfake detection, taking advantage of the generalized representation of visual reality that such World Models have exhibited. We hypothesize, and empirically demonstrate, that the intrinsic world understanding of JEPA models can be used as a strong prior for a deepfake detector. To fully exploit JEPA capabilities, we propose MoE-JEPA, a dual-stream architecture for deepfake detection. By enhancing a V-JEPA 2 backbone with a Residual Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) mechanism, along with a noise stream branch, our model dynamically internalizes forensic knowledge. Furthermore, a Gated Attention Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) module is employed to ensure precise spatial semantic understanding. Evaluated on the SID-Set benchmark, comprising 300K AI-generated, tampered and authentic images, MoE-JEPA establishes a new state-of-the-art with an accuracy of 95.54%, successfully outperforming vastly larger models.

</details>


### [43] [PSMP-CLIP: Patch-Prompt SAM and Multi-Semantic Prompting for CLIP-Based Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16785)
*Xuezhi Xiang,Guanghao Wu,Heqi Xiang,Jiayao Liu,Xiaoheng Li,Yiming Chen,Shanjun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PSMP-CLIP，通过 patch 提示驱动的 SAM2 分割与多语义提示正则化，实现零样本异常检测，在 14 个数据集上取得极具竞争力的像素级性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零样本异常检测需在无目标域样本条件下定位异常。现有基于 CLIP 的方法存在两个问题：异常图粗糙、语义提示表达能力有限。

Method: 方法包含两个模块：PPSS（patch-prompt SAM2 segmentation）从中间 patch 特征直接采样提示，避免阈值漂移，并引导 SAM2 生成精确掩码；MSGPR（multi-semantic guided prompt regularization）使用多个可学习提示，并由语义锚点约束，以保持泛化能力。

Result: 在 14 个数据集上实验，整体性能极具竞争力；在 MVTec AD、BTAD、DTD-Synthetic、CVC-ClinicDB、TN3K、Endo、Kvasir 上取得最佳像素级 AUROC。

Conclusion: PSMP-CLIP 通过将提示采样从阈值依赖转为 patch 特征驱动，并结合多语义提示正则化，有效缓解了 CLIP 类方法异常图粗糙与提示语义受限的问题，在多个基准上达到领先的像素级异常定位性能。

Abstract: Zero-shot anomaly detection aims to localize anomalies without target-domain samples. Existing CLIP-based methods suffer from coarse anomaly maps and limited semantic prompts. We propose PSMP-CLIP, integrating patch-prompt SAM2 segmentation (PPSS) and multi-semantic guided prompt regularization (MSGPR). PPSS samples prompts directly from intermediate patch features, avoiding threshold drift and guiding SAM2 to produce precise masks. MSGPR uses multiple learnable prompts constrained by semantic anchors to preserve generalization. Experiments on 14 datasets show highly competitive performance, achieving the best pixel-level AUROC on MVTec AD, BTAD, DTD-Synthetic, CVC-ClinicDB, TN3K, Endo, and Kvasir.

</details>


### [44] [TEDi: Temporal Memory-Enhanced and Denoising Transformer for Surgical Instrument Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16797)
*Jiahong Yuan,Weiming Mi,Tao Zhang,Haoyin Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TEDi——一种用于手术器械分割的时序记忆增强与去噪Transformer，通过记忆搜索增强与时序一致性去噪解决现有逐帧预测方法忽视跨帧时序先验与一致性约束导致的查询表示不稳定和类别识别欠佳问题，在EndoVis 2017与2018上超越SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于查询（query-based）的分割方法在手术器械分割与识别中潜力可观，但现有方法多依赖逐帧预测，忽略跨帧时序先验与时序一致性约束，导致查询表示不稳定、类别识别效果次优。

Method: 提出TEDi（Temporal memory-Enhanced and Denoising transformer），包含两个核心模块：(1) 记忆搜索增强（Memory Search Enhancement）：引入查询级记忆库（query-level memory bank）与记忆搜索增强编码器，从历史帧检索判别性表示以丰富当前帧特征；(2) 时序一致性去噪（Temporal Consistency Denoising）：构建时序一致的参考作为跨帧语义锚点，抑制时序不稳定的预测并促进跨帧语义连贯。

Result: 在EndoVis 2017与EndoVis 2018两个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，TEDi持续优于当前最先进方法。代码已开源（github.com/argon-xixi/TEDi）。

Conclusion: TEDi通过融合跨帧时序记忆与时序一致性约束，有效提升手术器械分割的稳定性和类别识别精度，展现出进一步推动计算机辅助手术发展的潜力。

Abstract: Query-based segmentation methods have shown promising potential for surgical instrument segmentation and recognition, which is essential for scene understanding and downstream tasks in computer assisted surgery. However, most existing approaches predominantly rely on per-frame predictions and overlook cross-frame temporal priors as well as temporal-consistency constraints. This limitation often leads to unstable query representations and suboptimal category recognition. In this paper, we propose TEDi, a Temporal memory-Enhanced and Denoising transformer for surgical instrument segmentation that addresses these is sues through Memory Search Enhancement and Temporal Consistency Denoising. The former introduces a query-level memory bank and a memory search enhancement encoder to retrieve discriminative representations from historical frames, enriching current-frame features. The latter constructs a temporally consistent reference as a cross-frame semantic anchor to suppress temporally unstable predictions and promote semantic coherence across frames. Extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets, EndoVis 2017 and EndoVis 2018, demonstrate that TEDi consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, highlighting its potential to further advance computer-assisted surgery. Our code is available at github.com/argon-xixi/TEDi.

</details>


### [45] [Hyper-RED: Scalable Event Pre-training via Semantic Hypergraph Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16811)
*Meisen Wang,Zhiqiang Tian,Wei Bao,Chengjie Wang,Shaoyi Du,Siqi Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Hyper-RED，利用超图建模并蒸馏图像到事件的高阶语义结构，实现可扩展的事件表征预训练，在五个数据集三个任务上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机具备鲁棒视觉感知潜力，但大规模标注事件数据稀缺，制约事件表征学习的扩展。预训练图像模型可提供可扩展的语义监督，然而现有图像到事件方法依赖刚性的像素级或token级对齐，忽视纹理、密度、外观等模态差异，易导致语义坍缩并限制迁移能力。

Method: Hyper-RED以超图建模并对齐多个图像与事件token间的高阶语义关联。对成对的事件—图像样本，用DINOv3提取空间token表征，构建图像、事件与跨模态语义超图，每条超边连接多个语义相关token；并提出超图关系蒸馏损失，施加互补的模态内与跨模态约束，使事件编码器继承图像语义组织，同时保持局部关系一致性与事件特有特征。

Result: 在五个事件数据集的三个任务上，从ViT-S到ViT-L表现出稳定的规模扩展性，并取得SOTA性能。

Conclusion: Hyper-RED是一种简单、无痛且可扩展的图像到事件预训练框架，通过高阶语义结构迁移缓解模态差异带来的语义坍缩，验证了事件表征学习的规模化潜力。代码已开源。

Abstract: Event cameras have shown great potential for robust visual perception, yet scaling event representation learning remains challenging due to the scarcity of large-scale annotated event data. Pretrained image models provide scalable semantic supervision, but existing image-to-event methods rely on rigid pixel-wise or token-wise alignment that overlooks modality discrepancies in texture, density, and appearance, potentially causing semantic collapse and limiting transferability. To address this issue, we propose Hyper-RED, a simple, painless, and scalable image-to-event pretraining framework that transfers high-order semantic structures from images to events. Hyper-RED uses hypergraphs to model and align high-order semantic associations among multiple image and event tokens, enabling cross-modal knowledge transfer while accommodating modality-specific differences rather than enforcing rigid one-to-one correspondence. Specifically, given a paired event--image sample, Hyper-RED leverages DINOv3 to extract spatial token representations and constructs image, event, and cross-modal semantic hypergraphs, where each hyperedge connects multiple semantically correlated tokens. We further introduce a hypergraph relational distillation loss that imposes complementary intra- and cross-modal constraints, enabling the event encoder to inherit image-derived semantic organization while preserving local relational consistency and event-specific characteristics. Experiments on three tasks across five event datasets demonstrate consistent scaling from ViT-S to ViT-L and state-of-the-art performance (Fig.1). The code is available at: https://github.com/meisenwang/Hyper--RED.

</details>


### [46] [StackTok: Accelerating VLMs Inference with Budget-Adaptive Visual Token Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16841)
*Zhenbin Wang,Lei Zhang,Lituan Wang,Wei Huang,Yan Wang,Zhenwei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StackTok：一种免训练的视觉token选择器，将查询相关性作为目标、视觉覆盖作为预算校准的支撑，自适应平衡二者，在五个VLM和十个基准上均取得免训练方法中最佳表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率图像在视觉语言模型（VLM）中产生超长视觉token序列，显著增加推理成本。现有免训练方法通过选择紧凑token子集来降低开销，但采用固定的"相关性—覆盖度"权衡，无法适应不同查询和不同token预算：局部性问题更依赖相关性，整体性问题则需要更广的视觉覆盖。

Method: StackTok将查询相关性视为优化目标、视觉覆盖视为预算校准的支撑。它从仅覆盖度的贪心序列构建"尺寸索引的覆盖参考"，并用查询—视觉亲和力熵调整支撑目标；通过参考门控的交错选择策略，依据当前子集的支撑缺口在相关性导向与覆盖度导向的增补之间切换。对高分辨率输入，按各局部提名token的组合边际增益在多个crop间分配共享token预算。

Result: 在五个VLM、十个图像理解基准、各种模型—预算设置下，StackTok在免训练选择器中均排名第一。在高分辨率LLaVA-NeXT-7B上，仅用2,880个视觉token中的160个（5.6%）即保留全token性能的95.26%。

Conclusion: 通过将相关性目标与预算校准的覆盖支撑动态结合，StackTok实现了无需训练、查询自适应的视觉token压缩，在显著降低推理成本的同时保持高精度。

Abstract: Increasing image resolution produces ever-longer visual-token sequences in vision-language models (VLMs), substantially raising their inference cost. To reduce this overhead without retraining, existing methods select compact token subsets that prioritize query relevance, visual coverage, or a fixed trade-off between them. The appropriate balance, however, varies across queries and token budgets: localized questions favor relevance, whereas holistic questions demand broader visual coverage. We introduce StackTok, a training-free selector that treats query relevance as the objective and visual coverage as budget-calibrated support. StackTok builds a size-indexed coverage reference from a coverage-only greedy sequence and adjusts its support target using query--vision affinity entropy. A reference-gated interleaved selection policy then switches between relevance- and coverage-oriented additions according to the current subset's support deficit. For high-resolution inputs, StackTok allocates one shared token budget across crops according to the combined marginal gain of locally nominated tokens. Evaluated with five VLMs over ten distinct image-understanding benchmarks, StackTok ranks first among training-free selectors in every tested model--budget setting. On high-resolution LLaVA-NeXT-7B, it retains 95.26% of full-token performance with only 160 of 2{,}880 (5.6%) visual tokens.

</details>

*Jun Wan,Jiwei Hu,Shengkai Hu,Qilu Zhu*

TL;DR: 提出FAHCD-Net，结合频域自适应热图条件扩散模型与平滑正则化损失，在级联框架下提升复杂场景人脸关键点检测的鲁棒性与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有人脸关键点检测方法在面部结构变化、信息丢失与噪声干扰等挑战性条件下表现不佳，学习到的面部特征完整性与准确性受损。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：1）频域自适应热图条件扩散（FAHCD）模型，引入层次化频率自适应（HFA）模块，通过多层频率分解与自适应重构抑制冗余高频噪声，保留关键面部结构；2）平滑正则化（SR）损失，进一步抑制高频噪声干扰并增强生成热图的平滑性；3）将FAHCD模型与SR损失级联，综合利用数据的统计分布与频率分布特性，从含噪输入逐步生成更精确的关键点热图。

Abstract: Facial Landmark Detection(FLD) is a crucial task in various applications and has achieved significant advancements in recent years. However, current FLD methods still struggle under challenging conditions, where facial structural variations, information loss, and noise interference severely compromise the integrity and accuracy of learned facial features. To address these issues, we propose Frequency-Adaptive Heatmap-Conditional Diffusion Network (FAHCD-Net), which integrates a Frequency-Adaptive Heatmap-Conditional Diffusion (FAHCD) model with a Smoothness Regularization (SR) loss in a cascaded framework. Specifically, the FAHCD model incorporates a Hierarchical Frequency Adaptation (HFA) module designed to suppress redundant high-frequency noise through multi-layer frequency decomposition and adaptive reconstruction, thereby preserving essential facial structures. Additionally, the SR loss is proposed to further mitigate the interference of high-frequency noise and enhance the smoothness of the generated landmark heatmaps. By cascading the FAHCD model with the SR loss, FAHCD-Net effectively leverages both statistical and frequency-based distribution characteristics of the data to progressively generate more accurate landmark heatmaps from noisy inputs. Extensive experiments on popular benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method, achieving state-of-the-art performance in FLD tasks under challenging scenarios. <details>

Abstract: Region-level retrieval aims to align user-specified image regions with relevant regions or textual descriptions, playing a crucial role in realworld applications such as e-commerce product search and RAG. Although recent Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have made significant strides in multimodal retrieval, they primarily focus on global-level tasks and struggle to capture effective region-level representations. To bridge this gap, we present RegRet, an LMM-based Region-level Retrieval framework that enhances the regional representations without compromising overall global retrieval performance. At its core, RegRet integrates a Region-Aware Encoder to capture detailed regional features while balancing them with the global background context. To further enhance the fine-grained understanding and discriminability of representations, we design a multi-stage training pipeline that includes detailed localized captioning and regional contrastive learning tasks. In addition, considering the absence of region-level contrastive training data and the limited diversity of evaluation tasks in current benchmarks, we introduce the REGMB benchmark. It comprises 225k contrastive pairs, covering four multimodal retrieval tasks. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach. RegRet outperforms strong baselines in the zero-shot setting. Further training with contrastive learning leads to an average improvement of more than 20\% on both REGMB and public benchmarks, while achieving comparable or better results on global-level retrieval tasks.

</details>


### [49] [TecoPrompt: Temporal-Conservative Prompt Learning for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16858)
*Zeyi Shao,Haowen Hua,Jiaxin Zhang,John See,Zeyd Boukhers,Cong Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TecoPrompt，一种闭环鲁棒提示学习框架，从时间维度重新审视最优传输伪标签，以应对少样本监督下标签噪声对提示优化的干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示学习（如CLIP）仅调整少量上下文令牌，但在少样本监督下，即使中等程度的标签噪声也会破坏提示优化过程，因此需要提升其鲁棒性。

Method: TecoPrompt在CLIP语义空间中使用熵正则化最优传输（OT）方案生成全局一致的候选标签；通过轨迹稳定性验证候选标签可靠性——仅当OT候选在K-epoch时间稳定窗口内保持不变，且通过基于指数移动平均（EMA）的置信门控时，才重写噪声标签，以缓解确认偏差；随后将重写标签通过包含干净、中间、噪声三个子集对应损失的三组目标函数整合回提示训练中。

Result: 在七个数据集上进行合成对称与非对称噪声实验，并在Food101N上验证，性能显著提升。例如在OxfordPets数据集上，50%非对称噪声下准确率达0.843，优于基线的0.775。

Conclusion: 从时间视角结合OT伪标签与稳定性验证，可有效提升提示学习在噪声标签下的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Prompt learning adapts vision-language models, such as CLIP, by adjusting a small set of context tokens. However, under few-shot supervision, even moderate label noise can disrupt prompt optimization. To address this issue, we propose TecoPrompt, a closed-loop robust prompt-learning framework that revisits optimal transport (OT) pseudo-labeling from a temporal perspective. TecoPrompt employs an entropic OT plan in the CLIP semantic space to obtain globally consistent label candidates. It verifies the reliability of these candidates by examining trajectory stability: a noisy label is only rewritten if the OT candidate remains unchanged within a K-epoch temporal stability window and passes a confidence gate based on Exponential Moving Average (EMA). This approach helps reduce confirmation bias. The rewritten labels are then integrated back into prompt training using a tri-group objective that includes three loss functions aligned with clean, mid, and noisy subsets. Experiments on seven datasets with synthetic symmetric and asymmetric noise, as well as Food101N, demonstrate significant performance improvements. For example, on the OxfordPets dataset, with 50% asymmetric noise, TecoPrompt achieves an accuracy of 0.843, up from 0.775.

</details>

*Manglesh Kumar Pandey,Sumit Kumar Banshal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在Devanagari手写文本识别中，通过对同一识别器、优化器和评估协议仅改变微调真实转写词数量（9档，10–4,000词）与4种初始化方式（每点6个随机种子），测量预训练可节省的人工转写量：合成预训练仅需81词即达CER 0.50，随机初始化需355词，标签倍数为4.40 [3.56, 4.99]；零样本预训练价值约等于136个真实转写词，但该优势随目标精度提高而缩小，最严苛目标下与无节省不可区分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对仅少数专家能阅读的书写系统，人工转写本身构成瓶颈，而所训练模型本应节省这些专家的时间。因此需要回答两个问题：识别器在多少转写下才变得有用，以及预训练能消除多少转写成本。作者选择手写Devanagari作为直接测量的对象。

Method: 固定识别器、优化器与评估协议，仅改变用于微调的真实转写词数：设置9个预算档（10至4,000）和4种初始化机制，每个配置点使用6个随机种子。识别结果曲线被换算为"标注等价"词数。另设第四组实验仅迁移编码器，以区分预训练方法效应与迁移范围效应。稀缺性通过从大型语料中下采样构造。

Result: 达到CER 0.50时，有监督合成预训练只需81个转写词，随机初始化需355个，标签倍数为4.40 [3.56, 4.99]。零样本（不使用任何真实转写词）下，该预训练相当于约136个转写词的价值。该优势随目标精度提高而减小，在最严苛目标下与无节省不可区分。仅迁移编码器的第四组实验将预训练方法效应与迁移范围效应分离，并观察到掩码图像建模在有界预算范围内呈负迁移。

Conclusion: 预训练能显著降低低精度目标下的标注需求，但其收益随目标精度提升而递减，在最严苛精度下无法与无节省区分；迁移范围（仅编码器）会影响结论，掩码图像建模在一定预算区间内产生负迁移。研究强调该稀缺设定源于对大型语料的下采样，因此结论的适用性受此构造方式限制。

Abstract: To train handwritten text recognition systems we need word images and their corresponding transcriptions, and these transcriptions are produced manually. For a script that can be read by only a small number of specialists, this manual transcription is a limitation, because the trained models are supposed to save the time of those same specialists. A relevant question therefore arises: how many transcriptions are needed before a recogniser becomes useful, and how much of that cost can pretraining remove? In this study the answer is measured directly for handwritten Devanagari. We keep the recogniser, optimiser and evaluation protocol the same and change only the number of real transcribed words used for fine-tuning across nine budgets from 10 to 4,000 and four initialisation regimes, with six seeds at every point. The resulting curves are then converted into annotation-equivalent terms. A CER of 0.50 is reached by supervised synthetic pretraining using only 81 transcribed words, whereas random initialisation requires 355, which gives a label multiplier of 4.40 [3.56, 4.99]. There is a zero-shot reference point as well: with no real transcribed words at all, this pretraining is worth about 136 of them. This advantage gets smaller as the target accuracy improves, and at the most demanding target we measure, it cannot be distinguished from no saving at all. A fourth arm in which only the encoder is transferred separates the effect of the pretraining method from that of transfer scope, and masked image modelling is observed to transfer negatively over a bounded range of budgets. We emphasise that the scarcity in this study is constructed by subsampling a large corpus.

</details>


### [51] [tcnerv:dual-domain temporal context modeling for implicit neural video compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16870)
*Xuezhi Xiang,Yixin Zhao,Heqi Xiang,Jiayao Liu,Shanjun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TCNeRV，通过在特征域和嵌入域利用重建上下文，提升隐式神经视频表示压缩的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频隐式神经表示（INR）通常独立解码各帧，导致中间特征未以上一帧重建结果为条件，且内容嵌入缺乏显式的时间预测，限制了率失真性能。

Method: TCNeRV包含两个模块：多尺度时间上下文融合（MTCF）在解码器多个尺度注入门控的历史特征；时间嵌入残差编码（TERC）对每个内容嵌入进行预测并仅编码其残差。

Conclusion: TCNeRV在有限模型容量下实现了具有竞争力的率失真性能，验证了在特征与嵌入双域利用重建上下文的有效性。

Abstract: Video compression aims to minimize reconstruction distor tion under a constrained bit rate. Existing video implicit neural representations (INRs) often decode frames independently, leaving intermediate features unconditioned on previous reconstructions and content embeddings without explicit temporal prediction. We propose TCNeRV, which exploits reconstructed context in both feature and embedding domains. Its multi-scale temporal-context fusion (MTCF) module injects gated historical features at multiple decoder scales, while temporal embedding-residual coding (TERC) predicts each content embedding and codes only its residual. With approximately 3M parameters, TCNeRV achieves an average PSNR of 36.08 dB on the UVG dataset, outperforming HNeRV-Boost by 2.20 dB. It reduces BD-rate by 22.06%, 66.73%, and 29.85% relative to HM, DCVC, and HiNeRV, respectively, demonstrating competitive rate-distortion performance with limited model capacity.

</details>

*Rajiv Ranjan,Udaiveer Singh,Shashank Tamaskar,Dharmendra Saraswat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SPEAR NeXT：一种紧凑的像素级多模态光谱-时间基础模型，将时间自监督建模为"仅用过去、多时域潜在地球状态预测"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有地球观测基础模型的时间信息多通过重建、不变性或回顾式序列摘要学习，未显式建模由过去预测未来的动态过程，难以捕获地球状态的时序演化。

Result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。

Conclusion: SPEAR NeXT以"过去预测未来"的多时域潜在状态预测作为时间自监督，构建紧凑的像素级多模态光谱-时间基础模型。

Abstract: Earth observation is inherently dynamic, yet temporal information in many foundation models is learned through reconstruction, invariance, or retrospective sequence summarization. SPEAR NeXT is introduced as a compact pixel-wise multimodal spectral temporal foundation model in which temporal self supervision is formulated as past only, multi horizon latent Earth state prediction. Instantaneous states are first encoded by the pretrained SPEAR model from optical, radar, and environmental observations into compact 32 dimensional embeddings. Their temporal evolution is then modeled by a causally masked Trans former that predicts multiple future latent states from pre ceding observations. Relative temporal order is represented using Rotary Position Embeddings, while month and year embeddings encode seasonal phase and interannual con text.

</details>

*Taigo Sakai,Kazuhiro Hotta,Hiroki Kouno,Naoki Kato*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GRACE，一种少相机多视角BEV跟踪器，通过体引导融合、射线条件化与BTR轨迹恢复三组件，在WildTrack两相机设置下将MOTA从83.54提升至91.07。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 减少相机数量可降低部署成本，但会去除用于纠正BEV响应偏移的视角，并引入易导致轨迹断裂的短时分数骤降问题。因此需要在少相机条件下保证BEV跟踪的准确性与轨迹连续性。

Method: GRACE包含三个组件：（1）Volumetric-Guided Fusion，将基于单应性的BEV特征与通过3D空间提升得到的特征相融合；（2）Ray Conditioning，将每个相机的视线方向信息显式暴露给融合网络；（3）BEV Track Recovery（BTR）跟踪组件，仅利用低置信度检测来延续已有轨迹，不允许这些检测起始新轨迹。

Abstract: Reducing the number of cameras reduces the deployment cost but removes views that correct BEV responses stretched away from true pedestrian positions by projection and short score drops that can split tracks} in Bird's-Eye View (BEV) tracking. We introduce GRACE, a camera-efficient multi-view tracker with three components. Volumetric-Guided Fusion combines homography-based BEV features with features lifted through 3D space. Ray Conditioning exposes each camera's viewing direction to the fusion network. Its tracking component, BEV Track Recovery (BTR), uses low-confidence detections only to continue existing tracks. The same detections cannot start new tracks. With two WildTrack cameras, GRACE improves MOTA from 83.54 for TrackTacular, our baseline, to 91.07.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Pediatric brain tumors are a leading cause of cancer-related mortality in children, and their small, rare, and often low-contrast subregions make accurate manual delineation challenging. Reliable automated segmentation is therefore needed to support diagnosis, treatment planning, and response assessment. Accordingly, we introduce NeuroTS-Net, a three-dimensional encoder-decoder convolutional neural network architecture for multi-class semantic segmentation that incorporates a dual-scale raw-detail stream, adaptive low-resolution context selection, and detail-preserving multipath downsampling. These components preserve fine intensity and boundary information while efficiently modeling broader tumor context. NeuroTS-Net was trained on the BraTS 2026 pediatric dataset without external data or pretrained weights and evaluated against nnU-Net and MedNeXt under the same experimental protocol. NeuroTS-Net outperformed the baseline methods, achieving whole-tumor and tumor-core Dice scores of 0.938 and 0.937 on the internal validation set and 0.927 and 0.926 on the official challenge validation set. The code is open-sourced at: https://github.com/maenstru56/NeuroTS.

</details>


### [55] [Accelerated Decoding of Centroid Positional Encoding for Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16874)
*Carmelo Scribano,Filippo Muzzini,Nedyalko Prisadnikov,Mohammad Mahdi,Yuqian Fu,Giorgia Franchini,Danda Pani Paudel,Marko Bertogna,Luc Van Gool*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对实例分割中正弦质心编码的解码开销问题，提出一种优化的CUDA解码实现，显著降低了解码开销并改善端到端推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型推理之外的解码阶段将原始网络输出转换为任务级表示，占执行成本的很大一部分，但预测解码长期被忽视，通常使用通用CPU例程或低效GPU核实现，限制了模型效率提升带来的收益。特别是正弦质心编码虽支持无需预定义候选框的灵活分割，但从密集嵌入中提取实例掩码计算成本高昂。

Result: 该方案显著降低了解码开销，改善了端到端推理延迟，性能优于基于CPU的方法和朴素GPU实现。

Abstract: Beyond model inference, the decoding stage, which converts raw network outputs into task-level representations, constitutes a significant portion of the execution cost. Despite its practical impact, prediction decoding has received comparatively little attention and is often implemented using generic CPU routines or inefficient GPU kernels, limiting the benefits of advances in model efficiency. In this work, we investigate the decoding overhead associated with a recent sinusoidal centroid encoding for Instance Segmentation, in which each pixel regresses a positional embedding of its instance centroid. This approach allows flexible segmentation without predefined proposals, but extracting instance masks from dense embeddings incurs a high computational cost. We present an optimized CUDA-based implementation of the decoding algorithm tailored to this encoding, explicitly addressing challenges related to parallelization, synchronization, and memory access on modern GPUs. Our solution significantly reduces decoding overhead and improves End-to-End inference latency, outperforming both CPU-based approaches and naive GPU implementations. The results demonstrate that efficient decoding is essential to fully exploit the advantages of advanced output representations and highlight the importance of jointly designing encoding schemes and their decoding algorithms for real-time computer vision systems.

</details>

*Jaeseok Byun,Gukyeong Kwon,Han-Kai Hsu,Meher Gitika Karumuri,Zhikang Zhang,Hao Yang,Davide Modolo*

TL;DR: 本文提出MKP-Adapter，首个无需更新骨干网络的适配器式多模态大模型后向兼容训练方法，通过多级知识保持损失与焦点重加权策略，在图像、文本、视觉文档与视频检索任务中实现强后向兼容性，且训练仅依赖预提取嵌入、推理延迟开销极小。

Method: 提出MKP-Adapter，首个面向多模态大模型（MLLMs）的纯适配器式BCT方法，无需骨干更新。其核心挑战在于适配器式BCT中既要保持新嵌入知识又要强制后向兼容，为此设计多级保持损失以在BCT过程中维持嵌入空间的几何结构，并引入焦点重加权策略以优先学习困难样本。

Result: 在图像、文本、视觉文档与视频检索等多类多模态基准及多种模型类型上取得强后向兼容性；方法仅基于预提取嵌入训练，相对原始骨干前向传播仅增加可忽略的额外延迟。

Conclusion: MKP-Adapter为MLLM提供了一种高效、无需修改骨干的适配器式后向兼容训练方案，兼顾兼容性、知识与性能保持及低开销。

Abstract: Upgrading embedding models typically requires expensive database re-indexing, as new query embeddings are incompatible with existing database embeddings. While Backward Compatible Training (BCT) mitigates this by enforcing compatibility during training, existing approaches often require updating the backbone model. This is impractical because of significant training cost, the risk of performance regression, and limited access to proprietary model weights. We introduce Multi-modal Knowledge Preserving Adapter (MKP-Adapter), the first adapter-only BCT approach for Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) that requires no backbone updates. We identified that the primary challenge in adapter-only BCT is preserving the knowledge of the new embeddings while enforcing backward compatibility. Hence, we propose a multi-level preservation loss that maintains the geometric structure of the embedding spaces throughout BCT. Furthermore, a focal re-weighting strategy is integrated to prioritize learning from challenging samples. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves strong backward compatibility across diverse multi-modal benchmarks (image, text, visual document, and video retrieval tasks) and model types. Notably, MKP-Adapter is trained solely on pre-extracted embeddings and requires only negligible additional latency relative to the original backbone forward pass, highlighting its efficiency.
