With stationary observers, 25 Hz image input, and ideal state-feedback control, a fixed standard suite yielded 44 correct complete messages from 53 receiver exposures across 17 nominal broadcasts; 13 broadcasts passed all group-level decoding and execution checks. Three additional no-message or input-fault controls met their expected outcomes. A separately reported supplemental suite, using the same frozen code at the default geometry, achieved 14 successful receiver exposures across three broadcasts. Near-range and wide-angle configurations exposed tracking and recognition failures, while unsuccessful receivers remained stationary. These finite simulation results support the feasibility of a waggle-dance-inspired broadcast-to-action mechanism under the tested conditions and identify the present perceptual and protocol limits.

</details>


### [305] [Overcoming technical adoption barriers for mobile service robots in rehabilitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16996)
*Christian Sternitzke,Sebastian Blumenthal,Lukas Kleedoerfer,Verena Deserno,Anke Mayfarth*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文指出，医疗机器人研究多停留在低技术成熟度阶段；作者以一款已获批为医疗器械的移动服务机器人为例，说明通过外围功能补充与小改进提升技术成熟度，对用户接受度至关重要，并建议开发者预留此类下游开发时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医疗机器人文献多聚焦早期阶段（低技术成熟度）工作，缺乏对如何在真实临床环境中实现用户接受、推动系统广泛应用的后期开发路径的探讨。

Method: 以一款已获医疗器械认证的移动服务机器人为对象，通过在实际临床或操作环境中测试，识别用户需求，并以外围功能开发与细节优化迭代提升系统。

Result: 外围功能与小幅改进成为提升技术成熟度、获得用户接受的关键；此类需求往往难以在事前通过问卷调查获得，只有在临床或操作环境测试中才会显现。

Conclusion: 医疗服务机器人开发者应预先规划此类下游开发，并预留充足的实施时间，以实现用户接受与系统的广泛采用。

Abstract: Many publications on robotic systems in healthcare describe early-stage work on low technology readiness levels. This paper describes how a mobile service robot approved as a medical device reaches higher technology readiness levels by adding peripheral functions and smaller improvements, which are pivotal for user acceptance in clinical environments and which often cannot be elicited by questioning users ex-ante as certain aspects only come in mind from testing the systems in clinical settings or operational environments. Especially developers of service robots in healthcare are advised to plan with such downstream developments, which can take significant implementation time, to obtain user acceptance and achieve widespread adoption of their robotic systems.

</details>


### [306] [SWIM: Vision-Language-Grounded Soft Whole-Body Interactive Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17035)
*Tingcong Liu,Aye Phyu Phyu Aung,Junjie Xiong,Siyi Ma,Bo An,Ke Wu,Senthilnath Jayavelu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SWIM框架将RGB观测与语言指令映射为软体机器人整体驱动序列，通过扩散动作头与视觉软体本体感知的共享表征实现，仿真与真机任务成功率显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软体与连续体机器人依赖分布式形变与接触实现操作，但将语言与视觉上下文转化为可执行的整体驱动指令仍是基本难题；同时有限示范下策略难以保留本体几何信息，且在线策略查询代价高。

Method: 提出SWIM框架，其VLA策略SWIM-VLA在RGB观测、语言指令与肌腱状态的共享表征基础上，耦合扩散动作头与视觉软体本体感知（VSP）：扩散头建模专家指令块的条件分布，VSP以仿真真值监督有序身体锚点预测以保留本体几何；执行阶段通过演化仿真观测的迭代虚拟滚动生成指令序列，并借助具身机械智能与固有柔顺性实现局部接触自适应，无需在线策略查询。

Result: 在平面肌腱驱动软体机器人上评估抓取、到达与打包任务。仿真中成功率分别为100%、96%、88%，优于适配的OpenVLA-OFT基线及受控消融；真机上分别为100%、80%、75%，而同一策略检查点直接在线部署仅为75%、40%、25%。

Conclusion: 共享表征结合扩散动作生成与软体本体感知监督，可有效提升有限示范下的整体驱动学习；迭代虚拟滚动与固有柔顺性使策略无需在线查询即可完成物理执行，真机性能大幅领先直接在线部署。

Abstract: Soft and continuum robots enable manipulation through distributed body deformation and contact, yet translating language and visual context into executable whole-body actuation remains a fundamental challenge. We present SWIM, a framework that maps an initial RGB observation and a language instruction to a complete actuation-command sequence. Its vision-language-action (VLA) policy, SWIM-VLA, combines a diffusion action head with Visual Soft Proprioception (VSP) through a shared representation of RGB observations, language instructions, and tendon states. The diffusion head models conditional distributions of expert command chunks, while VSP supervises ordered body-anchor predictions using simulation ground truth, encouraging the representation to retain body geometry when learning from limited demonstrations. Embodied mechanical intelligence supports physical execution of command sequences generated through iterative virtual rollout from evolving simulated observations, with intrinsic compliance providing local contact adaptation without online policy queries. We evaluate SWIM on packing, reaching, and grasping on a planar tendon-driven soft robot, with grasping targets anchored. In simulation, SWIM-VLA achieves success rates of 100\%, 96\%, and 88\%, respectively, outperforming an adapted OpenVLA-OFT baseline and controlled ablations. On hardware, SWIM achieves success rates of 100\%, 80\%, and 75\%, compared with 75\%, 40\%, and 25\% for direct online deployment of the same policy checkpoint.

</details>


### [307] [BRAVE-6D: Benchmark for Robotic Active Vision in 6DOF Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17106)
*Philipp Ausserlechner,Bernhard Neuberger,Alessandro Scherl,Michael Schebek,Stefan Thalhammer,Markus Vincze*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: BRAVE-6D 是一个基于 3D 高斯泼溅(view synthesis)的机器人主动视觉基准,用于评估小物体位姿估计系统,并提供在合成场景中执行视觉伺服并准确估计小物体位姿的基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检测与抓取小物体在机器人领域仍是难题,主动视觉(让机器人靠近物体)是直观的解决思路;但由于比较不同方法需要完全相同的物理场景设置,难以在统一基准上公平对比。论文旨在解决这一缺乏公共评估平台的问题,聚焦于抓取的关键第一步——物体位姿估计。

Method: 提出 BRAVE-6D 基准,利用基于 3D 高斯泼溅(Gaussian Splats, 3DGS)的视图合成技术,为主动视觉系统提供构建场景与评测工具,从而支持在相同虚拟场景下对主动视觉方法进行可复现的对比评估,并提供执行视觉伺服与位姿估计的基线方案。

Result: 论文给出基线方案:在场景中执行视觉伺服(visual servoing),并能够准确估计小物体的位姿。

Conclusion: BRAVE-6D 为机器人主动视觉的物体位姿估计提供了统一、可复现的基准平台,借助 3DGS 视图合成避免了物理场景一致性的限制,并证明基线方法可在该基准下有效完成靠近与精确定位小物体的任务。

Abstract: Detecting and grasping small objects remains a significant challenge in robotics. Active vision, where the robot moves closer to the object, is an intuitive solution, yet comparing approaches on common ground is difficult since identical physical scene setups are required. Hence, we introduce BRAVE-6D, a benchmark designed to evaluate robotic active vision systems for object pose estimation, a crucial first step in grasping objects. BRAVE-6D leverages view synthesis based on Gaussian Splats (3DGS) to provide scenes and tools for benchmarking active vision systems. We show baseline solutions performing visual servoing within the scene and accurately estimating the poses of small objects.

</details>


### [308] [Intrinsic Robot Rewarding: Reusing VLA Representations for Autonomous Evaluation and Policy Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17115)
*Tobias Schaffer,Mohab Elkhayat,Daniela Nicklas,Mustafa Almohamad,Elham Al-Fuqara*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: IRR 复用 VLA 中已有的视觉编码器与成功示范端点构建奖励库，为机器人策略改进提供内在奖励，无需额外评估器或感知骨干，已在 COMAU Racer 3 平台达到 TRL 4。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人学习已拥有丰富的视觉表征与成功示范数据，但这些资源主要用于策略学习，未被用于评估机器人自身结果；额外训练评估器或感知骨干会带来集成负担与重复人工打分成本。

Method: 以成功示范端点作为任务特定参考，在策略冻结的视觉编码器特征空间中进行结果评估；在现有流程中加入参考库（reference bank）与打分操作（scoring operation），不引入独立学习的评估器或额外感知骨干。

Result: 给出奖励公式、核心研究问题与评估方法，将奖励可靠性与任务成功率、监督投入相关联；在 COMAU Racer 3 上构建了 TRL 4 的演示系统，但仍处于实验室基础阶段，尚未完成与物理策略改进的闭环。

Conclusion: IRR 主张复用机器人已有感知与示范流程，可降低集成成本、提升奖励计算效率、减少持续性人工结果打分，为工业机器人系统从既有数据与经验中持续学习提供可复用的路径。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) systems already bring together two valuable resources for robot learning: rich visual representations and demonstrations of successful task execution. Intrinsic Robot Rewarding (IRR) proposes to use these resources for a second, complementary purpose: evaluating the robot's own outcomes and providing feedback for policy improvement. Successful demonstration endpoints define task-specific references, and the policy's frozen visual encoder provides the feature space in which new outcomes are assessed. The core reward mechanism adds a reference bank and a scoring operation to the existing pipeline, without requiring a separate learned evaluator or an additional perception backbone. Our position is that this reuse offers a promising route to lower integration effort, efficient reward computation, and reduced recurring human outcome scoring. Building on established research in visual rewards and learning from experience, IRR brings these ideas into the robot's existing perception and demonstration pipeline. An operational COMAU Racer 3 demonstrator is available at technology readiness level 4 (TRL 4). This laboratory foundation supports the next research step: connecting internal outcome evaluation to physical policy improvement. We present the reward formulation, central research questions, and an evaluation methodology linking reward reliability to task success and supervision effort. The intended contribution is a reusable approach to learn and improve from the data and experience already available in industrial robot systems.

</details>


### [309] [LOTUSim-Energy: A Maritime Simulator for Human-Drone Interaction in Autonomous Offshore Operation \&amp; Maintenance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17124)
*Juliette Grosset,Marie Dubromel,Hélène Lechêne,Quentin Arzel,Cédric Buche*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 LOTUSim-Energy，一个面向海上运维的多域人-无人机交互实时海事仿真平台，统一异构无人载具、环境力耦合与沉浸式监控界面，并通过多域巡检场景验证其性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海上运维需跨空中、水面、水下多域作业且依赖人工监督，现有仿真工具难以在同一平台内统一异构无人载具、海洋环境扰动与沉浸式人机交互，导致自主性栈验证与海试风险居高不下。

Method: 构建分布式架构的实时仿真平台，统一 UAV、USV、AUV、ROV 四类异构无人载具；耦合风、浪、流等环境力；提供桌面与虚拟现实沉浸式监控界面；集成分层物理仿真、能量感知电池建模与故障检测模块；并建立结构化海上任务库以支持可重复的自主性栈评估。

Result: 在单桩与过渡段结构的多域巡检场景中开展系统级验证，评估了航点跟踪插件与基于 AIS 参考轨迹跟踪的可靠性，并进行实时能量监控，表明平台可稳定运行多域协同仿真任务。

Conclusion: 通过融合统一环境物理、异构载具仿真与沉浸式监督，LOTUSim-Energy 为海上人-机器人协作工作流的原型开发与演练提供了集成测试平台，有助于降低海上部署风险。

Abstract: Offshore maintenance requires operations in the air, the surface, and the subsea domain and include human supervision. This paper presents LOTUSim-Energy, a real-time maritime simulator designed for multi-domain human--drone interaction for offshore operation and maintenance. The plat- form unifies heterogeneous unmanned vehicles (Unmanned Aerial Vehicles: UAVs, Unmanned Surface Vehicles: USVs, Autonomous Underwater Vehicles: AUVs, Remotely Operated Vehicles: ROVs) within a distributed architecture coupling environment forcing (wind, waves, currents) and provides immersive user interfaces for supervision (desktop and virtual reality). A structured offshore task library enables repeatable evaluation of autonomy stacks under realistic metocean disturbances. The simulator supports realistic physics, energy-aware battery modeling, and fault-detection pipelines as modular validation tools. System-level performance is demonstrated on a multi-domain inspection scenario for monopile and transition piece structure, where we evaluate the reliability of integrated waypoint-follower plugin and Automatic Identification System (AIS)-referenced trajectory tracking under real-time energy monitoring. By combining unified environmental physics, heterogeneous vehicle simulation, and immersive supervision, LOTUSim-Energy provides an integration testbed for prototyping and rehearsing offshore human--robot collaboration workflows, as a step toward de-risking sea deployment.

</details>


### [310] [Continual Learning for Traversability Prediction with Uncertainty-Aware Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17141)
*Hojin Lee,Yunho Lee,Daniel A Duecker,Cheolhyeon Kwon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种基于生成式经验回放的持续学习框架，用于非结构化环境下的可通行性预测，实现无需存储旧数据、具备不确定性感知的增量地形自适应，并缓解灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非结构化环境中机器人-地形交互复杂且不确定，易导致牵引力丧失与动态失稳，可通行性预测至关重要。现有基于学习的方法难以适应新地形；即便实现适应，也难以保留旧环境经验，即灾难性遗忘问题。

Method: 提出面向可通行性预测的持续学习框架，利用生成式经验回放模型增量适应新地形。核心特性有二：其一，在不存储历史数据的前提下保留既往经验；其二，将回放模型生成样本的不确定性纳入考量，实现不确定性感知的自适应。

Result: 采用滑移转向机器人的真实世界实验验证了框架有效性，表明其能够在多种不同环境中连续自适应，同时缓解灾难性遗忘。

Conclusion: 该生成式经验回放持续学习框架可在不存储旧数据的情况下实现跨多样地形的可通行性预测自适应，并有效抑制灾难性遗忘，为自主导航在非结构化环境中的长期部署提供可行方案。

Abstract: Traversability prediction is a critical component of autonomous navigation in unstructured environments, where complex and uncertain robot-terrain interactions pose significant challenges such as traction loss and dynamic instability. Despite recent progress in learning-based traversability prediction, these methods often fail to adapt to novel terrains. Even when adaptation is achieved, retaining experience from previously trained environments remains a challenge, a problem known as catastrophic forgetting. To address this challenge, we propose a continual learning framework for traversability prediction that incrementally adapts to new terrains using a generative experience recall model. A key virtue of the proposed framework is two folds: i) retain prior experience without storing past data; and ii) incorporate the uncertainty of the generated samples from the recall model, enabling uncertainty-aware adaptation. Real-world experiments with a skid-steering robot validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, demonstrating its ability to adapt across a series of diverse environments while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

</details>


### [311] [LiLi: Lie Theory Based 3D LiDAR Scan Alignment Degeneracy Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17145)
*Vsevolod Hulchuk,Jan Bayer,Jan Faigl*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出LiLi，一种基于李理论的方法，用于在退化场景（如直走廊、平坦田野）中检测3D LiDAR扫描配准的完整退化变换集合，通过在SE(3)上施加扰动并比较优化位姿实现鲁棒检测，显著降低配准误差并提升定位性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在直走廊或平坦田野等退化场景中，3D LiDAR扫描配准的解不唯一，会损害定位与建图精度。现有退化检测方法忽略了重新关联数据点的可能性，因而对噪声和复杂退化敏感。

Method: 提出LiLi方法，利用李理论识别SE(3)李群中刚性变换的完整退化变换集合。方法对优化解施加扰动，并比较由此得到的优化位姿，以保证退化的鲁棒检测；借助李代数se(3)的生成元，提供描述退化变换集合的系统化途径。

Result: 在合成数据上的定量评估显示，相比最先进的基于Hessian的方法，配准误差降低50%，在含噪声数据集上改进更显著。在真实退化数据集上，集成该方法的LiDAR里程计在260米长轨迹上定位性能优于基于Hessian退化检测器的参考方案，并在430米长的往返隧道轨迹上成功，而参考方案失败。

Conclusion: LiLi通过李理论系统描述退化变换集合，实现了更鲁棒、更精确的退化检测，在合成与真实场景中均优于基于Hessian的现有方法，提升了退化环境下的LiDAR里程计定位性能。

Abstract: In this paper, we study 3D LiDAR scan alignment in challenging scenarios with degeneracies, such as straight corridors or flat fields, where the alignment solution is not unique and compromises localization and mapping accuracy. Existing degeneracy detection methods that neglect the potential for reassociating data points are prone to being sensitive to noise and complex degeneracies. Therefore, we propose LiLi - a novel method that leverages Lie theory to identify the full set of degenerate transformations within the SE(3) Lie group of rigid transformations. The method employs perturbations of the optimized solution and compares the resulting optimized poses to ensure robust detection of degeneracies. By leveraging generators from the Lie algebra se(3), the method provides a systematic approach to describing the set of degenerate transformations. Quantitative evaluations on synthetic data show significant improvement over the state-of-the-art Hessian-based method, reducing alignment error by 50%, with more significant improvements for datasets featuring noise. In the real-world degenerate datasets, the proposed method integrated into LiDAR-based odometry yields superior localization performance compared to the reference solution based on the Hessian-based degeneracy detector on a 260 m long trajectory, and succeeds on a 430 m long round-trip tunnel trajectory where the reference fails.

</details>


### [312] [Kernel-Based Metrics Learning for Uncertain Opponent Vehicle Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Racing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17147)
*Hojin Lee,Youngim Nam,Sanghun Lee,Cheolhyeon Kwon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出异构核度量用于深度核学习（DKL），以无监督方式区分对手车辆不同驾驶策略，实现精确轨迹预测及不确定性估计，从而支撑自主赛车安全超车。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主赛车中对手车辆（OVs）轨迹不确定，因其驾驶策略未知，安全超车面临重大挑战，传统方法难以稳健捕捉多样驾驶策略并给出可靠预测。

Method: 为深度核学习设计异构核度量，基于自车（EV）与OV的观测交互，以无监督方式对齐相似驾驶策略、分离不同策略，并进行轨迹预测与不确定性量化。

Result: 在1/10比例赛车平台上开展实验，预测精度提升，能够安全超越对手车辆；方法对车载计算单元计算高效，适用于快速赛车场景。

Conclusion: 所提异构核度量DKL方法可稳健建模未知驾驶策略的对手车辆，兼具预测精度与计算效率，验证了其在自主赛车超车任务中的可行性。

Abstract: Autonomous racing confronts significant challenges in safely overtaking Opponent Vehicles (OVs) that exhibit uncertain trajectories, stemming from unknown driving policies. To address these challenges, this study proposes heterogeneous kernel metrics for Deep Kernel Learning (DKL), designed to robustly capture the diverse driving policies of OVs, and carry out precise trajectory predictions along with the associated uncertainties. A key virtue of the proposed kernel metrics lies in their ability to align similar driving policies and disjoin dissimilar ones in an unsupervised manner, given the observed interactions between the Ego Vehicle (EV) and OVs. The efficacy of the proposed method is substantiated through experimental studies on a 1/10th scale racecar platform, demonstrating improved prediction accuracy and thereby safely overtaking against OVs. Furthermore, our method is computationally efficient for onboard computing units, affirming its viability in fast-paced racing environments. The video and source code can be found at https://github.com/HMCL-UNIST/OpponentPredictionWithKMDKL.git.

</details>


### [313] [HuMemSLAM: Efficient Human-Inspired Semantic Place Recognition for Robust Visual SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17168)
*Mayowa Adebambo,Sebastian Donnelly,Armand Amaritei,Andrew Bradley,Alexander Rast*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 HuMem-VPR 视觉位置识别方法及其与 ORB-SLAM3 的集成 HuMemSLAM，在保持高检索精度的同时显著降低延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主系统的 SLAM 需要可靠的位置识别。传统几何视觉 SLAM 依赖低层特征与几何一致性，易受感知混淆（不同地点外观相似）与感知变化（同一地点外观不同）影响；语义 SLAM 与现代学习式 VPR 虽提升鲁棒性，但实时部署同时要求高检索精度与低延迟。

Method: 受人类记忆与感知启发，提出 HuMem-VPR，利用自下而上的感知证据与自上而下的上下文推理之间的双向关系实现高层地点理解；并进一步将 HuMem-VPR 与 ORB-SLAM3 集成，形成 HuMemSLAM。

Result: HuMem-VPR 在真实图像基准上取得最高综合检索精度，在 CARLA 基准上精度具竞争力，延迟约为所评估 SOTA VPR 方法的 1/2 至 1/3；在多个数据集族与在线实验中，HuMemSLAM 相比 ORB-SLAM3 原生检索显著提升集成 Recall@1，同时减少了提交给几何后端的候选数量。

Conclusion: 双向感知—上下文推理机制可兼顾 VPR 的精度与效率，并可有效增强 ORB-SLAM3 的位置识别与后端负载。

Abstract: Autonomous systems require reliable place recognition for efficient and effective simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM). Traditional geometric visual SLAM approaches rely on low-level features and geometric consistency, but remain vulnerable to perceptual aliasing, where different places appear similar, and perceptual variation, where the same place appears different. Although semantic SLAM and modern learned visual place recognition (VPR) methods improve robustness under challenging perceptual conditions, real-time deployment requires both high retrieval accuracy and low latency. Inspired by human memory and perception, we propose HuMem-VPR, which exploits the bidirectional relationship between bottom-up perceptual evidence and top-down contextual reasoning to achieve high-level place understanding. We further introduce HuMemSLAM, the integration of HuMem-VPR with ORB-SLAM3. HuMem VPR achieved the highest aggregate retrieval accuracy on the real-image benchmark, competitive accuracy on the CARLA benchmark, and approximately two to three times lower latency than the evaluated state-of-the-art VPR methods. Across the evaluated dataset families and online experiments, HuMemSLAM substantially improved integrated Recall @1 over ORB-SLAM3's native retrieval while reducing the proposals submitted to its geometric backend.

</details>


### [314] [Fingers as Legs: Learning Self-Supported Locomotion and Manipulation with an Anthropomorphic Hand](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17172)
*Amirhossein Kazemipour,Hehui Zheng,Robert Katzschmann*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究展示了一只仿人手如何在不改变手指设计与位置控制器的情况下，通过学习将手指同时用于移动、支撑体重与环境交互，实现无缆爬行、转向、摔倒恢复与推物等任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统移动机械手通常需要独立 locomotion 机构，而人手式平台希望复用同一套手指同时承担移动与操作，面临手指不对称、控制与供电集成及 reward 设计等挑战。

Method: 采用强化学习训练，针对手指不对称性建模；在基于硬件测量校准的仿真器中训练，并提出适配该手的 reward 公式；将任务特定策略迁移至带板载电源与计算的自包含硬件平台。

Result: 仿真中该 reward 公式使手部移动速度快于为四足机器人调优的 reward；硬件上实现无缆爬行、转向和摔倒恢复，并在支撑自身重量时无视觉执行键盘命令，以及利用俯视视觉反馈将物体推向目标。

Conclusion: 结果表明可构建紧凑型移动操作器，复用其手指完成移动与交互，而无需单独的移动机构。

Abstract: A walking robotic hand must use the same fingers to move its body, support its weight, and interact with the environment. We show how an anthropomorphic hand can learn these skills while retaining its finger design and position controller. Onboard power and computation make the platform self-contained. Our reinforcement learning approach accounts for the hand's unequal fingers, with training in a simulator calibrated from hardware measurements. In simulation, the hand moves faster with our reward formulation than with tuned rewards originally designed for quadrupeds. On hardware, task-specific policies enable untethered crawling, steering, and fall recovery. While supporting its own weight, the hand also executes successive keyboard commands without vision and pushes an object to targets using overhead visual feedback. These results demonstrate a compact mobile manipulator that reuses its fingers for locomotion and interaction, without a separate locomotion mechanism.

</details>


### [315] [Fleet-To-Lab: A Transfer Learning Framework For Lunar Rover Slippage Estimation Via Model Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17187)
*Riccardo Viviano,Saki Omi,Andrej Orsula,Miguel Olivares-Mendez*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Fleet-to-Lab迁移学习框架与AcoMerge混合群智优化算法，通过融合异构月球车专家模型缓解地月域差，在高保真物理仿真中实现优于深度模型融合基线的平衡准确率与macro-F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确的车轮打滑估计对自主月球车移动与导航至关重要，但基于地球数据训练的机器学习模型难以泛化到月球地形，而真实月球数据因任务数量有限、采集成本高昂而极度稀缺。因此需要一种能够在数据受限条件下跨越地月域差的迁移学习方案。

Method: 提出Fleet-to-Lab迁移学习框架，利用此前部署的异构月球车所采集的本体感知（proprioceptive）数据，缓解未来可部署单元滑移估计中的地球—月球域差；将多个异构专家模型融合为单一架构，并仅使用部署后采集的小规模数据集。进一步提出AcoMerge——一种混合群智（swarm-intelligence）算法，通过在专家参数空间中搜索最优组合实现模型融合。

Result: 在高保真物理仿真实验中，该方法相比深度模型融合基线在平衡准确率（balanced accuracy）和macro-F1上均有提升；AcoMerge在较小模型规模下达到与深度架构联合训练相当的竞争力，并获得更高的macro-F1与平衡准确率。

Conclusion: 模型融合可作为数据受限的空间机器人任务中滑移估计的一种可行迁移学习替代方案。

Abstract: Accurate wheel slip estimation is essential for autonomous lunar rover mobility and navigation. Machine Learning models trained on terrestrial data generalize poorly to lunar terrain, and real lunar datasets are scarce due to the limited number of missions and costly data acquisition. We present Fleet-to-Lab, a transfer learning framework that leverages proprioceptive data collected by previously deployed heterogeneous lunar rovers to mitigate the Earth-Moon domain gap in slip estimation for a future deployable unit. We fuse several heterogeneous expert models into a single architecture, using a modest dataset collected after the rover deployment. We propose AcoMerge, a new hybrid swarm-intelligence algorithm that performs model fusion by searching for an optimal combi- nation of expert parameters. Experiments conducted in a high- fidelity physics simulation show balanced accuracy and macro- F1 improvements compared to deep model fusion baselines. AcoMerge exhibits competitive performance with joint training on deep architectures, while achieving higher macro-F1 and balanced accuracy on a smaller model. Overall, our framework shows model fusion as a possible transfer learning alternative for slippage estimation in space robotic missions with limited data.

</details>


### [316] [TIO-Former: Ultra-Lightweight 6-Directional ToF-Inertial Odometry for Nano-UAVs via a Streaming Causal Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17198)
*Yang Liu,Yifan He,Wenhao Zhao,Xiangyu Mo,Yang Xu,Hao Wei,Mingze Ma,Huan Li,Yifan Wu,Zipeng Dai,Xin Zhou,Fei Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 TIO-FORMER，一种无相机、无光流、无地图的测距-惯性里程计框架，仅用 IMU 与 15 g 的六个正交 8×8 ToF 阵列实现 nano-UAV 的 6-DoF 自运动估计，并在真实飞行中显著降低开环位置误差，同时在 RISC-V 边缘计算平台上保持低延迟与低内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主 nano-UAV 导航需在严格 SWaP-C 约束下进行精确自运动估计：视觉与 LiDAR 超出载荷限制，光流在低纹理场景退化，纯惯性估计存在累积漂移。多区域 ToF 阵列虽轻量且具度量信息，但单帧仅 384 个测距值，面临无效回波、各向异性可观测性与时序计算随飞行时长扩展等挑战。

Method: 采用 IMU 与六个正交 8×8 ToF 阵列（总重 15 g）作为输入。前端对相邻测距栅格执行双边门控差分；IMU 引导的交叉注意力根据平台运动学动态路由方向特征；流式因果 Transformer 将未压缩 Local KV 缓存与压缩 Chunk-FIFO 记忆耦合，使推理成本与内存占用不随飞行时长增长。

Result: 真实飞行评估中，开环位置误差较 nano-UAV 光流降低 54.4%，较学习型惯性基线降低 66.4%–89.1%；并在多环境与严重传感退化下验证鲁棒性。部署于边缘 RISC-V 协处理器时，P95 延迟 10.466 ms，峰值常驻内存 6.324 MiB（低于系统 RAM 的 5%）。

Conclusion: 稀疏测距感知可为资源受限的微型空中机器人提供实用的几何锚定，TIO-FORMER 在 SWaP-C 严苛条件下实现了实时、低内存的 6-DoF 测距-惯性里程计。代码已开源。

Abstract: Autonomous nano-UAV navigation requires accurate ego-motion estimation under stringent size, weight, power, and computing (SWaP-C) constraints, where visual sensors and LiDARs exceed payload limits, optical flow degrades in low-texture scenes, and inertial-only state estimation is susceptible to accumulated drift. While multi-zone time-of-flight (ToF) arrays provide a lightweight metric complement, 6-DoF estimation from merely 384 ranges per frame is challenged by invalid returns, anisotropic observability, and temporal computational scaling. We propose TIO-FORMER, a camera-free, optical-flow-free, and mapless range-inertial odometry framework driven by an IMU and an ultra-lightweight (15 g) payload of six orthogonal 8 x 8 ToF arrays. Our frontend pairs consecutive range grids with a bilateral gated difference, while IMU-guided cross-attention dynamically routes directional features conditioned on platform kinematics. A Streaming Causal Transformer couples an uncompressed Local KV cache with compressed Chunk-FIFO memory, maintaining bounded inference cost and memory footprint independent of flight duration. In real-flight evaluations, TIO-FORMER reduces open-loop position error by 54.4% compared to nano-UAV optical flow and by 66.4%-89.1% over learned inertial baselines. We also evaluate performance across multiple environments and robustness under severe sensing degradation. Deployed on an edge RISC-V companion computer, TIO-FORMER achieves a P95 latency of 10.466 ms and peak resident memory of 6.324 MiB (less than 5 percent system RAM), demonstrating that sparse range sensing provides practical geometric anchoring for resource-constrained micro-aerial robots. Code is available at https://github.com/Ly041021/TIO-Former.

</details>


### [317] [FluxVLA Engine: A One-Stop VLA Engineering Platform for Embodied Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17210)
*Yinhao Li,Weixin Mao,Zihan Lan,Jikun Rong,Qirui Hu,Yiming Zhang,Weipeng Deng,Bowen Shen,Minzhao Zhu,Yiming Mao,Yan Yang,Chenguang Cui,Hongyuan Chen,Xu Huang,Zheyi Zhao,Pinxi Shen,Bozhen He,Zhen Fu,Yifan Wang,Zexin Zhang,Ang Gao,Haoyu Chen,Chengqi Shi,Hua Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FluxVLA Engine 是一个开源、配置驱动的平台，通过标准化接口将异构具身策略组件整合为可复现的“数据到部署”工作流，打通离线学习、仿真验证、在线纠错与真机执行，以解决算法到可靠机器人系统之间的工程瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型、世界动作模型（WAM）与离线强化学习正快速拓展具身策略的设计空间，但将这些算法落地为可靠机器人系统仍受制于碎片化的数据格式、训练栈、评测协议、推理运行时与具身接口。论文旨在解决这类工程瓶颈，而非提出新的策略模型。

Method: 平台以配置驱动方式标准化多类接口：数据集、视觉-语言与世界模型、动作头（action heads）、奖励/优势加权学习、分布式训练、仿真评测、优化推理及机器人算子（operators）。集成分体式双臂仿真、可扩展自动数据生成，以及模型解耦的人在回路（human-in-the-loop）接管、纠正数据采集与奖励标注。面向实时物理执行，结合 Real-Time Chunking（RTC）、加速推理后端、轻量级远程 GPU 服务与可配置轨迹后处理。

Result: 通过共享且可审计的契约（contracts），统一连接离线学习、仿真验证、在线纠错与真机执行；代码已开源于 https://github.com/FluxVLA/FluxVLA。

Conclusion: FluxVLA Engine 以工程化、标准化与可复现性为核心，弥合有前景的具身学习算法与可复现评测、可靠部署之间的鸿沟，为具身策略提供从数据到部署的一体化平台。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models, world-action models (WAMs), and offline reinforcement learning methods are rapidly expanding the design space of embodied policies, yet turning these algorithms into reliable robot systems remains constrained by fragmented data formats, training stacks, evaluation protocols, inference runtimes, and embodiment-specific interfaces. We present $\mathrm{FluxVLA}$ Engine, an open, configuration-driven platform that turns heterogeneous embodied-policy components into a reproducible data-to-deployment workflow. Rather than introducing another policy model, $\mathrm{FluxVLA}$ standardizes interfaces for datasets, visual-language and world models, action heads, reward- or advantage-weighted learning, distributed training, simulation evaluation, optimized inference, and robot operators. The engine further integrates compositional dual-arm simulation, scalable automatic data generation, and model-decoupled human-in-the-loop rollout, takeover, correction collection, and reward annotation. For responsive physical execution, it combines Real-Time Chunking (RTC) with accelerated inference backends, lightweight remote GPU serving, and configurable trajectory post-processing. Together, these capabilities connect offline learning, simulation validation, online correction, and real-robot execution through shared and auditable contracts. $\mathrm{FluxVLA}$ therefore targets the engineering bottlenecks separating promising embodied-learning algorithms from reproducible evaluation and dependable deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/FluxVLA/FluxVLA

</details>


### [318] [Swim-and-Breach at Palm Scale: A Rudder-Steered Two-Propeller Underwater Robot Platform with Differential-Thrust Pitch Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17240)
*Daehyun Choi,Ian Bergerson,Hengjia Zhu,Tianjun Lan,Saad Bhamla*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种手掌大小（65 mm、34 g）的水陆两用"游泳-跃出"机器人平台，通过双螺旋桨推进与差分推力俯仰控制、尾舵偏航控制，实现高速游动（13.9 BL/s）与无缝巡航-跳跃-巡航运动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为实现小型机器人在溪流、洪水结构及工业系统等场景中的巡检，需要能够跨越水池间障碍与干燥间隙的平台，因此需设计兼具高速游动与跃出水面能力的小尺度机器人。

Method: 采用两个垂直堆叠的螺旋桨提供推进及差分推力俯仰控制（PID闭环），尾部舵面提供偏航控制；通过流场仿真优化壳体以降低阻力，并用B系列（B-series）螺旋桨建模结合测力计验证进行螺旋桨优化。

Result: 经流场仿真评估的壳体相较于等效长方体阻力降低五倍；当前机器人游速达13.9体长/秒，转向速率209度/秒，达到水下机器人的报道上限；自由游动时俯仰回路可将机体转至任意指令抬头角度，在尾舵稳定出水条件下，实现跳跃高度1.6体长、距离3.7体长，且为无缝的巡航-跳跃-巡航序列。

Conclusion: 该平台可用于构建跨越障碍与水池间干燥间隙的小尺度机器人，适用于溪流、洪水结构和工业系统的巡检应用。

Abstract: We present a palm-scale (65 mm, 34 g) swim-and-breach robot platform. Two vertically stacked propellers provide both propulsion and differential-thrust pitch control under a proportional-integral-derivative (PID) loop, and a tail rudder adds yaw control. The hull, evaluated by flow simulation, reduces the drag five-fold relative to an equivalent cuboid, and the propellers are optimized using B-series modeling validated by dynamometer measurements. The current robot swims at 13.9 body lengths per second and turns at 209 deg per second, corresponding to the upper limits reported for underwater robots. In free swimming, the pitch loop turns the body to any commanded nose-up pitch angle, and, with the rudder stabilizing the exit, the current robot leaps 1.6 body lengths high and 3.7 long in a seamless cruise-leap-cruise sequence. The platform can be used to build small-scale robots that cross barriers and dry gaps between pools for inspection in streams, flooded structures, and industrial systems.

</details>


### [319] [DriveMCP: An Agentic AI framework for Advanced Driver Assistance System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17247)
*Farzad Nadiri,Mehdi Cina,Ahmad B. Rad*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出DriveMCP，一个模块化、可审计的智能体驾驶辅助框架，将感知、合规推理、车辆状态解释与安全仲裁整合为统一流水线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）驾驶辅助方案在合规性、可解释性与安全性上存在不足，且常依赖模拟器地面真值注入合规信息，缺乏真实场景的推理能力与安全仲裁机制。

Method: 以DriveLM作为视觉语言前端生成图结构场景理解（GVQA）与语言化驾驶信息，通过结构化解析层提取限速与司法管辖线索等world_state要素；由状态化编排层协调三类以MCP服务器形式暴露的专家：基于RAG的交通法规与标志规范合规推理Rules服务器、估计牵引风险与速度建议的Weather服务器、提供CAN/OBD遥测与诊断上下文的MCP-CAN服务器；融合输出生成结构化决策，再经RSS启发的护栏在有限在线自适应下仲裁"提示"与"执行"。

Result: 在CARLA仿真中的多语言、跨境及动态限速场景下，DriveMCP相较VLM-Direct、VLM-Direct+RAG、VLM-Tools-NoArbiter基线降低了交通违规与超速，改善了危险响应时间，并保持亚秒级建议延迟。

Conclusion: DriveMCP验证了模块化多专家智能体架构结合合规推理与RSS护栏在驾驶辅助中的有效性，可在保证实时性的同时提升合规性与安全性。

Abstract: An agentic AI driver-assistance framework that integrates perception, compliance reasoning, vehicle-state interpretation, and safety arbitration into a modular and auditable pipeline. The architecture, referred to as DriveMCP, incorporates a sensor-like perception stack alongside DriveLM as the vision-language front end to generate a graph-structured scene understanding (Graph Visual Question Answering) and language-grounded driving information. Key compliance elements in world_state, including posted speed limits and jurisdiction cues, are derived from DriveLM outputs through a structured parsing layer rather than being injected as simulator ground truth. A stateful orchestration layer coordinates specialized experts exposed as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers: (i) a Rules server that performs retrieval-augmented compliance reasoning over jurisdiction-specific traffic codes and sign conventions, (ii) a Weather server that estimates traction risk and contextual speed advisories, and (iii) an MCP-CAN server that surfaces Controller Area Network (CAN)/On-Board Diagnostics (OBD) telemetry and diagnostic context for health-aware risk shaping. These outputs are fused to generate a structured decision that prompts a recommended course of action. The outcome is then further filtered by a Responsibility-Sensitive Safety (RSS)-inspired guardrail that arbitrates speak versus act decisions under bounded online adaptation. In CARLA simulation across multilingual, cross-border, and dynamic speed-limit scenarios, DriveMCP reduces traffic infractions and overspeed relative to the VLM-Direct, VLM-Direct+RAG, and VLM-Tools-NoArbiter baselines, while improving hazard response time and maintaining sub-second advisory latency.

</details>


### [320] [Port-Hamiltonian Koopman Operator Synthesis for Mechanical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17249)
*Rajpal Singh,Aditya Singh,Jishnu Keshavan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出基于广义动量坐标的结构保持Koopman框架，通过结构约束神经网络联合学习提升函数与端口Hamilton-Koopman生成元，结合Cayley中点离散化，使所学动力学在构造上被动并精确保持离散储能-耗散平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有限维Koopman模型可实现非线性机器人系统的高效线性预测与控制，但纯轨迹数据学习的模型可能违背底层力学的能量结构，导致预测出现人为能量增长并在递归传播下发散。

Method: 在广义动量坐标下构建结构保持Koopman框架：动量变换将机械驱动暴露为已知且与状态无关的端口并在提升动力学中显式保留；设计结构约束神经网络联合学习提升函数与端口Hamilton-Koopman生成元，使动力学在构造上被动，而非依赖惩罚项或事后投影；采用Cayley中点离散化在离散时间精确保持储能-耗散平衡。并通过推导离散储能平衡及相应稳定性保证进行解析论证。

Result: 仿真与实验研究显示，相比Koopman基线，该方法在预测精度、数据效率和闭环跟踪方面均有提升，且系统维度越高增益越显著。

Conclusion: 该结构保持Koopman框架从能量结构出发保证被动性与稳定性，为Euler-Lagrange系统提供可靠的线性预测与控制工具，并随系统维度增加展现更大优势。

Abstract: Finite-dimensional Koopman models enable efficient linear prediction and control of nonlinear robotic systems. However, models learned purely from trajectory data may violate the energetic structure of the underlying mechanics, producing predictions that exhibit artificial energy growth and diverge under recursive propagation. This work presents a structure-preserving Koopman framework for Euler-Lagrange systems built on generalized-momentum coordinates. The momentum transformation exposes the mechanical actuation as a known, state-independent port, which is preserved explicitly in the lifted dynamics. A structure-constrained neural architecture is developed to jointly learn the lifting functions and a port-Hamiltonian Koopman generator, rendering the learned dynamics passive by construction rather than through penalty terms or post-hoc projection. A Cayley-midpoint discretization further preserves the corresponding storage-dissipation balance exactly in discrete time. These properties are established analytically by deriving the discrete storage balance and associated stability guarantees of the learned predictor. Simulation and experimental studies demonstrate improved prediction accuracy, data efficiency, and closed-loop tracking over Koopman baselines, with increasing gains for higher-dimensional systems.

</details>


### [321] [CAD-Based Relation Learning and Geometric-Symbolic Planning for Robotic Assembly](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17263)
*Fabian Harlacher,Christian Friedrich*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出混合ASP框架，结合学习式关系抽取与几何-符号推理，从含缺陷CAD数据生成机器人拆解序列，ASAP数据集上成功率85.83%，规划时间降低一个数量级以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 装配序列规划(ASP)具有组合爆炸特性，穷举法在复杂工业装配中不可行；同时许多CAD模型缺乏可靠的语义接触信息或需大量人工预处理，限制了现有方法的适用性。

Method: 神经网络从点云预测语义几何关系，配合人机回环验证纠正不确定预测与规划失败；将关系转化为符号装配图；几何-符号规划器计算局部有效的机器人操作原语集合；基于可见性的光线投射策略引导可行拆解方向搜索，避免穷举组合搜索；局部解空间支持高效序列优化。

Result: 在自建装配数据集与ASAP测试数据集上评估。ASAP上规划成功率达85.83%；中位规划时间在所有装配规模上降低一个数量级以上，对超过30个零件的装配降低50倍以上，同时相对基线显著减少规划时间。

Conclusion: 该混合框架可从含缺陷CAD数据实现高效机器人装配序列规划并大幅缩短规划时间；学习式特征分割、人机回环验证与几何-符号推理的结合，为可扩展、可适配的机器人装配与拆解规划提供了实用基础。

Abstract: Assembly Sequence Planning (ASP) remains a challenging problem due to its combinatorial nature, making exhaustive planning approaches impractical for complex industrial assemblies. Furthermore, many CAD models lack reliable semantic contact information or require extensive manual preprocessing, limiting the applicability of existing methods. This paper presents a hybrid ASP framework combining learning-based relation extraction with geometric-symbolic reasoning to generate feasible robotic disassembly sequences from imperfect CAD data. A neural network predicts semantic geometric relations from point clouds, while human-in-the-loop verification enables correction of uncertain predictions and planning failures. Extracted relations are transformed into a symbolic assembly graph, enabling a geometric-symbolic planner to efficiently compute locally valid sets of robotic manipulation primitives. A visibility-based ray-casting strategy guides the search for feasible disassembly directions without requiring an exhaustive combinatorial search, while the local solution space enables efficient sequence optimization. The framework is evaluated on an introduced assembly dataset and on the ASAP test dataset. On the ASAP test dataset, the proposed planner achieves an 85.83% planning success rate while reducing the median planning time by more than one order of magnitude across all assembly sizes and by more than a factor of 50 for assemblies with more than 30 components compared to the baseline. The results demonstrate that the proposed hybrid framework enables efficient robotic assembly sequence planning from imperfect CAD data while substantially reducing planning time. By combining learning-based feature segmentation, human-in-the-loop verification, and geometric-symbolic reasoning, the framework provides a practical foundation for scalable and adaptable robotic assembly and disassembly planning.

</details>


### [322] [Escape-Aware Control Barrier Functions for Quadrotor Safety under Body-Rate Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17292)
*Lei Shi,Haosong Wen,Qichao Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文揭示输入受限系统上仅依赖状态的障碍函数存在"认证缺口",并提出基于状态-输入增广对的逃逸障碍函数,可闭式求解最大可认证接近速度,嵌入预测控制器后在四旋翼上实现全部场景成功。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 输入受限系统的控制障碍函数虽将容许输入集纳入安全集定义,但所得障碍几乎总是仅状态函数。在四旋翼上这并非表面问题:推力矢量必须先重新定向才能减速接近,而重定向受可达机体角速度限制,因此仅状态障碍会认证那些实际上已无法及时逃逸的状态。

Method: 以闭式刻画该认证缺口,证明其宽度正比于接近速度、反比于机体角速度上限;在"状态+上一步施加输入"的增广对上定义逃逸障碍,逃逸权限以单步可达推力上限度量;给出闭式解及最大可认证接近速度的解析逆;并将其嵌入预测控制器,不增加额外状态开销。

Result: 在13状态四旋翼的550组配对闭环实验中,所提控制器完成所有测试场景;同视野内的停止距离障碍在恰好进入预测缺口的两个场景中分别失败15%和25%。相比在到达状态处施加同一逃逸条件的在线备份CBF基线,方向裕度大29–74度,净空为其3–18倍;独立保守 rollout 裁判未发现任何逃逸失败的已认证状态。

Conclusion: 仅状态障碍函数在输入受限(尤其欠驱动、速率受限)系统中会给出过度乐观的安全认证;通过状态-输入增广构造逃逸障碍并给出可认证接近速度的解析界,可在不增加状态维度代价下闭合该认证缺口,并在四旋翼实验中验证其有效性与保守性。

Abstract: Control barrier functions for input-constrained systems place the admissible input set inside the definition of the safe set, yet the resulting barrier is almost always a function of the state alone; On a quadrotor this is not cosmetic: because the thrust vector must be reoriented before it can decelerate an approach, and reorientation is limited by the attainable body rate, a state-only barrier certifies states from which no escape is reachable in time; We characterize the certification gap in closed form and show its width is proportional to closing speed and inversely proportional to the body-rate limit; We then define an escape barrier on the augmented pair of state and previously applied input, with escape authority measured over the one-step reachable thrust cap; It admits a closed form and an analytic inverse for the maximum certifiable closing speed, and embeds in a predictive controller at no additional state cost; Across 550 paired closed-loop episodes on a 13-state quadrotor, the proposed controller completes every tested scenario, whereas the stopping-distance barrier enforced over the same horizon fails 15% and 25% of episodes in exactly the two scenarios that enter the predicted gap; Against an online backup-CBF baseline enforcing the same escape condition at the reached state, it holds a 29-74 degree larger directional margin and 3-18 times the clearance, and an independent conservative rollout referee finds no certified state from which escape fails.

</details>


### [323] [Online Geometric Change Detection via Scene Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17302)
*David Thorne,Samuel Jia Cong Chua,Nakul Joshi,Aiden Wong,Christa S. Robison,Philip Osteen,Brett T. Lopez*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CDSD框架，通过场景分解与子图比较实现基于LiDAR/RGB-D的在线几何变化检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主机器人在动态环境中执行长时程任务时，需识别倒树、门被打开等环境变化以支持在线规划；但现有方法比较全局地图计算代价高，且无法支持单会话在线变化检测。

Method: CDSD将已建图环境空间分解为唯一场景，通过比较全局地图的稠密局部子集（submaps）高效检测变化；针对四个核心挑战提出解决方案：1) 识别冗余信息最少的合适场景；2) 为每个场景生成稠密且具代表性的子图；3) 检测视场不同的子图间变化；4) 处理检测到的变化以实现实时地图重建。

Result: 在Maryland州Graces Quarters的Army Research Laboratory facility采集的自定义数据集及开源多会话变化检测数据集上验证了算法。

Conclusion: CDSD作为首个基于子图的几何变化检测方法，实现了高效、准确的在线变化检测，适用于单会话与多会话场景。

Abstract: Autonomous robots are increasingly deployed on long duration single- and multi-session missions in dynamic environments, where the ability to identify environmental changes such as fallen trees or opened doors provides important contextual information for online planning. We propose a framework called Change Detection via Scene Decomposition (CDSD) for accurate online geometric change detection using LiDAR or RGB-D sensors. Recent advances in geometric SLAM have made it possible to generate dense, tightly aligned maps without post processing, but comparing global maps across entire sessions is computationally expensive and does not allow for single-session online change detection. CDSD instead spatially decomposes mapped environments into unique scenes where changes can be found efficiently by comparing dense, local subsets of the global map called submaps. As the first submap-based approach for geometric change detection, we identify and address the following core challenges: 1) identifying appropriate scenes for change detection that require minimal redundant information; 2) generating dense and representative submaps for each scene; 3) detecting changes between submaps with differing fields of view; and 4) processing detected changes for real-time map reconstruction. Results demonstrate our algorithm on custom datasets collected at the Army Research Laboratory facility in Graces Quarters, Maryland, and on open-source multi-session change detection datasets.

</details>


### [324] [XPACE: Joint World and Action Modeling from Heterogeneous Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17372)
*Jiacheng Wei,Jerry Bai,Xiaoyu Yue,Zidong Wang,Xiaoyang Guo,Cheng Chen,Fanqi Pu,Fan Wu,Zhixu Yue,Yizhuo Li,Feng Qiu,Bo Liu,Yuying Ge,Hui Zhou,Chenyi Chen,Yixiao Ge*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出XPACE统一具身世界模型，兼具"世界动作模型"与"世界模拟器"双重功能，通过共享视频主干、异构数据训练与自生成恢复数据，实现机器人策略的鲁棒性提升与自我改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用机器人需综合多样经验、选择动作并预测动作后果。核心问题是：如何将异质（无动作标签视频、有人/机器人示范）经验连接起来用于动作学习，并在此基础上生成新经验以持续改进策略。

Method: XPACE为统一具身世界模型：(1) 双角色——世界动作模型（联合预测可执行动作与未来视频）与世界模拟器（预测给定动作的视觉后果）；(2) 策略与模拟器共享视频主干，用无动作标签视频学习视觉动力学，用有动作标签的人与机器人示范联合学习视频与动作预测；(3) 粗到细训练课程，逐步侧重机器人控制同时保留人类经验；(4) 利用模拟器适配自生成上下文，在专家示范周围合成"偏离-恢复"轨迹，经筛选后微调策略。

Result: 在XPENG IRON人形机器人上：异构训练提升了鲁棒性，并实现将人类观测到的技能迁移到机器人示范中缺失的任务；由模型自身模拟器生成的恢复数据进一步提升了真实世界任务完成率。

Conclusion: 联合世界建模与动作建模能够把"从异构经验学习"与"模拟驱动的策略自我改进"连接起来，构成统一的具身学习范式。

Abstract: A general-purpose robot needs to draw on diverse experience, choose actions, and anticipate how those actions will change the world. We introduce XPACE, a unified embodied world model that serves as both a world action model, jointly predicting executable robot actions and future video, and a world simulator, predicting the visual consequences of prescribed actions. Our key insight is that video prediction can both connect heterogeneous experience to action learning and generate new experience for policy improvement. With a shared video backbone between the policy and simulator, we use action-unlabeled video to learn visual dynamics and action-labeled human and robot demonstrations to jointly learn video and action prediction. Building on this architecture, a coarse-to-fine training curriculum progressively emphasizes robot control while retaining human experience, allowing the policy to learn behaviors beyond those covered by robot demonstrations. Beyond learning from recorded experience, XPACE uses its simulator to create additional recovery supervision for the policy. Specifically, we adapt the simulator to its own generated context, synthesize deviation-recovery trajectories around expert demonstrations, and fine-tune the policy on filtered recovery examples. Experiments on XPENG's IRON humanoid robot show that heterogeneous training improves robustness and enables transfer of human-observed skills to tasks absent from robot demonstrations, while recovery data generated by the model's own simulator further improves real-world task completion. Together, these results demonstrate how joint world and action modeling connects learning from heterogeneous experience with simulation-driven policy self-improvement.

</details>


### [325] [Exact Fusion and Coordinated Exploration in Multi-Robot Active Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17384)
*Peng Wu,Mohsen Imani,Amidu Kamara,Md Tamzeed Islam,Seyede Fatemeh Ghoreishi,Mahdi Imani*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文指出现有机器人团队共享信念规划中存在两处"共同先验被重复计数"的错误：融合时局部后验之积将共同先验计入n次，规划时各机器人基于同一信念评估计划导致团队收敛到同一未知量。作者通过向共享自然参数添加证据增量（融合时为已实现增量，规划时为期望增量）来修正，证明修正后增益之和等于联合增益、消除的冗余等于计划观测流的总相关、序贯承诺保持1/2贪心保证，并在实验中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习共同环境模型的机器人团队通过交换信念摘要并依据动作的期望信息增益进行规划，但在共轭指数族信念下，共享信念在融合点与规划点各被重复计数一次，导致探索冗余与规划偏差。论文旨在识别并修正这两处系统性错误。

Method: 在共轭指数族信念框架下，向共享自然参数添加证据增量：融合时添加已实现增量，规划时添加期望增量。对期望增量进行理论分析，给出高斯信念（固定采样路径）与Dirichlet信念（离散主动推断的新颖性近似）下的精确形式，并给出团队目标的闭式凹形式及其与精确互信息之间显式界；对有限假设类给出短精确枚举替代方案。结合序贯承诺机制保持1/2贪心保证。

Result: 修正后的增益之和等于联合增益；消除的冗余等于计划观测流的总相关；序贯承诺保持1/2贪心保证。期望增量对高斯信念与Dirichlet信念精确，在有限假设类上失效。在协作RockSample、觅食与野外监测实验中：融合修正不改变探索冗余，预期证据消除冗余，序贯承诺以团队规模的线性代价恢复集中式联合规划的大部分价值。

Conclusion: 通过证据增量修正共同先验的重复计数，可消除融合与规划两处的冗余，理论上桥接分布式与集中式规划，并在多机器人协作任务中以线性代价逼近集中式联合规划的性能。

Abstract: Robot teams that learn a common environment model exchange belief summaries and plan by the expected information gain of their actions. Under conjugate exponential-family beliefs the shared belief is counted once per robot at two points: at fusion, the product of local posteriors counts the common prior $n$ times, and at planning, every robot scores its plan under the same belief and the team converges on the same unknown. Both errors are removed by adding evidence increments to the shared natural parameter, realized increments at fusion and expected increments at planning. The expected increment of a committed teammate gives the next robot its conditional gain; corrected gains sum to the joint gain, the redundancy removed equals the total correlation of the planned observation streams, and sequential commitment keeps the $1/2$ greedy guarantee. The expected increment is exact for Gaussian beliefs with fixed sampling paths and for Dirichlet beliefs under the novelty approximation of discrete active inference, whose team objective has a closed concave form within an explicit bound of the exact mutual information, and fails for finite hypothesis classes, where a short exact enumeration replaces it. Experiments on cooperative RockSample, foraging, and field monitoring show that fusion correction leaves exploration redundancy unchanged, anticipated evidence removes it, and sequential commitment recovers most of the value of centralized joint planning at cost linear in the team size.

</details>


### [326] [Residual Fault Adaptation for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation Under Runtime Joint Faults](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17404)
*Linan Deng,Xing Liu,Lin Hong,Feng Hua,Guijun Ma,Zuogong Yue,Fumin Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出残差故障适应（RFA）框架，通过冻结健康教师与循环残差策略补偿隐藏的命令通道故障，仿真与真机实验验证其提升操作性能并支持零样本部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧手手内操作需多关节协同控制，运行时的关节故障会突发性地破坏成功操作所需的接触构型，而现有控制器缺乏对隐藏命令通道故障的补偿能力。

Method: RFA以冻结的健康教师提供名义行为，训练循环残差策略从本体感知与命令响应历史中推断纠正动作；训练时采用故障注入域随机化（FIDR）改变故障模式、受影响关节、严重程度与发生时刻，并用自适应采样提高近期表现较差故障模式的采样频率；此外冻结一个Direct FIDR策略，仅在故障激活训练样本上提供分布参考，部署时不使用。

Result: 在灵巧手上的仿真实验表明，在固定混合故障协议下RFA相较健康策略提升了操作性能；软件注入故障的真机实验进一步验证了所学适应策略的零样本部署。

Conclusion: RFA能够在无故障标签、无控制器切换信号的条件下实现隐藏命令通道故障的在线补偿，具备从仿真到真机的零样本迁移能力。

Abstract: Dexterous in-hand manipulation requires coordinated control of multiple actuated joints, and a runtime joint fault can abruptly disrupt the contact configuration required for successful manipulation. In this work, we propose residual fault adaptation (RFA), a teacher-anchored framework for compensating for hidden command-channel faults. RFA retains a frozen healthy teacher to provide nominal behavior and trains a recurrent residual policy to infer corrective actions from proprioceptive and command-response history. During training, fault-injection domain randomization (FIDR) varies the fault mode, affected joint, severity, and onset time, while adaptive sampling increases the frequency of fault modes associated with lower recent performance. A frozen Direct FIDR policy provides a distributional reference only on fault-active training samples and is absent from deployment. The deployed controller receives neither fault labels nor controller-switching signals. Simulation experiments on the dexterous hand indicate that RFA can improve manipulation performance relative to the healthy policy under a fixed mixed-fault protocol. Real-robot experiments with software-injected faults further demonstrate zero-shot deployment of the learned adaptation policy.

</details>


### [327] [Optimized Wrench Polytope Analysis for Real-Time Stability Control of Legged Robots in Complex Multi-Contact Configurations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17405)
*Friedrich Graaf,Elias Birkefeld,Christian Eichmann,Elias Hofele,Tristan Schnell,Georg Heppner,Arne Roennau,Rüdiger Dillmann*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种优化算法，可快速计算任意接触场景下腿式机器人的全驱动可行力螺旋多面体（actuatable wrench polytope），单次计算耗时满足49 Hz控制频率，从而实现实时稳定性控制，并在仿真与实体机器人上验证了其在斜坡、洞穴、脚手架等复杂地形上的优越稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腿式机器人虽已广泛应用于现实场景，但在斜坡、洞穴、脚手架等难以通行的地形上仍面临巨大挑战。现有控制器在这些复杂接触场景下难以保证稳定，亟需一种可在常规控制回路内实时运行、适应任意接触构型的稳定性控制方法。

Method: 提出一种优化的全驱动可行力螺旋多面体（full actuatable wrench polytope）评估算法，能够针对任意接触场景计算每个关节所需力矩，计算速度满足49 Hz的控制频率，从而可嵌入常规控制回路，用于驱动不同接触场景下的机器人位姿。

Result: 在多种仿真场景中对稳定性控制器进行了充分评估，并通过部署于实际步行机器人硬件进行验证；该控制器在目前其他控制器无法实现的极端复杂场景中仍能保持稳定。

Conclusion: 通过优化可行力螺旋多面体的评估算法，实现了实时可部署的稳定性控制器，突破了腿式机器人在陡坡、洞穴、脚手架等困难地形中的通行与稳定控制瓶颈。

Abstract: Legged robots offer a variety of automation applications in real-world scenarios. But areas that are difficult to traverse, like slopes, caves, or scaffolding, still pose a great challenge for traversal. To tackle this problem, we propose an optimized algorithm for evaluating the full actuatable wrench polytope for arbitrary contact scenarios. With our improved analysis algorithm, the torques for each joint of the robot can be calculated within a control frequency of 49 Hz. The achieved speedup allows for deployment within a regular control loop for actuating robot poses for different contact scenarios. We evaluated our stability controller extensively in simulation scenarios and validated its applicability by deploying it on actual walking robot hardware. The proposed controller achieved stability in very complex scenarios that are currently not achievable by any other controller.

</details>


### [328] [Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability for Hybrid Systems: Unified Goal-Driven Control with Safety Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17430)
*Javier Borquez,Shuang Peng,Somil Bansal*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文把经典的 Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) 可达性分析扩展到混杂动力系统，定义同时覆盖离散与连续状态的广义值函数以刻画安全集，并给出数值算法；在此基础上提出混杂最小限制安全滤波器与混杂反向 reach-avoid 管两种机制，实现安全与目标达成的联合保障，并在四足机器人上完成仿真与实机验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混杂动力系统是接触丰富的机器人系统的有效建模框架，但连续动力学与离散模式切换之间的复杂耦合，使得在此类系统中同时保证安全性与性能非常困难。经典 HJ 可达性只面向连续时间非线性系统，无法直接处理离散模式切换，因此需要将其推广到混杂系统。

Method: 1) 将经典 HJ 可达性分析扩展到混杂动力系统，通过定义在离散与连续状态上的广义值函数刻画混杂系统的安全集，并考虑控制约束与模型不确定性；2) 给出计算该值函数的数值算法；3) 基于安全集提出两种性能集成机制：混杂最小限制安全滤波器，仅在必要时干预标称控制器的离散与连续分量以避免不安全状态；以及混杂反向 reach-avoid 管，用于同时强制满足安全性与目标到达，合成保证安全与任务完成的连续、离散控制策略。

Result: 通过仿真研究与四足机器人实机实验验证了框架的有效性，展示了其在混杂模式规划与安全关键应用中的作用。安全滤波器可在尽量保留标称行为的同时避免不安全状态；reach-avoid 管实现了混杂 HJ 可达性中此前未涉及的安全与目标到达联合保障。

Conclusion: 该工作将 HJ 可达性成功推广到混杂动力系统，并提供了安全滤波与 reach-avoid 管两类可计算机制，使混杂系统能够同时获得形式化安全保证与任务性能，适用于接触丰富的机器人系统。

Abstract: Hybrid dynamical systems provide a powerful modeling framework for robotic systems, particularly in contact-rich environments. However, ensuring safety and performance in such systems remains challenging due to the intricate coupling between continuous dynamics and discrete mode transitions. In this work, we extend classical Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis, a formal verification method for continuous-time nonlinear systems, to hybrid dynamical systems. Our framework characterizes safe sets for hybrid systems through a generalized value function defined over both discrete and continuous states while accounting for control constraints and model uncertainty. We additionally provide a numerical algorithm to compute this value function.
  Building on these safe sets, we propose two different mechanisms to integrate performance objectives. First, we introduce a hybrid least-restrictive safety filter that intervenes on both the discrete and continuous components of a nominal controller only when necessary to avoid unsafe states, thereby preserving nominal behavior whenever possible. Second, we formulate and compute hybrid backward reach-avoid tubes, enabling the simultaneous enforcement of safety and goal-reaching behavior, an extension not previously addressed within hybrid HJ reachability. This enables the synthesis of continuous and discrete control policies that guarantee both safety and task completion. We validate our framework through simulation studies and real-world experiments on a quadrupedal robot, demonstrating its effectiveness in hybrid mode planning and safety-critical applications.

</details>


### [329] [Gaussian Processes for Modelling Spatial Fields with Robot Swarms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17463)
*Guillermo Legarda Herranz,Gianpiero Francesca,Mauro Birattari*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出位置无感知高斯过程回归（LU-GPR），使机器人群在没有外部定位系统时，仅用局部感知与通信即可建模空间场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于机器人群的空间场建模依赖外部定位系统，每个机器人需知道自身位置；在没有定位系统时无法适用。

Method: LU-GPR让每个机器人在推断空间场后验均值与方差的同时，与同伴就共同参考系达成一致；提出在线算法使各机器人在局部参考系收敛到共同参考系的过程中一致地推断局部估计；再通过专家乘积（product of experts）模型融合同伴估计与自身估计，得到全局模型。

Result: 结果表明LU-GPR随机器人数量的扩展性良好，且对有限通信范围具有鲁棒性；并展示了其在真实监测场景中估计疏散人群流动的应用。

Conclusion: LU-GPR为无外部定位条件下的分布式空间场建模提供了可行方案，兼具可扩展性与鲁棒性，并具备实际监测应用潜力。

Abstract: Robot swarms, by virtue of their decentralised architecture, are a natural tool for scalable, robust modelling of spatial fields, such as water temperature, wind velocity, or terrain elevation. However, existing methods rely on external positioning systems that allow each robot to determine its own position in space. Here, we introduce location-unaware Gaussian process regression (LU-GPR) as a solution to the modelling of spatial fields in the absence of such positioning systems. LU-GPR allows each robot to infer the posterior mean and variance of the field in space, while simultaneously agreeing on a common frame of reference with its peers, using only local sensing and communication. We propose an online algorithm that allows each robot to consistently infer local estimates as its local frame of reference converges to the common one. By means of a product of experts model, each robot also combines the estimates of its peers with its own to obtain a global model. Our results show that LU-GPR scales well with the number of robots and is robust to limited communication ranges. We also demonstrate how it can be used in real-world monitoring scenarios to estimate the flow of an evacuating crowd.

</details>


### [330] [Dissecting Motion-Prior Regularization for Data-Scarce Robotic Insertion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17484)
*Ning Hu,Shuai Li,Jindong Tan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 在仅有15次示范的扩散策略学习中，比较最小急动、速度-曲率及联合运动先验正则化对真实机器人插入任务的成功率影响：最小急动单独使用即可达到与联合正则化相同的87.5%成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散策略通常依赖大量示范数据，本研究探讨在仅15次示范的少样本条件下，训练期引入运动先验正则化能否提升插入任务的成功率。最小急动与速度-曲率被作为促进任务完成的候选机制，而非安全保障。

Method: 比较五种设置：单独最小急动、单独速度-曲率、二者联合、无先验、通用平滑正则化。每种设置在四类记录条件下汇总进行80次真实机器人试验。最小急动抑制预测平移加速度的突变，速度-曲率将运动速度与路径几何耦合。结果以成功率及Wilson 95%置信区间可视化对比。

Result: 联合正则化与仅最小急动均为70/80成功（87.5%）；仅速度-曲率为69/80（86.3%）；无先验为66/80（82.5%）；通用平滑为67/80（83.8%）。联合正则化比无先验高5.0个百分点，但相比单独最小急动无观测增益。

Conclusion: 最小急动是更简单、更值得复现的候选方案。研究未证实协同效应、生物力学特异性、安全性提升或分布偏移鲁棒性。

Abstract: This study asks whether training-time motion-prior regularization can improve insertion success when a diffusion policy is learned from only 15 demonstrations. Minimum jerk discourages abrupt changes in predicted translational acceleration; speed-curvature regularization instead couples movement speed to path geometry. These are candidate mechanisms for task completion, not safety guarantees. We compare the priors individually and jointly, neither prior, and generic smoothness, with 80 real-robot trials per setting pooled over four recorded condition classes. Joint and minimum-jerk-only settings each achieved 70/80 successes (87.5%), versus 69/80 (86.3%) for speed-curvature only, 66/80 (82.5%) for neither prior, and 67/80 (83.8%) for generic smoothness. Success rates and Wilson 95% confidence intervals are visualized for direct comparison. Joint regularization exceeded neither by 5.0 percentage points but provided no observed gain over minimum jerk alone. The results motivate minimum jerk as the simpler candidate for replication, without establishing synergy, biomechanical specificity, improved safety, or distribution-shift robustness.

</details>


### [331] [Modality-Autoregressive World-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17524)
*Adam Hung,Bardienus P. Duisterhof,Deva Ramanan,Jeffrey Ichnowski*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ModAR是首个在预测动作前自回归地去噪多种未来模态的world-action model (WAM)，系统研究表明预测点轨迹、DINO特征与深度图有益，而额外预测RGB收益不稳定；其顺序生成形式在所有测试数据规模下平均成功率最高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WAM通常联合建模未来观测与动作，但普遍以RGB图像作为未来预测目标。深度、预训练视觉特征、点轨迹等视觉模态能更高效地刻画几何、语义与运动信息，然而如何在WAM中最佳地组合这些模态仍是开放问题。

Method: 提出ModAR：在预测动作之前，以自回归方式对多种未来模态进行去噪，使每一步预测都能以先前生成的模态为条件。从零开始训练，系统研究训练数据混合比例、预测模态种类与WAM公式设计对性能的影响。

Result: WAM从预测点轨迹、DINO特征和深度图中获益，而额外预测未来RGB未带来一致收益；ModAR的顺序生成优于现有WAM形式，在所有评估数据规模下平均成功率最高。与基于视频模型初始化的Flex-π相比，ModAR在相同数据上微调后取得略高的观测平均成功率（75% vs. 72%），且训练FLOPs约减少20倍、无需预训练。在三个真实世界双臂任务上，ModAR超过基线，并能从人类视频中获益。

Conclusion: 多模态自回归去噪是构建WAM的有效范式：以几何与语义特征替代RGB预测目标可提升性能，顺序生成结合轻量训练即可媲美甚至超越预训练大模型方案，并具备向真实双臂任务与人类视频数据扩展的潜力。

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) jointly model future observations and actions, typically predicting the future as RGB images. Other visual modalities such as depth, pretrained visual features, and point tracks can more efficiently capture geometric, semantic, and motion features. However, how best to combine these modalities within WAMs remains an open question. We introduce ModAR, the first WAM to autoregressively denoise multiple future modalities before predicting actions. This allows each prediction to condition on previously generated modalities. We train from scratch to systematically study how training-data mixtures, predicted modalities, and WAM formulations affect performance. In our evaluations, WAMs benefit from predicting point tracks, DINO features, and depth maps, while additionally predicting future RGB does not provide a consistent benefit. We also find that ModAR's sequential generation outperforms existing WAM formulations, with the highest average success rate at all evaluated data scales. We also fine-tune the video-model-initialized WAM Flex-$π$ on the same data; ModAR achieves a slightly higher observed average success rate (75% vs. 72%) while using approximately $20\times$ fewer training FLOPs and no pretraining. On three real-world bimanual tasks, ModAR outperforms baselines and improves with human videos.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [332] [Optimal Pruning for Neural Architectures using Fisher Information Distances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16129)
*David S. Berman,Yen-Yu Fu,Edward Hirst,Thelma Chiwete Obirai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文从模型空间的微分几何距离出发，提出一种新的参数剪枝方案，通过Fisher信息度量下的测地距离衡量剪枝对模型的真实影响，并据此构建了从幅度剪枝到更优剪枝方法的层级体系，在多种架构与数据集上取得更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统剪枝方法（如基于参数幅度或局部Fisher信息）缺乏严格的数学理论支撑，无法准确衡量剪枝对模型性能的真实影响，因此需要一个有理论依据的剪枝准则。

Method: 将参数置零视为模型在参数消失超曲面上的位移，用Fisher信息度量下的测地距离计算未剪枝模型到该超曲面的最小距离，以此距离衡量剪枝带来的真实模型变化与性能影响；通过逐步逼近该测地距离，构建剪枝方法的最优性层级，从传统幅度剪枝发展为更精细有效的剪枝方案。

Result: 在全连接网络和视觉Transformer上，针对MNIST与CIFAR-10，覆盖0-100%完整剪枝范围和5个随机种子，该方法在准确率和Matthews相关系数上均优于基于参数幅度和局部Fisher信息的剪枝；同时不同测地近似层级产生计算高效且接近最优性能的中间剪枝方案。

Conclusion: 该几何视角不仅提供了面向AI模型的最先进剪枝方法，也为剪枝方案给出了经实验验证且具数学依据的合理解释。

Abstract: A new scheme for parameter pruning is introduced, derived from the differential-geometric distance in model space. Pruning a parameter sets its value to zero, representing a displacement of the model to the hypersurface on which that parameter vanishes. The minimal distance from the unpruned model to this hypersurface is naturally computed via the geodesic distance in the model space as determined by the Fisher information metric. This distance determines the true change in the model, and its performance, under pruning. By analysing progressively more faithful approximations of this geodesic distance a natural hierarchy of optimality for pruning methods is determined. This starts with the traditional magnitude pruning, then develops into new more sophisticated and effective pruning schemes. The method is demonstrated for both fully-connected networks and vision transformers, on MNIST and CIFAR-10, over the complete $0$-$100\%$ pruning range and across five random seeds. It outperforms pruning by parameter magnitude and by the local Fisher information alone in every architecture and dataset combination considered, on both accuracy and the Matthews correlation coefficient. Additionally, analysis of different levels of geodesic approximation produces intermediate pruning schemes that are computationally efficient and maintain near-optimal performance. This geometric picture supplies not only a state-of-the-art pruning methodology for AI models, but also a verified and mathematically-motivated justification for pruning schemes.

</details>


### [333] [Safe Error Correction for Language Models: Frozen-Base Adjustment with Capability Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16145)
*Gautam Kishore*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 CRN v2：在完全冻结的 Gemma 4 E2B 之上加一个约 34M 可训练参数（占文本模块 0.73%）的 logit 级纠错模块，通过 SFT + 无参考 DPO 训练，修正 53.3% 的基座错误且无能力退化，验证了"冻结基座 + logit 纠正 + KL 锚定"的设计原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究一个实用问题：小型纠错模块能否在不损害冻结语言模型原有能力的前提下修正其输出错误。既有方案（如 LoRA 微调）常面临"纠错—能力"权衡，作者希望找到一种既能纠错、又能保持基座能力的轻量方案，并明确本文定位为设计原则研究而非架构创新。

Method: 1) 基座 Gemma 4 E2B 完全冻结，仅训练一个 logit 级纠错模块 CRN v2（约 34M 可训练参数，占 4.65B 文本模块的 0.73%）。2) 训练流程为先 SFT，再在 83,400 条纠错对上做无参考 DPO。3) 引入 KL 保持项（λ=0.1）以锚定基座分布。4) 对比基线：匹配 CRN v1 预算的 LoRA（6.6M、rank 19）；消融：KL 项降至 0.01、更深层隐藏态注入（1.6M、仅 SFT）、第 4 层浅层注入、多深度 logit 纠正（~35M）、更长训练（5,000 SFT + 2,000 DPO）。5) 评测集为 60 题领域考试 CEHRI（事实、算术、隐式目标推理）及 MMLU/BoolQ N=200、car-wash N=8 能力基准。

Result: CRN v2 纠正 53.3% 的基座错误（改写变体 43.3%），能力基准无退化。LoRA 基线（6.6M、rank 19）纠错率高达 83.3%，但在同基准上损失 30–75% 能力，体现纠错—能力权衡。KL 项由 0.1 降至 0.01 使纠错率降至 35.0%。深层隐藏态注入（1.6M、仅 SFT）为 50.0%/55.8%，未超过 logit 纠正；第 4 层浅层注入降至 30.0%/28.3%；多深度 logit 纠正仅 40%；延长训练仍为 53.3%。所有替代配置均未超过 rank-128 logit 结果，与"最佳约 53% 而非下限"一致。

Conclusion: 在冻结基座上做 logit 级纠正并配合 KL 锚定，可获得不损害基座能力的纠错效果，但纠错率存在约 53% 的上限倾向；LoRA 等改动基座权重的方式纠错更强却以能力损失为代价。本文贡献在于提炼设计原则（冻结基座 + logit 纠正 + KL 锚定），而非架构创新，并开源代码、主结果权重与评测脚本（深层变体仅代码、无训练权重）。

Abstract: We study a practical question: can a small correction module fix errors in a frozen language model's outputs without degrading its base capabilities? We propose CRN v2, a lightweight logit-level correction module (~34M trainable parameters, 0.73% of the 4.65B text module) that sits atop a fully frozen Gemma 4 E2B model. The base model is never updated; only the correction module learns, via supervised fine-tuning followed by reference-free DPO on 83,400 error-correction pairs. On a 60-question domain exam (CEHRI: Certified Human-Robot Intelligence, covering facts, arithmetic, and implicit-goal reasoning), CRN v2 corrects 53.3% of base-model errors (reworded variant: 43.3%) while showing no degradation on tested capability benchmarks (MMLU/BoolQ N=200; car-wash N=8). A LoRA baseline at the matched CRN v1 budget (6.6M params, rank 19) achieves 83.3% correction but suffers 30-75% capability loss on the same benchmarks -- the correction-capability tradeoff. An ablation shows that the KL preservation term (lambda=0.1) is critical: lowering it to 0.01 degrades correction to 35.0%. A hidden-state injection variant at earlier layers (1.6M params, SFT-only) reaches 50.0%/55.8% but does not exceed logit correction; shallower injection (layer 4) drops to 30.0%/28.3%; multi-depth logit correction (~35M) reaches only 40%; and longer training (5,000 SFT + 2,000 DPO) stays at 53.3% -- none of the alternative configurations we tested exceeded the rank-128 logit result, consistent with a best-achieved result of ~53% rather than a floor. This is a study of a design principle (frozen base + logit correction + KL anchoring), not a claim of architectural novelty. All code, main-result weights, and evaluation scripts are released (deep variant as code only -- no trained deep checkpoints).

</details>


### [334] [GPEvac: GNN-Based PPO for Adaptive Evacuation Routing During Shooting Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16163)
*Daniel Perkins,Subhadeep Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出GPEvac——一个基于GNN与PPO的自适应疏散路径规划框架，可在多样化建筑布局中实时生成全局疏散路线，显著降低威胁暴露，14.73ms内完成计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模枪击事件激增，亟需能实时引导受害者避险的系统。有效疏散需同时最小化威胁暴露、应对对抗性不确定性并考虑拥挤动态。现有方法局限于特定布局且大规模下计算不可行，实用指南仅给出"跑、躲、战"的粗略建议。

Method: GPEvac结合GNN与PPO：采用edge-first顺序消息传递机制并引入可学习的虚拟全局节点，以捕捉局部与远距离依赖；将图嵌入整合进置换不变（permutation-invariant）评分机制，使单一策略可跨不同拓扑与规模的建筑布局泛化。

Result: 在多种建筑布局的仿真中，GPEvac优于智能基线，显著降低总威胁暴露；在本地CPU硬件上仅用14.73ms即可计算全局疏散路线，可与实时监控系统无缝集成。

Conclusion: GPEvac不仅可在枪击事件中拯救生命，其方法还可迁移至关键基础设施、智能交通系统、自适应传感器网络等其他图结构决策领域。

Abstract: The sharp increase in mass shootings underscores an urgent need for systems that guide victims to safety in real time. An effective evacuation system must minimize threat exposure while also accounting for adversarial uncertainty and crowding dynamics. Current methods in the literature are rigidly constrained to layout-specific policies and computationally intractable in large-scale layouts, while practical guidelines simply advise victims to "run", "hide", or "fight". We propose GPEvac: a GNN-based PPO framework that computes adaptive evacuation routes during shooting events. To capture both local and long-distance dependencies, we introduce an edge-first sequential message-passing scheme with a learnable virtual global node. The resulting graph embeddings are integrated into a permutation-invariant scoring mechanism that allows a single learned policy to operate across building layouts of diverse topologies and sizes. Through extensive simulation, we show that GPEvac outperforms intelligent baselines across distinct architectural layouts, significantly reducing total threat exposure. Crucially, the system computes global evacuation routes in just 14.73 ms on local CPU hardware, enabling seamless integration with live surveillance systems. In addition to saving lives during shooting events, the methodologies developed are transferable to other graph-structured decision-making domains, including critical infrastructure, intelligent transportation systems, and adaptive sensor networks.

</details>


### [335] [Position: AI Is Not Ready for Strategic Conflicts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16189)
*Mark Riedl,Glenn Matlin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该立场论文主张：开放式战略兵棋是基于LM的高风险社会仿真，任何影响规划、条令、政策或危机响应的LM兵棋都必须具备可审计的安全论证；当前开放式兵棋的正确定位是作为压力测试工具，而非安全论证本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型可扮演智能体、生成想定分支、裁决模糊行动并总结经验，因而对兵棋仿真极具吸引力；但同样的能力也带来风险：模型语言同时决定智能体"想做什么"和"什么成为仿真现实"。作者担忧这类开放式角色若无安全约束，会被误用于影响真实决策。

Method: 采用立场论文（position paper）形式，通过概念分析与失效模式分类进行论证，提出五类失效模式：决策洗白（decision laundering）、裁决不透明（adjudication opacity）、角色崩塌（role collapse）、经由裁决的升级（escalation-through-adjudication）、战略想象力失效（failure of strategic imagination）。

Result: 指出常规基准测试无法为上述场景确立安全性；兵棋能够以压力测试方式暴露失败，但其自身并不构成面向重大用途的安全论证。因此，缺乏可审计安全论证的LM兵棋不应影响规划、条令、政策或危机响应。

Conclusion: 开放式LM兵棋的价值在于对影响决策的LM智能体进行压力测试，而非直接用于重大决策；应建立可审计的安全论证机制，并明确区分"压力测试"与"安全论证"两种功能，防止仿真结果被不当迁移至现实决策。

Abstract: Open-ended strategic wargames are high-stakes LM-based social simulations: they model adversaries, institutions, escalation, plan brittleness, doctrine, and crisis response. Language models (LMs) are attractive because they can play agents, generate scenario branches, adjudicate ambiguous actions, and summarize lessons, but the same affordances make open-ended roles dangerous: model language determines both what an actor attempts and what becomes simulated reality. This position paper argues that no LM-enabled wargame should inform planning, doctrine, policy, or crisis response without an auditable safety case, and that the proper use of open-ended wargames today is to stress-test decision-influencing LM agents. We identify five failure modes: decision laundering, adjudication opacity, role collapse, escalation-through-adjudication, and failure of strategic imagination. Ordinary benchmarks cannot establish safety for these settings. Wargames can expose failures as stress tests; they are not themselves safety cases for consequential use.

</details>


### [336] [Calibrate, Then Route: A Measured Study of Learned Request Routing for Disaggregated LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16206)
*Srikanta Datta Tumkur,Jay Iyer,Mehar Simhadri,Sai Pavan Kumar,Sai Kapil Kumar,Ramesh Nampelly*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究分离式LLM服务中的请求路由问题，提出基于精确提示长度、预测输出长度、准入后KV缓存压力和SLO类别的完成时间估计路由器，并在八卡A40真实集群上验证其优于轮询、最小负载和长度启发式策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分离式LLM服务将计算密集的prefill与内存密集的decode部署在独立GPU池上，虽已通过DistServe、Splitwise、Mooncake等系统实现快速分离，但路由策略仍决定各实例的请求分配，直接影响完成时间与资源效率，现有研究对此关注不足。

Method: 构建离散事件仿真器开发路由策略，并以八块NVIDIA A40 GPU、每卡运行vLLM引擎、池间通过NIXL传输KV缓存的真实平台进行验证；路由器利用精确提示长度、预测输出长度、准入后KV缓存压力和SLO类别估计各实例的额外完成时间，所有工作负载在实测饱和状态下运行。

Result: 在三条混合突发到达轨迹上，校准路由器平均goodput最高达0.864，优于轮询、最小负载和长度启发式的0.835–0.847，且跨轨迹方差最低；对轮询与长度启发式在三条轨迹上均胜出，对最小负载在两条上胜出，第三条仅落后0.003（处于运行噪声范围）。硬件校准关键：仿真器常数会损失4.5个goodput点及约40%的尾部延迟优势，使评分器退化为近似队列计数。收益随decode池规模与流量异质性增大而增加，但在三实例池中消失；极端稀缺下贪心成本最小化会集中于最低成本实例，此时盲目分散更优；校准成本后，学习路由器用六块GPU即可达到轮询七块的goodput。

Conclusion: 基于实测硬件校准的延迟感知路由器能有效提升分离式LLM服务的goodput并降低尾延迟，但其收益依赖校准精度、池规模与流量特征；在实例极少或资源极度稀缺时，简单策略（队列计数或盲目分散）可能更适用。

Abstract: Disaggregated LLM serving places compute heavy prefill and memory heavy decode on separate GPU pools. Systems such as DistServe, Splitwise, and Mooncake make this separation fast, but routing still determines which instances handle each request. We study a router that estimates the additional completion time on each instance using exact prompt length, predicted output length, post admission KV cache pressure, and SLO class. We develop the policy in a discrete event simulator and validate it on eight NVIDIA A40 GPUs, each running a vLLM engine, with NIXL transferring KV caches between pools. All workloads run at measured saturation. Across three mixed, bursty arrival traces, the calibrated router achieves the highest mean goodput at 0.864, compared with 0.835 to 0.847 for round robin, least loaded, and a length heuristic. It also shows the lowest variance across traces. It beats round robin and the length heuristic on all three traces and least loaded on two. On the third, it trails by 0.003, within run to run noise. Hardware calibration matters: simulator derived constants cost 4.5 goodput points and roughly 40 percent of the tail latency advantage, reducing the scorer to little more than queue counting. Benefits grow with decode pool size and traffic heterogeneity but disappear in pools with three instances, where queue counts are often enough. Under extreme scarcity, greedy cost minimization concentrates requests on the cheapest scored instance, and blind spreading performs better. With calibrated costs, the learned router matches the goodput of round robin using six GPUs instead of seven.

</details>


### [337] [Artificial intelligence and biosecurity: capabilities, threat pathways, and defense-in-depth governance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16213)
*Candace S. Y. Chan,Aris Karatzikos,Ilias Georgakopoulos-Soares*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 综述AI在生物研究数字—物理全流程中的应用，分析其生物安全风险取决于能力、使用者意图与实验室可及性等多因素，指出目前AI"提升"主要体现在数字任务，湿实验仍存壁垒，主张采用纵深防御治理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI正重塑生物学研究全流程（检索、预测、实验协调、自动化实验），其在医学、公共卫生和生物技术中潜力巨大，但可能带来生物安全风险；现有讨论多聚焦AI能做什么，缺乏对"谁使用、意图、工具可及性、防护措施"等多维因素的系统评估，也缺乏适配生物领域的治理框架。

Method: 文献综述与概念分析：梳理AI工具用于生物威胁的各环节（信息收集、生物设计、采购、合成、测试、放大、潜在释放）；比较数字任务与湿实验任务的AI能力证据（前沿系统在in-silico与筛选规避基准上超越专家，而受控湿实验研究显示隐性知识与物理执行仍是障碍）；分析通用模型对齐技术向生物领域迁移不佳的原因，以及可解释性在审计危险能力是否被真正移除中的作用。

Result: 证据显示AI提升效应存在，但主要集中在数字任务；前沿系统在in-silico与筛选规避类基准上已超过专家基线，而受控湿实验研究表明隐性知识与物理执行构成实质壁垒。同时，针对通用模型的对齐技术难以有效迁移到生物模型，可解释性正成为审计危险能力是否被真正去除的新兴手段。

Conclusion: 应构建纵深防御式治理，将能力阈值与生物AI生态中各主体的相称责任挂钩，在降低高后果风险的同时保留有益用途。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence is reshaping biological research across an increasingly connected digital-to-physical workflow. General-purpose large language models can retrieve and integrate scientific information, support experimental planning, and computational analysis; biological foundation models can predict, optimize, and generate proteins, genes, and genome-scale sequences; agentic systems can coordinate multistep research tasks; automated laboratories can partially close the design-build-test-learn cycle. These technologies could greatly benefit medicine, public health, and biotechnology. However, their biosecurity risk depends not only on what the AI can do, but also on who uses it, their expertise and intent, their access to laboratory tools and materials, and the safeguards in place. Current evidence shows that AI uplift exists but primarily affects digital rather than physical tasks. Frontier systems have exceeded expert baselines on in-silico, and screening-evasion benchmarks, whereas controlled wet-laboratory studies find that tacit knowledge and physical execution remain substantial barriers. This review describes the different biological threats from AI tool use, from information gathering and biological design to procurement, synthesis, testing, scale-up, and potential release. We further examine why alignment techniques for general-purpose models transfer poorly to biological ones, and the emerging role of interpretability in auditing whether hazardous capabilities are genuinely removed. We argue for defense-in-depth governance that links capability thresholds to proportionate responsibilities across the biological AI ecosystem, reducing high-consequence risk while preserving beneficial use.

</details>


### [338] [Where Should the KV Cache Live? Placement Policies Across GPU, CPU, and SSD for Long-Lived Sessions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16215)
*Srikanta Datta Tumkur,Jay Iyer,Mehar Simhadri,Sai Pavan Kumar,Sai Kapil Kumar,Ramesh Nampelly*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Tiering（HBM+DRAM+SSD）带来73.02倍并发会话和62.04倍低成本收益主要来自容量而非放置策略；解码阶段计算受限，放置主要影响PCIe迁移流量和首token时延。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPU HBM稀缺昂贵，KV cache随对话、agent循环和文档问答累积状态而大量占用HBM；虽已有Mooncake、LMCache、FlexGen、InfiniGen、AttentionStore等系统用DRAM/SSD扩展，但"哪些块放哪层、何时迁移/驱逐、预取是否有效"仍缺乏系统研究。

Method: 构建覆盖GPU HBM、CPU DRAM、SSD的离散事件模拟器，并用随机森林执行时间预测器进行校准；在chat、agent、文档问答负载上比较recency、reuse frequency、predicted reuse、EWMA预测器及带prefetch lookahead的策略。

Result: 分层可支持每GPU 73.02倍并发会话、每会话成本降低62.04倍，收益来自1+8+64的容量而非放置策略；batch size=1时解码计算受限，放置几乎不影响吞吐，主要改变PCIe迁移流量与首token时延。chat下recency比reuse frequency减少2.30倍迁移流量，而reuse frequency在agent和文档问答最优。现有predicted reuse策略与recency逐字节相同，其agent建议实为recency；真正的EWMA预测器虽改变行为但排名仍落后于reuse frequency。预取无法以带宽成本自证，即使oracle在未来请求已知下，在迁移流量上也从未优于no prefetch。

Conclusion: 面向负载的放置可减少数据移动，但predicted reuse与prefetch的建议在其实现方式下缺乏支持。

Abstract: GPU high bandwidth memory is scarce and expensive, and KV caches consume much of it as chats, agent loops, and document question answering accumulate state. Systems such as Mooncake, LMCache, FlexGen, InfiniGen, and AttentionStore extend GPU memory with CPU DRAM and SSD. The harder question is which blocks belong in each tier, when to move or evict them, and whether prefetching helps. We study these choices in a discrete event simulator spanning GPU HBM, CPU DRAM, and SSD, calibrated against a random forest execution time predictor. We compare recency, reuse frequency, predicted reuse, and an EWMA predictor with prefetch lookahead across chat, agent, and document question answering workloads. Tiering supports 73.02 times more concurrent sessions per GPU and lowers cost per session by 62.04 times. These gains come from tier capacities of 1 plus 8 plus 64, not placement policy. Decode is compute bound at batch size one in our setup, so placement barely affects throughput. It mainly changes PCIe migration traffic and time to first token. Recency produces 2.30 times less migration traffic than reuse frequency for chat. Reuse frequency performs best for agents and document question answering. The existing predicted reuse policy is byte identical to recency, making its agent recommendation effectively recency. A genuine EWMA predictor changes behavior but still ranks behind reuse frequency on the workloads prediction was expected to help. Prefetching does not justify its bandwidth cost. Across the policy and cache size grid, even an oracle with knowledge of future requests never beats no prefetch on migration traffic. Workload specific placement can reduce data movement, but the predicted reuse and prefetch recommendations are not supported as implemented.

</details>


### [339] [Toward Governance-Aware Autonomous GIS: A Narrative Review of Ethical and Privacy Risks in LLM-Enabled GeoAI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16232)
*Maya Subramanian,Devika Jain*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文综述了LLM驱动的GeoAI在空间治理方面面临的八类重复性问题，并提出了一个治理感知架构，将其映射为可执行控制与可审计产物，同时指出现有响应多为概念性、缺乏实证验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的GeoAI通过自然语言接口和自主GIS工作流扩展了空间信息查询、生成与解释能力，但这种能力带来了通用AI伦理讨论未能充分覆盖的治理挑战，例如基于移动轨迹的被动位置推断、由空间自相关和尺度效应驱动的空间结构化偏见放大、空间事实幻觉，以及多模态地理空间输入中的不确定性叠加。现有讨论缺乏针对GeoAI的专门治理框架。

Method: 采用叙述性综述方法，识别LLM赋能GeoAI中的八个反复出现的问题：数据来源与同意、空间隐私与推断风险、算法偏见与空间不平等、作为结构性风险的空间机制（空间自相关、可变面积单元问题、尺度效应）、LLM特有的技术风险、可解释性、政策与监管缺口、公众赋能与劳动力发展。对每个问题，刻画其底层机制，用文献中的示例加以说明，并评估当前技术或制度响应的状态。在此基础上，提出面向LLM赋能自主GIS的治理感知架构。

Result: 提出了一个治理感知架构，将每个问题映射到地理空间数据生命周期中的可执行控制与可审计产物，并通过一个洪水响应路径规划的示例场景进行说明。综述还揭示了一个持续存在的证据缺口：所提出的响应大多仍停留在概念层面，针对LLM赋能GeoAI治理控制的实地测试评估仍然有限。

Conclusion: 文章在结尾提出了一项研究议程，强调实证验证、面向空间的可解释性工具，以及与这些新兴风险相匹配的劳动力培训。

Abstract: Geospatial artificial intelligence (GeoAI) powered by large language models (LLMs) is expanding the capacity to query, generate, and interpret spatial information through natural-language interfaces and agentic autonomous GIS workflows. This capability creates governance challenges that general AI ethics discussions do not fully capture, including passive location inference from mobility traces, spatially structured bias amplification driven by spatial autocorrelation and scale effects, hallucinated spatial facts, and uncertainty compounding across multimodal geospatial inputs.
