### [405] [DT-RAID: A Software-Defined Tiered RAID Architecture for Heterogeneous SSDs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16003)
*Kun-Chi Chiang,Radu Stoica,Animesh Trivedi,Chun-Lien Su,Liang-Chi Chen,Roman Pletka,Wei-Kuan Shih,Chien-Chung Ho*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: DT-RAID 是一种面向新型异构 SSD 的驱动器内异构感知 RAID 架构，通过监控条带级 I/O 访问模式并采用轻量级热度追踪机制，在线将热条带放置到高性能高耐久层，无需修改应用，在 SNIA MSR 企业级 I/O 踪迹仿真中最高提升 6.8 倍 I/O 性能并延长 20.9 倍归一化寿命。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云与 AI 驱动工作负载快速增长，使现代存储子系统需求愈发复杂。SSD 控制器架构已碎片化为面向耐久、性能或容量的多档驱动器类型；更近一步，SSD 开始在同一设备内划分不同区域，形成驱动器内异构性。然而，如何以最小扰动将这种异构性整合进现有存储栈仍具挑战。

Method: 论文主张存储中间件（如 RAID）是应对上述整合挑战的有效控制层，并提出 DT-RAID：一种面向新兴 SSD 的驱动器内异构感知 RAID 架构。DT-RAID 监控条带级 I/O 访问模式并在无需应用修改的情况下进行在线放置决策；其采用轻量级热度追踪机制，将频繁访问的热条带动态放置到更高性能、更高耐久性的层。

Result: 基于 SNIA MSR 企业级 I/O 踪迹的仿真表明：相比均匀 RAID 部署，DT-RAID 在层间不对称性更大时可将建模 I/O 性能提升最高 6.8 倍，并将归一化寿命延长最高 20.9 倍。

Conclusion: 存储中间件可作为整合驱动器内异构性的有效控制层；DT-RAID 通过条带级热度感知的在线放置，在不修改应用的前提下显著提升性能与寿命，为新兴异构 SSD 的存储栈集成提供了可行方案。

Abstract: The rapid proliferation of cloud and AI-driven workloads has led to increasingly complex requirements for modern storage subsystems. To meet these demands, SSD controller architectures have evolved into a fragmented landscape, offering tiers of drive types optimized for endurance, performance, or capacity. More recently, SSDs have begun to differentiate regions within the same device, enabling intra-drive heterogeneity. However, integrating such heterogeneity into the existing storage stack with minimal disruption remains challenging.
  In this paper, we argue that storage middleware, such as RAID, is an effective control layer to address these integration challenges. We present DT-RAID, an intra-drive heterogeneity-aware RAID architecture designed for emerging SSDs. DT-RAID monitors stripe-level I/O access patterns and makes online placement decisions without requiring application modifications. It employs a lightweight heat-tracking mechanism to dynamically place frequently accessed (hot) stripes onto the higher-performance, higher-endurance tier. Using simulations based on SNIA MSR enterprise I/O traces, we demonstrate that DT-RAID improves modeled I/O performance by up to $6.8\times$ under greater tier asymmetry and extends normalized lifespan by up to $20.9\times$ compared to uniform RAID deployments.

</details>


### [406] [Is INT8 Portable? A Cross-Platform Measurement Study of Quantized Inference on Embedded and Automotive Accelerators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16085)
*Yuyeong Shin*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 通过对7类硬件的受控测量，作者证明INT8训练后量化的"一次量化、随处部署"假设不成立：加速符号取决于CPU点积ISA，INT8输出跨目标不可移植（仅同整数内核时逐位一致），且厂商NPU强制绑定自有量化路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: INT8训练后量化被默认视为边缘部署的标准方案，业界普遍假设：INT8以微小且可预测的精度代价换取更快推理，且量化一次即可迁移到任意目标平台。本文旨在用受控实验检验这一假设是否成立，尤其针对嵌入式与汽车部署中对逐输入确定性和冗余性的需求。

Method: 在7类硬件（ARM与x86 CPU、独立GPU、NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin iGPU及其NVDLA核心、两款厂商NPU：Qualcomm Hexagon HTP与DEEPX DX-M1）上进行受控测量研究；固定ONNX模型工件与量化scale，使整数内核或ISA成为唯一自由变量；用固定计算量的扫描定位延迟区间转变。

Result: 可移植性在三个维度失效：(1) INT8加速符号由CPU点积ISA决定——具备dotprod/SDOT或VNNI的核心最高加速2.1x，缺失者反而减速1.7x，同模型同运行时亦然；(2) INT8输出不可移植且呈不变性而非梯度——FP32预测对所有目标对逐位一致(1000/1000)，INT8在共享整数内核时1000/1000一致，不共享时仅958-965/1000，与边界是CPU<->CPU还是CPU<->加速器无关，且top-1精度无法察觉；(3) 厂商NPU掌控量化——自带QDQ图在一款NPU上静默失败（外部scale被忽略，精度0.75->0.005，编译、profile、运行均无报错），在另一款上显式拒绝编译，仅厂商原生路径可得到正确引擎。此外，边缘NPU延迟区间由输出/设备到主机传输大小而非计算量决定。

Conclusion: "一次量化、随处部署"对嵌入式与汽车部署是不安全的，因为这些场景要求逐输入确定性与冗余性。作者开源脚本与32份报告。

Abstract: Eight-bit integer (INT8) post-training quantization is the default recipe for edge deployment, under a widely held assumption: INT8 makes inference faster at a small, predictable accuracy cost, and a model quantized once can be carried to any target. We test that assumption with a controlled measurement study across seven hardware classes -- ARM and x86 CPUs, a discrete GPU, an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin iGPU and its NVDLA cores, and two vendor NPUs (Qualcomm Hexagon HTP, DEEPX DX-M1) -- holding the ONNX artifact and the quantization scales fixed so the integer kernel or ISA is the only free variable. Portability fails on three axes. (1) The sign of the INT8 speedup is set by the CPU's dot-product ISA (ARM dotprod/SDOT, x86 VNNI): cores that have it speed up by up to 2.1x, cores that lack it slow down by 1.7x, for the identical model and runtime. (2) INT8 outputs are not portable, and the rule is an invariance rather than a gradient: FP32 predictions are bit-identical for every pair (1000/1000), while INT8 predictions agree 1000/1000 exactly when two targets share an integer kernel and 958-965/1000 whenever they do not -- independent of whether the boundary is CPU<->CPU or CPU<->accelerator, and invisible to top-1 accuracy, which is preserved. (3) Vendor NPUs own quantization: a bring-your-own QDQ graph fails silently on one NPU (external scales ignored, accuracy 0.75 -> 0.005 while it compiles, profiles and runs without error) and loudly on the other (the compiler refuses the graph), so only the vendor's native path yields a correct engine. We further show that edge-NPU latency regimes are set by output/device-to-host transfer size rather than compute, and locate the transition with a fixed-compute sweep. We release the scripts and 32 reports. "Quantize once, deploy anywhere" is unsafe for embedded and automotive deployment, where per-input determinism and redundancy matter.

</details>


### [407] [The World Model Hardware Accelerator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16244)
*Shashank Chaurasia*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该文提出WMHA——面向扩散Transformer的延迟优先推理加速器：采用超长指令字（VLIW）四引擎发射、权值驻留的16×16双点乘阵列（支持FP8/BF16）、单遍在线softmax注意力流水线（KV驻留）。RTL综合并用UVM对双精度参考模型验证，语义验收：真实去噪轨迹MSE至少降低10倍，实测降低23倍，2.37亿数值零错误；11个基准测试给出实测占用率与投影；5个引擎在sky130完成布线后时序与功耗测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer的推理算术特性与自回归解码相反：无逐token递归，每个去噪步均为定形状的全序列前向，整个调度在编译期已知，唯一串行维度是步数。这一结构可被硬件充分利用，以减少推理延迟为目标进行专用加速器设计。

Method: 1) 微架构：VLIW定序器单指令字发射四个引擎；权值驻留的16×16双点乘阵列流式执行FP8与BF16收缩运算；单遍在线softmax注意力流水线，通过偏斜软件流水保持KV驻留。2) 实现：冻结微架构文档，可综合SystemVerilog实现。3) 验证：UVM环境对双精度参考模型，验收准则为语义性——设备需运行真实去噪轨迹并使相对干净潜变量的MSE降低至少10倍。4) 物理实现：sky130下五个引擎完成布线布局，寄生标注时序与实测活动功耗；整芯片综合，并量化阻碍其布局布线的宿主限制及可解除该限制的机器方案。

Result: 在两种综合配置下MSE均降低23倍（超出10倍验收线），2.37亿个受检数值零单元失效。基于已发表模型形状构建的11个应用基准（含原始扩散Transformer配置）在设备上运行，给出实测占用率与单独标注的投影值。五个引擎在sky130完成布线布局，获得寄生标注时序与实测活动功耗；整芯片完成综合，阻其布局布线的宿主限制被量化并提出相应机器方案。

Conclusion: 扩散Transformer的编译期可知调度与定形状全序列前向特性可转化为延迟优先的硬件结构；WMHA通过VLIW多引擎发射、权值驻留点乘阵列与单遍在线softmax注意力，在RTL级以语义验收（去噪MSE降低23倍、零错误）证明正确性，并在sky130与综合流程中给出可量化的时序、功耗、占用率与宿主限制证据，为扩散Transformer推理加速提供了从微架构到物理实现的完整路径。

Abstract: Diffusion transformers invert the arithmetic that autoregressive decoding made familiar. There is no token-by-token recurrence: every denoising step is a full-sequence forward pass over static shapes, so the entire schedule is known at compile time and the only serial dimension is the step count itself. We exploit that structure in WMHA, a latency-first diffusion-transformer inference accelerator: a very-long-instruction-word sequencer issues four engines from one instruction word, a weight-stationary 16x16 dual-dot array streams FP8 and BF16 contractions, and a single-pass online-softmax attention pipeline keeps keys and values resident through a skewed software pipeline. The design is specified in a frozen micro-architecture document, implemented in synthesizable SystemVerilog, and verified against a double-precision reference model by a UVM environment whose acceptance criterion is semantic: the device must run a real denoising trajectory and reduce mean squared error against a clean latent by at least a factor of ten. It does so by a factor of 23, at both synthesized configurations, with zero element failures across 237 million checked values. Eleven application benchmarks built from published model shapes, including the original diffusion-transformer configuration, run on the device and report measured occupancy beside separately labelled projections. Five engines are taken to routed layout in sky130 with parasitic-annotated timing and measured-activity power; the full chip is synthesized, and the host limit that stopped its place-and-route is quantified together with the machine that would remove it.

</details>


### [408] [EBL: Efficient Broad Learning for Distributed Adaptive Harmonic Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16358)
*Changhong Li,Georgios Floros,Biswajit Basu,Shreejith Shanker*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出 Efficient Broad Learning (EBL) 框架，用于分布式自适应谐波估计，在 FPGA 上实现高精度、低时延与在线迁移学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可再生能源与电动交通（以 EV 充电为主）的非线性负荷大量接入电网，引入严重谐波畸变，影响变电站设备与开关设备的效率与寿命，因此需要在注入源处进行快速、高精度谐波分析与治理。

Method: 提出 Efficient Broad Learning (EBL) 框架，针对 BLS 风格谐波估计进行量化 FPGA 加速；采用半周期输入；利用闭式解而非反向传播实现在线迁移学习；结合定制量化与稀疏化设计以降低资源开销。

Result: 预测速度比最接近的已报道 FPGA 方法快 17.4 倍；在多场景充放电节点谐波预测中具备快速自适应能力；在 Zynq Ultrascale+ ZU7EV FPGA 上仅消耗 5.9% 的 LUT，约为当前最先进 FPGA 加速估计器所需 LUT 的 82%。

Conclusion: EBL 框架同时实现了高精度、可重构灵活性、超低时延与低资源占用，适用于分布式自适应谐波估计与源侧谐波治理。

Abstract: Renewable energy systems and electrified transport have found widespread adoption in recent years. The integration of these non-linear loads, dominated by electric vehicle (EV) charging, however, has introduced severe harmonic distortion into the power grid, impacting the efficiency and lifetime of substation equipment and switchgear in the distribution network. Rapid and high-precision harmonic analysis has hence become a prerequisite for effective harmonic control at the source of injection. This paper proposes an Efficient Broad Learning (EBL) framework for distributed adaptive harmonic estimation. As a quantised FPGA acceleration framework for BLS-style harmonic estimation, it offers high-accuracy estimation with half-cycle input, reconfigurable flexibility enabled by the FPGA implementation, and ultra-low latency, achieving 17.4 $\times$ faster predictions than the nearest reported FPGA method. For harmonic prediction across multi-scenario charging and discharging nodes, the online transfer learning based on a closed-form solution rather than backpropagation in EBL demonstrates rapid adaptability. By exploiting bespoke quantisation and sparsity, the approach consumes 5.9\% of the LUTs on the Zynq Ultrascale+ ZU7EV FPGA, using $\approx$ 82\% of the LUTs required by the state-of-the-art FPGA-accelerated estimator.

</details>


### [409] [FSNIC: A Low-Latency Flow-Based Intrusion Detection Architecture for FPGA SmartNICs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16363)
*Nise O'Cuill,Changhong Li,Georgios Floros,Shreejith Shanker*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文在基于FPGA的SmartNIC数据平面中实现了基于机器学习的入侵检测系统，将P4解析与RTL级LogicNets模型结合，提出有状态流级IDS，在UNSW-NB15上将准确率从86.92%提升至97.68%，并在CICIDS2017上验证，实现6ns推理延迟、仅846 LUT且不占用BRAM/DSP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代数据中心需要高性能网络与实时安全，但传统IDS依赖通用处理器，难以在高速流量下线速检测而不引入延迟或性能瓶颈；SmartNIC可将计算下沉到网络数据平面，为低延迟IDS提供可能。

Method: 在FPGA SmartNIC流水线中实现机器学习IDS：集成P4数据包解析与RTL实现的LogicNets IDS模型，实现确定性低延迟推理；相较无状态包级分类器，采用有状态流级IDS，通过跨包聚合特征引入少量状态，捕捉包级不可见的行为模式。

Result: 在UNSW-NB15上，流级IDS较无状态包级分类将检测准确率从86.92%提升到97.68%；在CICIDS2017上进一步评估，并与已有FPGA IDS设计对比；硬件-软件协同设计实现6ns推理延迟，仅使用846 LUT，不占用BRAM或DSP，具备低延迟与资源高效特性。

Conclusion: 基于FPGA SmartNIC数据平面的流级机器学习IDS可在极低延迟和极少资源开销下显著提升检测准确率，验证了在网计算用于实时入侵检测的可行性。

Abstract: Modern data centres require high-performance networking alongside effective real-time security. Traditional Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) commonly rely on general-purpose processors and often struggle to inspect high-speed traffic at line rate without introducing latency or performance bottlenecks. Smart Network Interface Cards (NICs) provide an alternative by enabling computation directly within the network data plane. This work presents a machine learning-based IDS implemented within an FPGA-based SmartNIC pipeline. The system integrates P4-based packet parsing with a LogicNets IDS model implemented in RTL, enabling deterministic, low-latency inference. Compared with traditional stateless packet-level classifiers, the proposed stateful flow-based IDS introduces minimal state by aggregating features across packets, capturing behavioural patterns not observable at the packet level. Experimental results on the UNSW-NB15 dataset show that the flow-based IDS improves detection accuracy from 86.92\% to 97.68\% compared with stateless packet-level classification. We also evaluate the proposed IDS on CICIDS2017 and compare its real-time hardware performance with prior FPGA-based IDS designs. Through hardware-software co-design, the proposed IDS achieves 6~ns inference latency using only 846 LUTs, with no BRAM or DSP usage, demonstrating a low latency and resource efficient implementation.

</details>


### [410] [FINNAS: FINN-Guided Hardware-Aware NAS and Pruning for FPGA Jet Substructure Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16367)
*Eva Chauffour,Changhong Li,Georgios Floros,Shreejith Shanker*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出FINNAS，一种由FINN引导、硬件感知的进化神经架构搜索框架，用于联合搜索量化MLP的深度、宽度与全局精度，并以FINN估算的LUT占用和延迟为代理指标筛选候选，最终在CERNBox喷注子结构分类任务上实现了优于手工优化FINN加速器的精度-资源权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FPGA适合在严格的精度、延迟和资源约束下部署量化神经网络（QNN），但寻找高效的"模型-加速器"组合通常需要大量人工设计空间探索和反复的硬件综合，成本高昂。因此需要一种自动化的硬件感知架构搜索方法来降低设计负担。

Method: FINNAS：FINN引导的硬件感知进化神经架构搜索框架。联合搜索量化MLP的深度、宽度和全局精度设置；使用代理验证精度与FINN估算的LUT占用、全并行映射下的延迟共同对候选排序；入选的最终候选被完整重训练，并进行搜索后非结构化剪枝，随后通过RTL仿真和Vivado out-of-context综合进行验证。

Result: 在CERNBox喷注子结构分类任务上，搜索得到的实现展现出有竞争力的精度-资源权衡。与手工优化的稠密FINN加速器相比，紧凑的FINNAS设计将精度从73.78%提升至74.36%，同时LUT占用减少8.5倍，RTL仿真延迟降低1.77倍。非结构化剪枝在全并行最终候选上进一步带来一致的LUT和FF减少。

Conclusion: FINNAS能够自动发现高效的量量化MLP-FPGA加速器组合，在提升精度的同时显著降低资源占用和延迟，且结合非结构化剪枝可进一步减少LUT和FF，验证了硬件感知进化搜索在QNN部署中的有效性。

Abstract: FPGAs are well suited to deploying quantised neural networks (QNNs) under strict accuracy, latency, and resource constraints; however, identifying efficient model-accelerator combinations commonly requires extensive manual design-space exploration and repeated hardware synthesis. This paper presents FINNAS, a FINN-guided hardware-aware evolutionary neural architecture search framework. FINNAS jointly searches quantised MLP depth, width, and global precision settings, and ranks candidates using proxy validation accuracy together with FINN-estimated LUT usage and latency under a fully parallel mapping. Selected finalists are fully retrained, subjected to post-search unstructured pruning, and validated using RTL simulation and Vivado out-of-context synthesis. On the CERNBox jet substructure classification task, the searched implementations expose competitive accuracy-resource trade-offs. Compared with a manually optimised dense FINN accelerator, a compact FINNAS design improves accuracy from 73.78\% to 74.36\%, while reducing LUT usage by \(8.5\times\) and RTL-simulation latency by \(1.77\times\). Unstructured pruning further provides consistent LUT and FF reductions across the fully parallel finalists.

</details>


### [411] [ScaleLUT: A Fully-Parallel Configurable LUT-Based Accelerator for Real-Time Multi-Scale Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16508)
*Boyu Li,Chenchen Ding,Zhilin Ai,Wenqing Shi,Baizhou Jiang,Wenyong Zhou,Binxiao Huang,Jiachen Ren,Hao Yu,Ngai Wong*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: ScaleLUT 是一种面向硬件的查找表（LUT）超分辨率设计与全并行可重构加速器，支持实时多尺度 SR；在 ZCU102 FPGA 上实现 4K x2 达 95.3 FPS，并在 LUT、触发器、DSP 与功耗上显著优于现有方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备上的实时超分辨率（SR）受限于深度学习方法的巨大乘累加（MAC）运算、资源与功耗开销；现有基于 LUT 的 SR 虽以查表替代卷积推理降低计算，但仍存在速度受限、存储开销大、跨上采样因子扩展性差的问题。因此需要算法-硬件协同设计以实现实用且能效高的边缘 SR 部署。

Method: 提出 ScaleLUT：一种面向硬件的 LUT 设计框架与全并行可重构加速器。方法上结合硬件友好的 YUV 域策略、2 的幂次核与旋转集成，以提升感受野覆盖并降低 LUT 维度；用移位替代除法操作；采用深度流水线与大规模并行架构，支持任意输入分辨率和可配置的 x2^n 上采样因子。

Result: 相较最先进的基于 LUT 的 SR 方法，内存降低 18.4%。在 Xilinx ZCU102 FPGA 上，300 MHz 下实现 x2 放大实时 4K SR 达 95.3 FPS。与现有 SR 加速器相比，LUT 至少减少 58.6%，触发器减少 41.1%，DSP 为零，功耗降低 42.0%；相较最佳 CPU 实现和先前 FPGA 加速器分别获得 10x 和 1.2x 加速。

Conclusion: 结果表明，LUT 算法与硬件的联合协同设计对实用且能效高的边缘 SR 部署是有效的。

Abstract: Real-time super-resolution (SR) remains challenging for edge devices because deep-learning-based methods require substantial multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations, resources, and power. Lookup-table (LUT)-based SR reduces computation by replacing convolutional inference with table queries, but existing methods still suffer from limited speed, large storage overhead, and poor scalability across upsampling factors. We present ScaleLUT, a hardware-oriented LUT design framework and fully parallel reconfigurable accelerator for real-time multi-scale SR. ScaleLUT combines a hardware-friendly YUV-domain strategy with power-of-two kernels and rotation ensemble to improve receptive-field coverage while reducing LUT dimensionality; division operations are replaced by shifts. These designs reduce memory by 18.4% over state-of-the-art LUT-based SR methods. ScaleLUT supports arbitrary input resolutions and configurable x2^n upsampling factors using a deeply pipelined, massively parallel architecture. Implemented on a Xilinx ZCU102 FPGA, it achieves real-time 4K SR at 95.3 FPS for x2 upscaling at 300 MHz. Compared with existing SR accelerators, ScaleLUT uses at least 58.6% fewer LUTs, 41.1% fewer flip-flops, zero DSPs, and 42.0% lower power, while delivering 10x and 1.2x speedups over the best CPU-based SR implementation and prior FPGA-based SR accelerators, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of joint LUT algorithm-hardware co-design for practical and energy-efficient edge SR deployment.

</details>


### [412] [A 420 GOPS/W CGRA with a Configurable MAC and Dynamic Truncation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16600)
*Yi Sheng Chong,Rakshith Harish,Rajesh Chandrasekhara Panicker,Vishnu P. Nambiar,Anh Tuan Do*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种具有可配置MAC单元的粗粒度可重构架构（CGRA），使PE能在单周期内完成ADD、MUL或MAC运算，并可通过截断模块调节MAC结果读出精度；采用40nm CMOS实现，在0.6V、21MHz下能效达420.6GOPS/W，为当前最优水平的1.4倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备需要高效且灵活的处理能力以应对动态实时负载。CGRA兼具通用处理器的灵活性与接近专用加速器的高能效，是边缘设备的理想候选。但典型CGRA执行一次MAC需两个周期，而神经网络推理和信号处理等负载包含大量MAC操作，导致其处理时间过长。

Method: 在PE中设计可配置MAC单元，使同一个乘法器与加法器可在单周期内完成加法、乘法或乘累加；并引入截断模块调节MAC结果的读出精度；芯片基于40nm CMOS工艺实现。

Result: 在0.6V供电、21MHz频率下实现420.6GOPS/W的能效，比现有最优方案高1.4倍。

Conclusion: 该可配置MAC的CGRA有效解决了传统CGRA的MAC两周期瓶颈，在保持灵活性的同时显著提升边缘计算能效。

Abstract: Edge devices demand for highly efficient yet flexible processing capability to handle dynamic real-time workloads. Coarse grain reconfigurable architecture (CGRA) emerges as a suitable accelerator candidate in edge devices, because they are as flexible as general purpose processors and offer high efficiency close to that of domain specific accelerators. However, a typical CGRA requires two cycles for a multiply-and-accumulate (MAC) operation, and workloads such as neural network inference and signal processing involve many MAC operations, resulting in long CGRA processing time. This work proposes a CGRA that has configurable MAC units in the processing elements (PEs) that can perform an addition (ADD) or multiplication (MUL) or a MAC by using the same multiplier and adder, in a single cycle. The readout precision of MAC result can be adjusted by a truncation block. The proposed CGRA is implemented with 40nm CMOS technology. It attains an energy efficiency of 420.6GOPS/W operating at supply of 0.6V and frequency of 21MHz, which is 1.4 times higher than the state-of-the-art.

</details>


### [413] [SpecLens: LLM-Based Verilog Generation with Specification-Derived Constraints via Behavioral Divergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16729)
*Wen Bing,Bing Li*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: SpecLens：通过分析多个候选实现间的行为差异，自动推导规格驱动约束，用于LLM的Verilog生成，在VerilogEval v2.0上功能pass@1达86.2%~89.4%，超越当前SOTA提示方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从自然语言规格直接生成功能正确的RTL仍然极具挑战。现有方法主要依赖RAG、自规划或少样本提示等外部或通用形式的增强，并未从任务特定约束角度强化规格本身。

Method: 提出SpecLens自动化框架：以原始规格作为生成过程中唯一的外部语义来源，通过分析多个候选实现之间的行为分歧来推导规格驱动的约束。

Result: 在VerilogEval v2.0的spec-to-RTL基准上，o3-mini-medium达86.2%功能pass@1，o3-mini-high达89.4%，分别较SOTA提示方法提升3.6个百分点、较SOTA行为分歧方法提升3.8个百分点。在RTLLM v1.1和v2.0上，SpecLens更忠实于规格、更少依赖基准对齐先验。语法正确率：VerilogEval v2.0为100%，RTLLM v1.1为86.2%，RTLLM v2.0为88%，且无需昂贵的编译-修复迭代循环。

Conclusion: SpecLens通过规格驱动约束有效提升LLM生成Verilog的功能正确性与规格忠实性，减少对基准先验和迭代修复的依赖，代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown promise in Verilog generation, but producing functionally correct RTL directly from natural-language specifications remains a highly challenging task. Existing approaches improve LLM-based Verilog generation mainly with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), self-planning, or few-shot prompting. However, these methods focus primarily on external or generic forms of enhancement rather than strengthening the specification with task-specific constraints. In this work, we propose SpecLens, an automated framework for LLM-based Verilog generation that derives specification-driven constraints by analyzing behavioral divergence among multiple candidate implementations, using the original specification as the only external semantic source during generation. On the VerilogEval v2.0 spec-to-RTL benchmark, SpecLens achieves a functional pass@1 ratio of 86.2\% with o3-mini-medium and 89.4\% with o3-mini-high. This corresponds to a 3.6 percentage-point gain over the SOTA prompting method with o3-mini-medium and a 3.8 percentage-point gain over the SOTA behavioral divergence method with o3-mini-high. In addition, on RTLLM v1.1 and v2.0, analysis shows that SpecLens is more specification-faithful and less prone to benchmark-aligned priors. SpecLens achieves 100\% syntactic correctness on VerilogEval v2.0, 86.2\% on RTLLM v1.1, and 88\% on RTLLM v2.0, even without using costly compile-repair loops to revise generated code iteratively. The code is open source and available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SpecLens-4632/readme.md.

</details>


### [414] [Carry-Through Checksum: A Lightweight Fault-Detection for CNN Inference at the Edge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16742)
*Kyrylo Nazarevych,Mohammad Hasan Ahmadilivani,Krister Kaldre,Davide Bertozzi,Jaan Raik*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出carry-through checksum方案，通过在卷积层嵌入专用校验滤波器实现CNN推理软错误端到端检测，FP32/FP16关键故障检测率分别达95.86%和86.56%，几乎无额外单图开销，重执行缓解仅增加2.27%运行时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CNN日益部署于安全攸关的边缘应用，软错误会静默破坏推理输出导致不安全决策。这类应用依赖资源受限的嵌入式GPU，需要低计算、低内存、低延迟且能无缝集成标准GPU推理流水线的故障检测与缓解技术。现有基于算法的容错技术依赖矩阵扩充和逐操作校验和验证，开销过大，不适用于嵌入式GPU上的CNN推理。

Method: 提出carry-through checksum（贯通校验和）方案：在卷积层中嵌入专用carry-through滤波器，利用CNN自身运算计算校验和，并使其贯穿整个推理过程传播，从而仅通过一次输出验证即可实现端到端错误检测。

Result: 在多种CNN架构上实验表明，该方法对FP32和FP16分别检测出95.86%和86.56%的关键故障，且几乎不增加每张图像的额外开销；检测到的故障通过重执行进行缓解，在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX GPU上整个测试集仅产生2.27%的运行时间开销。

Conclusion: carry-through checksum为嵌入式GPU上CNN推理提供了一种低开销、可无缝集成的软错误检测与缓解方案，在保持高关键故障检测率的同时实现了近乎可忽略的性能损失。

Abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical edge applications, where soft errors can silently corrupt inference outputs and lead to unsafe decisions. Such applications typically rely on resource-constrained embedded GPUs, requiring fault detection and mitigation techniques that add minimal compute, memory, and latency overhead while integrating seamlessly with the standard GPU inference pipeline. Existing algorithm-based fault tolerance techniques rely on matrix augmentation and per-operation checksum verification, imposing substantial overhead that is prohibitive for CNN inference on embedded GPUs.
  In this work, we propose carry-through checksum, a fundamentally new scheme for soft-error detection in CNN inference on embedded GPUs. The method embeds dedicated carry-through filters into the convolutional layers, which compute a checksum from the CNN's own operations and propagate it through inference, enabling end-to-end error detection with a single output verification. Experimental results on multiple CNN architectures show that the proposed method detects 95.86% and 86.56% of critical faults for FP32 and FP16, respectively, at almost no additional per-image overhead. Detected faults are mitigated through re-execution, incurring only 2.27% run-time overhead across the entire test set on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX GPU.

</details>


### [415] [OptiPrime: Optimizing Private Inference through Protocol-Hardware Co-design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16898)
*Jiangrui Yu,Ye Yu,Si Chen,Chenqi Lin,Wenxuan Zeng,Junfeng Fan,Mingyu Gao,Meng Li*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该论文提出OptiPrime，一种协议-硬件协同优化框架，用于高效私有深度神经网络推理，通过新型同态加密卷积协议减少传输的密文数量，并结合权值明文压缩与专用数据流缓解内存与网络瓶颈，端到端性能较Cheetah提升最高5.7倍（CPU）和4.2倍（加速器）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于混合同态加密（HE）与多方安全计算（MPC）的私有DNN推理虽能提供形式化隐私保证，但HE带来严重延迟开销。现有定制HE加速器对单个HE操作可实现数量级加速，但直接将其应用于先进HE-MPC框架时，端到端性能提升有限，原因在于HE-MPC框架通常需要对每次HE操作的输入输出密文进行无线传输，造成严重的网络通信瓶颈。

Method: 提出协议-硬件协同优化框架OptiPrime。其一，设计新型HE卷积协议，显著减少传输的输出密文数量，缓解网络通信瓶颈；其二，针对新协议为减少输出密文而引入的复杂计算、大量权值明文与中间密文带来的新内存访问挑战，提出轻量级权值明文压缩系统（将内存流量降低10倍），并设计专用数据流以最大化中间密文的片上数据复用。

Result: 大量实验表明，该框架在CPU上最多比Cheetah基线快5.7倍，在配备加速器时最多快4.2倍。

Conclusion: 通过协议与硬件的协同优化，可在保持私有DNN推理形式化隐私保证的前提下，有效突破HE-MPC框架的网络通信与内存访问瓶颈，显著提升端到端性能。

Abstract: Private deep neural network (DNN) inference based on hybrid homomorphic encryption (HE) and multi-party computation (MPC) can protect user data with a formal guarantee, but at the cost of significant latency overhead due to HE. Customized HE accelerators have been proposed and have achieved orders-of-magnitude speedup for individual HE operations. However, when directly applying a commercial HE accelerator to state-of-the-art HE-MPC frameworks, we observe only limited end-to-end performance gain. This is because HE-MPC frameworks often require wireless transmission of input and output ciphertexts for each HE operation, leading to a severe network communication bottleneck. To overcome this challenge, we introduce OptiPrime, a protocol-hardware co-optimization framework for efficient private DNN inference. OptiPrime features a novel HE protocol for convolutions that substantially reduces the number of transmitted output ciphertexts and mitigates the network communication bottleneck. Meanwhile, as the new protocol introduces complex computation for fewer output ciphertext, we observe new memory access challenges due to a high volume of weight plaintexts and intermediate ciphertexts. Hence, we further propose a lightweight compression system for the weight plaintexts, reducing memory traffic by 10 times, as well as a specialized dataflow to maximize on-chip data reuse of intermediate ciphertexts. Extensive experiments show that our framework outperforms the Cheetah baseline by at most 5.7 times on CPUs and 4.2 times with an accelerator.

</details>


### [416] [Budgeted Express-Mesh: Traffic-Aware Link Placement and Deadlock-Free Adaptive Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17057)
*Li Cao,Jingyuan Ma*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出 Budgeted Express-Mesh 拓扑-路由协同设计，在固定布线预算下引入少量流量感知快速链路，通过 ASPL 贪心布局+仿真引导退火优化拓扑，并用 committed top-K 路由降低拥塞，跨四类负载稳定提升高负载吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在固定布线预算约束下，Mesh 网络高负载吞吐受限；随机添加快速链路收益不稳定，需要拓扑与路由协同优化，并应对延迟、量化拥塞信息等现实约束。

Method: 拓扑侧用基于 ASPL 的贪心放置，再用仿真引导退火精化；路由侧采用 committed top-K 路由，依据延迟的快速链路拥塞与预留信号选择路径。

Result: 四类合成负载下，优化布局较 Mesh 与随机布局持续提升高负载吞吐，退火优于纯贪心；在延迟量化拥塞、更长快速链路时延、multi-flit 包及 16×16 异构负载下增益仍保持。

Conclusion: 流量感知快速链路+协同路由能在有限布线预算内有效缓解拥塞，方案对延迟与异构条件鲁棒，具备可扩展性与实际部署潜力。

Abstract: We present Budgeted Express-Mesh, a topology-routing co-design that adds a small number of traffic-aware express links under a fixed wire budget. An ASPL-based greedy placement is refined by simulation-guided annealing, while packets use committed top-K routes selected from delayed express-link congestion and reservation signals. Across four synthetic workloads, optimized placements consistently improve high-load throughput over Mesh and random placement, and annealing further improves Greedy. The gains persist under delayed quantized congestion information, longer express-link latency, multi-flit packets, and a 16-by-16 heterogeneous workload.

</details>


<div id='cs.DC'></div>

# cs.DC [[Back]](#toc)

### [417] [Novel Iterative Construction Methods for the Blocking Job Shop Scheduling Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16007)
*Adel Dabah,Karima Rihane,Hocine Saadi,Andreas Herten,Farouk Benslimane,Mohammed Lamine Bahmani,Abdelhakim Aitzai*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 针对阻塞作业车间调度问题，提出基于束搜索的BS-ICH、并行PMS-BS及GPU加速G-PMS-BS，并在标准算例上刷新大量最优解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阻塞作业车间调度问题（BJSSP）在无中间存储的制造、生产、物流与服务场景中普遍存在。由于可行解占搜索空间比例极低，元启发式方法难以高效求解，因此需要设计更高效的求解策略。

Method: 提出三种束搜索启发式：BS-ICH通过迭代扩展部分解并维护宽度为k的束以保留多个高质量部分调度；PMS-BS并行运行大量带机器偏置多样性的BS-ICH实例以扩大搜索空间并跳出局部最优；G-PMS-BS将束扩展卸载至GPU，采用两阶段核架构分离轻量打分与定向状态重建，支持2000个工序规模；混合CPU+GPU模式利用空闲主机核心并采用负载均衡降低同步开销。

Result: G-PMS-BS相对CPU基线取得44倍加速；在全部标准Lawrence与Taillard算例上，G-PMS-BS为22个Lawrence基准和77个Taillard实例刷新最优已知解，最大100x20实例的最大完工时间最多降低13%。

Conclusion: 束搜索结合并行与GPU加速可有效求解BJSSP，显著提升求解效率与解质量，并为大规模实例提供可扩展的高性能求解方案。

Abstract: The Blocking Job-Shop Scheduling Problem (BJSSP) arises in modern and complex manufacturing, production, logistics, and service where no intermediate storage is allowed between consecutive operations. This creates a significant challenge for meta-heuristics due to the low ratio of feasible to explored solutions when solving the problem. To address this problem efficiently, we propose three new beam-search-based heuristics: the Beam Search Iterative Construction Heuristic (BS-ICH), its CPU-parallel extension Parallel Multi-Strategy Beam Search (PMS-BS), and a GPU-accelerated variants G-PMS-BS. BS-ICH constructs feasible schedules by iteratively extending partial solutions, while maintaining a beam of width k to preserve multiple high-quality partial schedules. PMS-BS runs hundreds of parallel BS-ICH instances with machine-biased diversity to expand the search space and escape local optima. G-PMS-BS offloads the beam expansion onto massively parallel GPU hardware using a two-phase kernel architecture that separates lightweight scoring from targeted state reconstruction, enabling scaling to instances with 2,000 operations. A hybrid CPU+GPU mode further exploits idle host cores for concurrent exploration, using load-balancing strategy to minimize synchronization overhead. G-PMS-BS achieves a 44x speedup over the CPU baseline. Experiments on all standard Lawrence and Taillard instances demonstrate that G-PMS-BS establishes new best-known results for 22 Lawrence benchmarks and 77 Taillard instances, with makespan reductions of up to 13% on the largest 100x20 instances.

</details>


### [418] [Co-Skill: A Collaborative Communication Framework for Skill Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16008)
*Yilin Ma,Yangi Pan,Weihao Yang,Peixin Zeng,Jiannan Xu,Hao Huang,Wen Xia*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出协作通信框架（CCF），通过云感知前缀合并轨迹Trie、边缘感知渐进式技能树和协同技能演化三种技术，解决云端LLM与边缘SLM之间"盲目通信"问题，在降低成本的同时提升任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的智能体通过技能演化迭代提升任务成功率至关重要。混合演化（云LLM生成技能、边缘SLM执行内化）是成本高效的范式，但现有方法（如SkillRL）成功率低、token消耗高。作者发现根本原因是"盲目通信"：云端无法感知边缘执行能力，边缘不理解云端分析需求。

Method: CCF包含三项技术：(1) 云感知前缀合并轨迹Trie——边缘通过合并共享前缀压缩轨迹并定位分歧点，供云端高效分析；(2) 边缘感知渐进式技能树——云端渐进构建分层技能树以匹配边缘SLM执行能力；(3) 基于上述两棵树的协同技能演化方案——将云LLM与边缘SLM分离演化，共同提升任务成功率。

Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上实验表明，CCF相比最先进的混合方法减少LLM+SLM token 15.6%–41.9%，同时任务成功率持续提升25.8%–76.4%。

Conclusion: 通过让云端与边缘双向感知、协同演化，CCF实现了有效的边缘-云演化，在降低成本的同时显著提升任务成功率，验证了解决"盲目通信"问题的有效性。

Abstract: Agent evolution through skills becomes critical for LLM-based agents to iteratively improve task success rate. Hybrid evolution is a cost-efficient paradigm where a cloud LLM analyzes and generates skills while an edge SLM executes and internalizes them. However, existing hybrid methods, such as SkillRL, still suffer from low success rate and high token usage. We find this stems from blind communication: the cloud cannot perceive the edge's execution capability, while the edge does not understand the cloud's analysis needs.
  We thus propose the Collaborative Communication Framework (CCF) to achieve effective edge-cloud evolution. CCF is realized via three techniques: (1) a cloud-aware prefix-merged trajectory trie where the edge compresses trajectories by merging shared prefixes and pinpointing divergence points for efficient cloud analysis, (2) an edge-aware progressive skill tree where the cloud progressively builds a hierarchical skill tree to match edge SLM execution capability, and (3) a collaborative skill evolution scheme upon these two trees that evolves cloud LLM and edge SLM in a separated way to jointly improve task success rate. Experiments across ALFWorld and WebShop show that CCF reduces LLM+SLM tokens by 15.6%--41.9% over state-of-the-art hybrid methods while consistently improving 25.8%--76.4% task success rate.

</details>


### [419] [Vectorization Of Narrow Matrix Multiplication for Ascend AI Inference Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16009)
*Anton Shurygin,Aleksandr Frolov*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出并评估了一种在华为昇腾NPU上优化矩阵乘法（MatMul）的新方法，通过利用AscendC向量指令将计算从Cube单元（AIC）卸载到Vector单元（AIV），在MLA DeepSeek-V3算子推理加速中实现了单token场景平均20%的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心洞察是：在矩阵-向量乘法（窄MatMul）过程中，Cube单元（AIC）常常未被充分利用，而Vector单元（AIV）在算子运行的大部分时间内处于空闲状态，造成算力浪费。此外，尽管存在官方文档和活跃的CANN社区，关于AscendC实际优化技术的文献仍存在明显空白。

Method: 提出一种MatMul算法，使用AscendC的向量指令，将部分计算从Cube单元有效卸载至Vector单元，从而实现AIV与AIC计算的overlap（重叠执行）。该算法被测应用于加速MLA DeepSeek-V3算子的推理。

Result: 通过成功重叠AIV与AIC计算，在单token处理场景下实现了平均20%的性能增益。

Conclusion: 该工作为AscendC的实际优化技术提供了有价值的实践补充，填补了相关文献空白，验证了在窄MatMul场景下跨单元卸载与计算重叠策略的有效性。

Abstract: This research proposes and evaluates a novel approach to optimizing matrix multiplication (MatMul) on Huawei Ascend NPUs, motivated by a key insight: during matrix-vector multiplication (narrow MatMul), the Cube Unit (AIC) is often underutilized, while the Vector Unit (AIV) remains idle for most of the operator runtime. In this paper, we introduce the MatMul algorithm, which uses vector instructions of AscendC to effectively offload computations from the Cube Unit to the Vector Unit. The algorithm was tested and applied to accelerating the inference of MLA DeepSeek-V3 operator. By successfully overlapping AIV and AIC computations, our optimization showed a mean performance gain of 20% for a single token processing scenario. Our work addresses a significant gap in the literature on practical optimization techniques for AscendC, despite the availability of documentation and the active CANN community.

</details>


### [420] [BOA: Beamwidth Online Adaptation for Filtered-ANNS on a GPU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16175)
*Farhana Akter Tumpa,Rajiv Gupta*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出单GPU过滤式ANNS引擎BOA，通过对批次内查询进行在线beamwidth自适应，在多阶段搜索中先用窄束筛选、仅对不确定结果逐步加宽，从而大幅提升吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过滤式近似最近邻搜索中，图方法通常对批次查询统一使用固定高beamwidth（≥100）以保证召回率，但观察发现多数查询用≤50的beamwidth即可精确求解，固定高beamwidth为少数困难查询牺牲了整体吞吐。

Method: BOA采用在线beamwidth自适应，在多属性范围过滤下对批次内查询定制搜索力度；采用多阶段搜索：所有查询先在窄beam下评估，仅对结果不确定的查询逐步扩大beamwidth。BOA+进一步重叠各阶段执行以提升吞吐。

Result: 在10,000条查询上，在线自适应在平均beamwidth为22至77时实现94.05%至99.96%召回；非自适应方法需固定beamwidth 500才能达到相近或更低召回。自适应使吞吐量提升7倍至12.5倍。

Conclusion: BOA通过在线beamwidth自适应与多阶段搜索，有效缓解召回-吞吐权衡，使召回对起始beamwidth不敏感，相比固定高beamwidth方案显著提升吞吐，并可通过阶段重叠（BOA+）进一步优化。

Abstract: Filtered approximate nearest neighbor search, i.e. returning the top-k vectors nearest to a query vector among those satisfying one or more attribute predicates, has become a fundamental operation in modern vector search systems. Graph-based solutions employ beam search to solve a batch of queries in parallel for high throughput and employ high fixed beamwidth of 100 or greater for ensuring high recall. We observe that, given a batch of queries, more than half of the queries across multiple data sets can be solved precisely with a beamwidth of just 50 or less. Therefore, existing systems based on fixed high beamwidth sacrifice throughput to achieve high recall by forcing every query to search as thoroughly as the hardest query in the batch even though majority of queries can be resolved by a shallow search. In this paper we present a filtered ANNS engine for a single GPU named BOA that uses online beamwidth adaptation to customize the search effort across queries within a batch under multi-attribute range filters. We address the recall throughput tradeoff with a multi-phase search: all queries are first evaluated under a narrow beam, and only those with uncertain results are progressively refined with wider beamwidths. This renders recall largely insensitive to the starting beamwidth, whereas prior methods must use a fixed high beamwidth for high recall. BOA+ overlaps execution of phases to further enhance throughput. Our experiments show that, for 10,000 queries, online adaptation achieves 94.05% to 99.96% recall with average beamwidth ranging from 22 to 77, while a non-adaptive approach requires a fixed beamwidth of 500 to achieve similar or lower recall. Consequently, adaptivity increases throughput by 7x to 12.5x

</details>


### [421] [Cognitive Admission Control: Risk-Conditioned Assurance for Consequential Actions in Agentic Distributed Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16313)
*Jun He,Deying Yu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 论文提出"认知准入控制"(CAC)，为代理型分布式系统中的外部基础设施变更建立显式证据要求，通过策略化的担保义务与确定性评估器区分已满足/违反/未决义务，未决条件触发定向证据获取，成功准入产出发证；TypeScript原型在2,730次受控本地试验中验证，390次CAC试验无一有害效应，而活策略基线虽完成数相同却接纳了构造的相关性见证失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在代理型分布式系统中，代理可能被授权变更外部基础设施，但缺乏"变更已具备执行就绪性"的证据。这种"授权"与"就绪"之间的缺口是核心风险来源：仅凭授权并不能保证变更安全，因此需要把证据要求显式化、可评估化。

Method: 提出CAC框架：策略将类型化动作及其建模风险映射为担保义务，义务规定谓词、证据类别、范围、时效性与见证集约束；确定性评估器将义务判定为已满足、违反或未决，未决条件生成定向的证据获取请求；成功准入产生绑定动作、见证清单与派发时守卫的证书。形式化准入演算及连接受中介执行的假设，并用TypeScript原型实现，在2,730次受控本地试验（含独立效应观测与匹配故障调度）中评估，并通过机制消融隔离守卫、证据类别、结构割与补救行为。

Result: 390次CAC试验中120个效应在无建模危害下完成，且未发生有害效应；活策略基线完成数相同，但接纳了构造的相关性见证失效。机制消融分别隔离出守卫、证据类别、结构割与补救行为的作用。另有9,000次测量覆盖含持久重放保护的完整本地派发路径。作者强调这些结果仅确立已测试的实现行为与本地开销，而非生产故障率或语言模型能力比较。

Conclusion: CAC将"证据就绪性"作为准入的显式条件，其保证是策略相对的：物理安全还需可靠证据、充分的环境模型以及效应过程中相关条件的保持。实验支持该实现在本地受控条件下的有效性与成本，但不外推至生产故障率或模型能力比较。

Abstract: In agentic distributed systems, an agent may be authorized to mutate external infrastructure while lacking evidence that the mutation is ready to execute. Cognitive Admission Control (CAC) makes this evidence requirement explicit. A policy maps a typed action and its modeled risk to assurance obligations specifying predicates, evidence classes, scope, freshness, and witness-set constraints. A deterministic evaluator distinguishes satisfied, violated, and unresolved obligations; unresolved conditions produce targeted evidence-acquisition requests. Successful admission produces a certificate binding the action, its witness manifest, and dispatch-time guards.
  We formalize the admission calculus and the assumptions connecting it to mediated execution. The guarantees are policy-relative: physical safety additionally requires sound evidence, an adequate environment model, and preservation of relevant conditions through the effect. A TypeScript prototype is evaluated in 2,730 controlled local trials with independent effect observation and matched fault schedules. Across 390 CAC trials, 120 effects complete without modeled harm and no harmful effects occur. A live-policy baseline achieves the same completion count but admits the constructed correlated-witness failure. Mechanism ablations isolate guard, evidence-class, structural-cut, and remediation behavior. A further 9,000 measurements exercise the complete local dispatch path with persistent replay protection. These results establish tested implementation behaviors and local costs, not production failure rates or comparisons of language-model capability.

</details>


### [422] [PipeSwift: Revisiting Pipeline Parallelism for Large-Scale Completion-Oriented Agentic Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16491)
*Shiju Wang,Fei Ren,Fangcheng Fu,Zhanhong Tan,Kairui Li,Jingwei Cai,Kaisheng Ma*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM智能体（agent）工作负载以完成时间为目标的特点，重新审视调度与并行策略，提出兼顾预填充-解码效率平衡的流水线并行运行时，显著降低作业完成时间（JCT）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体执行长时程工作流，其响应决定后续工具交互与环境转换的进展。与传统聊天服务受TTFT、TPOT等令牌级SLO约束不同，智能体工作负载日益由完成时间主导。这一转变对现有围绕令牌级SLO优化的LLM服务设计构成挑战。

Method: 作者在完成导向目标下系统探索调度与并行策略：分析预填充与解码效率的平衡对JCT的影响；构建名为\name{}的开源流水线并行运行时，通过JCT感知的调度层与流水线集成的多令牌预测（multi-token prediction）实现调度与并行的协同设计。

Result: 预填充优先调度虽实现最佳TTFT与解码吞吐，但JCT次优；跨调度策略空间完成时间差异可达1.40倍，最优解不在任一极端。流水线并行（PP）通过提供有利的预填充-解码权衡有利于JCT。在64块H800 GPU上，用两个360B+ MoE模型对真实编码与网页搜索智能体轨迹做确定性回放评估，\name{}相较SGLang wide-EP降低JCT达1.45倍，较vLLM PP2达2.33倍，较当前最先进开源PD分离部署达1.54倍。

Conclusion: 以完成时间为导向的目标改变了LLM服务的最优调度与并行选择：预填充-解码效率的平衡是JCT的关键，流水线并行被重新证明具有价值，调度与并行的协同设计可大幅降低智能体工作负载的作业完成时间。

Abstract: LLM agents execute long-horizon workflows where each model response determines the progress of subsequent tool interactions and environment transitions. Unlike chatbot serving, where TTFT and TPOT SLO constraints are critical, agentic workloads are increasingly governed by completion time. This shift challenges existing LLM serving designs, which are optimized around token-level SLOs.
  We revisit scheduling and parallelism under this completion-oriented objective. Through systematic exploration, we show that job completion time (JCT) is governed by the balance between prefill and decode efficiency. Prefill-prioritized scheduling, while achieving the best TTFT and decode throughput, renders suboptimal JCT; across the scheduling-policy space, completion time varies by up to 1.40$\times$, with the optimum at neither extreme. We further show that pipeline parallelism (PP), previously overlooked due to its limited decode latency advantage, benefits JCT by providing a favorable balance of prefill--decode trade-off.
  Based on these insights, we build \name{}, an optimized open-source pipeline-parallel runtime that co-designs scheduling and parallelism through a JCT-aware scheduling layer and pipeline-integrated multi-token prediction. Evaluated on deterministic replays of real coding and web-search agent trajectories with two 360B+ MoE models on 64 H800 GPUs, \name{} reduces overall JCT by up to 1.45$\times$ over SGLang wide-EP, 2.33$\times$ over vLLM PP2, and 1.54$\times$ over today's state-of-the-art open-source PD-disaggregated deployment.

</details>


### [423] [XMPIaaS: Towards Cloud Native MPI via Cooperative Process Migration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16531)
*Shunyu Yao,Dimitrios S. Nikolopoulos,Ali R. Butt*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出 \name，一种面向 MPI 的协作式迁移系统，支持运行时选择性进程组迁移，通过 XMPI\_quiesce 接口与扩展 Hydra 实现静默、CRIU 检查点/恢复、代理重启与无缝重连，停机仅取决于迁移节点 rank 数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云环境具有资源短暂、动态定价、可抢占实例等特性，与超算不同；MPI 在云上需在不重启作业的情况下迁移运行中进程。现有方法要么依赖全局检查点重启整个作业，要么需透明拦截完整 MPI 栈，复杂度高。

Method: 协作式迁移系统：在 MPI Sessions API 之上暴露 XMPI\_quiesce 接口，让应用标记安全迁移点；扩展 Hydra 进程管理器编排迁移生命周期——rank 静默、CRIU 检查点/恢复、目标节点代理重启、rank 无缝重连；仅迁移受影响 rank，其余进程短暂静默后原地恢复。

Result: 协作式静默阶段占总迁移停机时间不足 1.4%；停机时间仅由迁移节点的 rank 数量决定，与作业规模无关；插桩在正常执行期间无可测量开销。

Conclusion: 该协作迁移方案以低复杂度实现按需选择性迁移，避免全作业检查点开销，具备可扩展性与低开销特性，适用于云上 MPI 的成本高效、弹性执行。

Abstract: Message Passing Interface (MPI) has been the dominant programming model for High Performance Computing (HPC) for three decades, and as HPC workloads increasingly migrate to cloud infrastructure for scalability and cost efficiency, MPI applications must contend with an execution environment fundamentally unlike traditional supercomputers: ephemeral resources, dynamic pricing and preemptable instances. In such a volatile setting, the ability to relocate running MPI processes between nodes without restarting the job is a necessity for cost-effective, resilient execution. Existing approaches either require restarting the entire job from a global checkpoint, or transparently intercepting the full MPI stack at prohibitive complexity. To address these challenges, we propose \name, a cooperative migration system for MPI that enables selective process group migration on-the-fly. When a cloud instance is scheduled for preemption, only the affected ranks are relocated while the remaining processes briefly quiesce and resume in place, avoiding the cost of a full-job checkpoint. \name tackles this through a cooperative protocol between the MPI process management runtime and rank processes. We expose an \texttt{XMPI\_quiesce} interface built atop the MPI Sessions API that allows applications to mark safe migration points, and we extend the Hydra process manager to orchestrate the full migration lifecycle: rank quiescence, CRIU checkpoint/restore, proxy relaunch on the target node, and seamless rank reconnection. We evaluate and show that the cooperative quiesce phase accounts for less than 1.4\% of total migration downtime, and that this downtime is governed by the migrating node's rank count alone, independent of job size, and the instrumentation introduces no measurable overhead during normal execution.

</details>


### [424] [DeepShare: Assurance-Driven Deep Learning Job Scheduling for Multi-Tenant Clusters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16682)
*Jinghao Wang,Yihang Zhou,Xiao Zhou,Xinlei Zheng,Xiaoyang Sun,Tianyu Wo,Chunming Hu,Renyu Yang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出DeepShare调度器，以连续化的租户保障信号统一协调弹性配额借用、运行时预测、成本感知抢占与干扰感知MPS共置，从而在多租户GPU集群中同时提升利用率并降低排队延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多租户GPU集群常在租户排队延迟很长的情况下仍保持低利用率，原因在于配额控制、队列排序、抢占与GPU共享分别由不同的局部信号驱动，缺乏统一的运行时协调机制。

Method: DeepShare采用连续的租户保障信号作为运行时控制回路，统一协调四项机制：弹性配额借用、租户特定的运行时预测、成本感知的尽力抢占，以及干扰感知的MPS共置；同一保障信号还用于决定何时回收借出容量、何时使共享更保守。

Result: 在23,859个Venus作业与3,200个内部作业的trace驱动实验中，平均GPU利用率达70.58%，较最强非侵入式共享基线提升29.5%，平均排队延迟降低46%；在16-GPU Kubernetes测试床上，平均作业完成时间降低34%，保障型租户QoS合规率保持93%。

Conclusion: 将租户保障视为运行时控制回路，比独立优化配额、调度与资源共享能获得更优的利用率—QoS权衡。

Abstract: Multi-tenant GPU clusters frequently remain underutilized even when tenants experience long queueing delays, because quota control, queue ordering, preemption, and GPU sharing are driven by different local signals. We present DeepShare, a scheduler that uses a continuous tenant-assurance signal to coordinate these decisions at runtime. DeepShare combines elastic quota borrowing, tenant-specific runtime prediction, cost-aware best-effort preemption, and interference-aware MPS colocation, while using the same assurance signal to decide when borrowed capacity should be reclaimed and when sharing should become more conservative. In trace-driven experiments on 23,859 Venus jobs and 3,200 internal jobs, DeepShare achieves an average GPU utilization of 70.58%, a 29.5% improvement over the strongest non-intrusive sharing baseline, while reducing average queueing delay by 46%. On a 16-GPU Kubernetes testbed, it reduces the average job completion time by 34% and maintains 93% QoS compliance for guaranteed tenants. These results show that treating tenant assurance as a runtime control loop achieves a more advantageous utilization-QoS trade-off than optimizing quotas, scheduling, and resource sharing independently.

</details>


### [425] [The Price of Random Access: Measuring Block Granularity Across Four Compressed Formats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16731)
*Yakiv Shavidze*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文量化了"压缩数据随机访问"的密度代价：将254 MB归档切分为16 KiB独立可寻址单元，绝对偏移格式仅增加1.632%体积，而可寻址zstd增加6.57%；单元越小差距越大（4 KiB时为5.33% vs 10.06%）。低代价带来归档分割免费、追加无需改格式、寻址延迟恒定、CPU与GPU共用同一归档等特性，并给出三项带证明与逐位验证的结构性结果，同时公布17条被否决方向与全部测量数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通常认为对压缩数据进行随机访问必须以牺牲压缩密度为代价，但该"汇率"（即密度损失的具体量级）缺乏系统测量。作者希望在统一语料上量化这一权衡，并检验若代价足够小，是否能解锁一系列通常不可得的性质（如免费分割、免格式变更的追加、恒定寻址延迟、跨CPU/GPU解码）。

Method: 在统一语料库上，跨4种格式、9个维度进行测量，比较绝对偏移格式与可寻址zstd在16 KiB与4 KiB单元下的密度开销；提出三项结构性结果并给出证明与逐位验证：(1) LZ77解析的重复距离链构成替换幺半群，因此可在不触碰比特流的情况下进行前缀扫描；(2) 自重叠匹配是周期性的而非链式的；(3) 依赖深度可由编码器强制界定。每条测量极限均附带其成因机制，所有结论标注证据等级（命令可复现／附理由的实测／估计）。

Result: 16 KiB单元下，绝对偏移格式开销为1.632%，可寻址zstd为6.57%；缩小至4 KiB时分别为5.33%与10.06%，差距随单元缩小而扩大。归档分割无额外成本，在平铺输入上甚至带来-0.28%的收益；追加无需改变格式；寻址延迟与位置无关；同一归档可同时被CPU与GPU解码器读取。另列出17条被否决方案及其数据，其中一项可提升密度26%但被主动放弃。测量工具单独发布（DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22713364），含435条带来源记录。

Conclusion: 随机访问压缩数据的密度代价远比预期小，且在单元尺寸较大时仅为个位数百分比，因而使免费分割、免格式变更追加、恒定寻址延迟和异构（CPU/GPU）解码等性质成为可能。LZ77重复距离链的幺半群结构、自重叠匹配的周期性以及可编码器约束的依赖深度，为这些性质提供了形式化基础。作者同时公开被否决方向与完整测量记录，强调每条结论的证据等级，以保证可复现性与透明度。

Abstract: Random access into compressed data is normally bought with density. We measure the exchange rate. Across four formats and nine axes on a common corpus, the cost of cutting a 254 MB archive into independently addressable 16 KiB units is 1.632% of the archive for an absolute-offset format against 6.57% for seekable zstd, and the gap widens as the unit shrinks: at 4 KiB, 5.33% against 10.06%. Because the cost is small, several properties follow that are usually unavailable: splitting an archive is free and occasionally profitable (-0.28% on tiled input), append needs no format change, seek latency does not depend on position, and one archive is read by both a CPU and a GPU decoder. We give three structural results with proofs and bit-perfect verification - that the repeat-distance chain of an LZ77 parse forms a substitution monoid and is therefore prefix-scannable without touching the bitstream, that self-overlapping matches are periodic rather than chained, and that dependency depth admits an encoder-enforced bound - and we report each measured limit together with the mechanism that sets it. Seventeen rejected directions are listed with their numbers, including one that improved density by 26% and was declined. Every claim carries a level: reproducible by command, measured with a stated reason, or estimated. The measurement tool is released separately (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22713364) with 435 provenanced records.

</details>


### [426] [Nested Parallel von Neumann Architecture and Nested BSP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16787)
*Heng Liao*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 论文提出两项互锁扩展：将BSP递归嵌套为Nested BSP，将冯·诺依曼架构扩展为Nested Parallel von Neumann Architecture，并以统一总线(Unified Bus)实现端到端内存语义互联，论证百万级并行下"多处理器仍是一台计算机"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模AI算力的瓶颈已不再是单处理器性能，而是如何让大规模处理器集群在统一指挥下仍作为"一台计算机"运行。作者指出两个根深蒂固的错误惯性：(1)将"把多台计算机联网"误推为"得到一台更大的计算机"；(2)几乎所有设计都预设"主从"结构——主机支配设备、CPU支配加速器、中心支配边缘。

Method: 提出两层嵌套设计：软件层将经典BSP递归嵌套为Nested BSP，每一层内重复"并行推进—屏障—交换—聚合"四步，逐层递进，约束为各层各节点均为对等体(peer)；硬件层将冯·诺依曼架构扩展为Nested Parallel von Neumann Architecture，从封装(package)到自治域(autonomous zone)层层嵌套，由一条端到端的内存语义总线(Unified Bus)连通，实现"物理稀疏、逻辑紧凑"的完全对等互联。该架构与华为τ Scaling law配套：τ规律支配各层如何折叠时间，架构规律支配嵌套并行计算机如何逐层、逐对等地"站立"。

Result: 形成一套自洽的百万级并行计算范式：Nested BSP提供软件侧的递归并行执行模型，Nested Parallel von Neumann Architecture提供硬件侧从芯片封装到自治域的嵌套对等结构，Unified Bus作为贯穿端到端的内存语义互联，二者如套娃般相互嵌套，并与τ Scaling law形成时间折叠与结构组织的对应关系。

Conclusion: 论文完成两处范式扩展：BSP→Nested BSP，冯·诺依曼→Nested Parallel von Neumann Architecture。核心理念可概括为：τ折叠时间，对等并行逐层嵌套——多处理器，仍是一台计算机。

Abstract: Large-scale AI computing is no longer a contest of ''one stronger processor,'' but of how an army of processors under one command can still be one computer. This paper offers two interlocking extensions.
  First, extend BSP to Nested BSP. The Turing machine describes computation as a single tape, in sequence. A million processors need not a longer tape, but a battle plan nested layer within layer: at every layer, parallel work, barrier, exchange and aggregate, then the next phase. Every ``parallel advance'' inside a layer repeats the same four steps. Nested BSP extends classic BSP by nesting it recursively, a computing paradigm for million-scale parallelism, under one rule: every node at every layer is a peer.
  Second, extend von Neumann to the Nested Parallel von Neumann Architecture, and Unified Bus is its interconnect. Von Neumann taught us how to build one stored-program computer. The false extrapolation of eighty years was that wiring many computers into a network yields one larger computer. A second habit ran deeper: nearly every design assumes a master that commands and slaves that obey---host over device, CPU over accelerator, center over edge. The Nested Parallel Architecture extends that idea rather than discarding it. Two nesting dolls must fit: Nested BSP in software, and the Nested Parallel von Neumann Architecture from package to autonomous zone, joined by one memory-semantic bus end to end, with full peer equality: physically sparse, logically tight. It pairs with Huawei's $τ$ Scaling law: $τ$ governs how each layer folds time, while the Architecture governs how the nested parallel computer stands, layer by layer, peer by peer.
  In summary, the paper extends BSP to Nested BSP and extends von Neumann to the Nested Parallel von Neumann Architecture. $τ$ folds time, peer-equal parallelism nests layer by layer---many processors, still one computer.

</details>


### [427] [Byzantine Reliable Broadcast with Causal Ordering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17074)
*Mariarosaria Barbaraci,Christian Cachin*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文在拜占庭故障模型下研究可靠广播的消息因果序问题，指出经典happened-before定义因拜占庭进程可伪造、遗漏依赖信息而不充分（并以抢跑攻击为例证明），进而将可靠广播扩展为"外化本地潜在知识"，基于足够多正确进程的联合观测给出首个完整的因果消息序定义，刻画满足因果序的拜占庭可靠广播信道性质，并提出抗f<n/3最优故障、单实例比特复杂度O(n²(|m|+λ+n))的高效协议并完成正确性证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拜占庭故障下可靠广播与全序广播已有充分研究，但因果序研究较少，主要因拜占庭进程行为带来复杂性。现有方案几乎都把因果序构建在全序广播之上，可靠广播与因果序的结合罕见，且少数已有方案采用基于单进程事件的经典happened-before因果定义。该定义不足以在广播消息间强制因果序：拜占庭进程可对依赖信息撒谎、遗漏和伪造，从而违反自报事件间的因果序，且单一观察者无法区分这种操纵与正确行为。作者通过抢跑攻击说明该问题及其后果，因此需要重新定义因果消息序。

Method: 1) 将可靠广播扩展为"外化本地潜在知识"(externalize local potential knowledge)；2) 据此形式化拜占庭故障下可靠广播中首个完整的因果消息序定义，该定义基于足够大的正确进程组的联合观测而非单一进程自身视角；3) 基于该定义刻画保证因果序的拜占庭可靠广播信道应具备的性质；4) 提出满足这些性质的高效协议，容忍最优的f<n/3个拜占庭故障，单次广播载荷m的比特复杂度为O(n²(|m|+λ+n))，其中λ为消息m唯一密码标签的最大长度；5) 证明协议实现带因果序的拜占庭可靠广播。

Result: 揭示了经典happened-before因果定义在拜占庭环境下的不足，并以抢跑攻击展示其后果；提出基于联合观测的首个完整因果消息序定义；给出满足该定义的拜占庭可靠广播信道性质刻画；构造出可容忍f<n/3最优故障、比特复杂度O(n²(|m|+λ+n))的高效协议，并证明其正确性。

Conclusion: 在拜占庭故障模型下，传统基于单进程happened-before的因果序定义不足以约束广播消息间的因果序，需以足够多正确进程的联合观测为基础重新定义因果消息序。本文通过外化本地潜在知识完成了这一定义，刻画了相应信道性质，并给出达到最优容错与高效复杂度的协议，证明了可实现带因果序的拜占庭可靠广播。

Abstract: Reliable and total-order broadcasts in the Byzantine-fault model are well studied, but adding causal order has received comparatively little attention, largely due to the complexity that stems from actions of Byzantine processes. Existing solutions almost exclusively build causal ordering on top of total-order broadcast. The combination of causal order with reliable broadcast remains rare, and the few solutions that exist adopt the classical definition of causality based on events occurring at individual processes (the happened-before relation). This definition is not sufficient to enforce causal ordering among broadcast messages: Byzantine processes can lie about, omit, and forge dependency information and thereby violate the causal order among self-reported events. Such manipulations remain indistinguishable from correct behavior to any single observer. We demonstrate the issue and its consequences via a front-running attack.
  To close this gap, we extend the notion of reliable broadcast to externalize local potential knowledge. We use this to formalize the first complete definition of causal message ordering in reliable broadcast under Byzantine faults. Unlike the classical formalization, this notion is grounded in the joint observations of a sufficiently large group of correct processes rather than a process's own view. Building on this definition, we characterize the properties of a Byzantine reliable broadcast channel that guarantees causal ordering. We then present an efficient protocol that satisfies these properties: it is resilient to the optimal number of $f < n/3$ Byzantine faults and for one instance that broadcasts payload message~$m$, it has bit complexity $O(n^2(|m| + λ+ n))$, where $λ$ denotes the maximal size of a unique (cryptographic) label for~$m$. Finally, we prove the protocol achieves Byzantine reliable broadcast with causal ordering.

</details>


### [428] [DS2-Based Cross-Data-Space Interoperability for Precision Agriculture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17185)
*Katerina Kyriakou,Ilias Syrigos,Ioannis Moutsinas,Panagiotis Tzimotoudis,Thanasis Korakis*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出面向农业数据空间互操作的层次化参考架构，实现跨数据空间的安全、主权可控的数据产品与服务共享，并构建自动化生态以支持精准灌溉等农艺推荐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代精准农业虽尝试整合传统农业系统，但仍存在IoT数据碎片化、农民数据主权保护不足以及互操作性有限等问题，不同农业数据空间之间难以有效交换数据产品与服务。

Method: 在Horizon Europe DS2（DataSpace, DataShare 2.0）项目框架下，采用面向互操作的框架与分层参考架构；每层由独立运行模块组成，支撑DigiAgro与AgroScience两个数据空间之间的跨部门数据交换，实现安全、主权可控且透明的共享机制。

Result: 构建了一个自动化生态系统，可在不同数据空间之间共享多样化的农场IoT测量数据、卫星影像及指标、天气预报和分析服务，并据此生成灌溉计划等作物实践推荐。

Conclusion: 该框架有助于农民与农艺师依据准确推荐提升作物产量，同时维持农业可持续性，为农业数据空间互操作与数据主权保障提供可行路径。

Abstract: Despite the strategies of modern precision agriculture to leverage the integration of legacy agricultural systems, the challenges of IoT data fragmentation, farmers' sovereignty preservation, and limited interoperability still persist. This paper presents our work, conducted within the Horizon Europe DS2 project (DataSpace, DataShare 2.0), that applies an interoperability-oriented framework supporting participants of different agricultural data spaces to share data products and services under secure, sovereign, and transparent methods. The suggested methodology follows a layered reference architecture, where each layer consists of independent operational modules that facilitate the inter-sector data exchange between DigiAgro and AgroScience Data Spaces. The result of this work is an automated ecosystem for sharing diverse farm IoT measurements, satellite images and metrics, weather forecasts, and analytics services across distinct data spaces, aiming to generate accurate recommendations on crop practices, such as irrigation schedules, that farmers and agronomists will rely on to increase crop production while maintaining sustainability.

</details>

### [429] [Optical microelectrode arrays for differential readout of electrical and mechanical signals in cardiac cells](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16101)
*Alessandro Leronni,Rosalia Moreddu*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 提出一种无标记光学方法，利用光学微电极同时读取心肌细胞的电兴奋与机械收缩，并通过抑制收缩来分离两种信号来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心脏细胞功能依赖于电兴奋与机械收缩的协同，但二者通常需用不同技术分别测量，或需侵入式手段，难以同步、无创地获取。

Method: 以光学微电极作为传感界面：细胞电活动改变局部电荷再分布并被转换为荧光信号（静电转导）；细胞收缩引起膜位移，为光学读出叠加机械分量。通过对比搏动细胞与抑制收缩后的记录，将动作电位相关的静电转导与收缩驱动的膜运动分离。

Result: 实现了对电学与力学两类信号的同步、无标记读取，并成功区分动作电位相关的静电转导成分与收缩性膜位移成分。

Conclusion: 该方法为心脏毒性筛选和机电耦合传感提供了无标记、高通量的体外检测途径，同时揭示了膜基光学器件在心脏细胞生物电子学与力学中的物理机制。

Abstract: Simultaneous assessment of electrical excitation and mechanical contraction is essential for understanding cardiac cell function, yet these two processes are commonly measured with separate techniques or invasively. Here, changes in cellular electrical activity modulate local charge redistribution in optical microelectrodes and are converted into fluorescence signals, while cell contraction induces membrane displacement that contributes an additional mechanical component to the optical readout. By comparing recordings obtained in beating cells with those acquired after inhibition of contraction, we separate action-potential-associated electrostatic transduction from contractility-driven membrane motion. The approach offers a label-free route to support high-throughput in vitro assays for cardiotoxicity screening and electromechanical sensing. Concurrently, it unfolds the physical mechanisms governing membrane-based optical devices deployed in cardiac cell bioelectronics and mechanics.

</details>


### [430] [GPCR Ligand Bioactivity Prediction with Physics-Informed Dual-State Query Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16468)
*Shuo Zhang,Huifeng Zhang,Rongqi Hong,Jian K. Liu*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 提出物理信息多模态架构DSQ，将MWC别构模型嵌入神经网络，用可学习正交查询分离GPCR激活/非激活态表征，实现小分子生物活性预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPCR小分子生物活性预测是药物发现难点。现有深度学习方法难以区分功能效能，因其忽略构象动力学平衡；结构类方法受限于高分辨率激活态晶体结构稀缺，且静态表征无法区分构象状态。目标是弥合黑箱预测与生物物理现实之间的差距。

Method: DSQ采用物理信息多模态架构：1）不依赖显式3D结构，用可学习正交查询提取激活态与非激活态的解耦表征；2）神经MWC门控模块，从配体-状态亲和力与受体本征构象能垒的热力学竞争中数学推导受体激活概率；3）对比排序目标函数，施加差异化亲和力约束以保证物理一致性。

Result: 大量实验表明DSQ优于其他基线，在激动剂子集上尤为明显。同源性分层、温度敏感性、扰动、聚类及效率分析显示DSQ提供了有用的热力学归纳偏置，同时暴露出在低同源性受体上的明显局限。

Conclusion: DSQ通过将MWC别构模型与神经网络结合，为GPCR活性预测引入了有效的热力学归纳偏置，提升预测性能尤其对激动剂；但低同源性受体场景仍是其局限。代码已开源。

Abstract: Predicting the bioactivity profiles of small molecules against G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) is a challenge in drug discovery. Although deep learning has accelerated the prediction of binding affinities, existing approaches often struggle to distinguish between functional efficacies because they neglect dynamic conformational equilibria. Furthermore, structure-based methods are frequently limited by the scarcity of high-resolution active-state crystal structures and the indistinguishability of conformational states in static representations. To bridge the gap between black-box prediction and biophysical reality, we propose Dual-State Query (DSQ), a physics-informed multimodal architecture that explicitly embeds the Monod-Wyman-Changeux (MWC) model of allostery within a neural network. Unlike conventional models that rely on explicit 3D structures, DSQ utilizes learnable orthogonal queries to extract disentangled representations of active and inactive receptor states. These latent representations are governed by a novel neural MWC gating module, which mathematically derives the probability of receptor activation from thermodynamic competition between ligand-state affinities and the receptor's intrinsic conformational energy barrier. A contrastive ranking objective is also introduced to enforce differential affinity constraints, ensuring physical consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSQ outperforms other baselines, particularly for the agonist subset. Additional homology-stratified, temperature-sensitivity, perturbation, clustering, and efficiency analyses show that DSQ provides useful thermodynamic inductive bias, while also exposing a clear limitation on low-homology receptors. The code is available at https://github.com/jiankliu/DSQ.

</details>

### [431] [Exploring Optimal Parameters for Ligand-Based Virtual Screening in Early Drug Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16356)
*Temitope Sobodu,Victor Chibuzor Johnson,Ryan Kern,Peter Oni*

Main category: q-bio.BM

TL;DR: 该研究系统考察了基于配体的虚拟筛选中相似性阈值、指纹设置与原子不变量方案等常被忽视的实现细节，证明不存在通用的Tanimoto阈值，需采用"先池化默认、再配体特异校准、最后专家复核"的分阶段筛选策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相似性阈值、指纹选择与原子不变量方案在基于配体的虚拟筛选中常被视为实现细节，但其对筛选结果组成的影响缺乏系统评估；同时计算合成可及性评分与人工判断之间的一致性尚不明确。

Method: 以atomoxetine、bupropion、mirtazapine、venlafaxine四个胺能参考配体对Enamine库进行累计Tanimoto排序检索；以化合物加权骨架新颖度、归一化Shannon骨架多样性和三种计算合成可及性估计评价候选集；比较匹配检索深度下5种ECFP设置及ECFP4与FCSFP4；另由3名化学家对240条记录（229个唯一结构）在盲法下独立评分。

Result: 不存在适用于全部四个检索的单一Tanimoto截断值；ECFP8为最稳定的合并设置，但venlafaxine偏好ECFP2；ECFP4在合并比较中为主指纹更强，FCSFP4提供非冗余化学空间；化学家间一致性中等，平均评分比单次评分更可靠；SCScore与盲法共识关联最高，但性能因配体而异。

Conclusion: 筛选参数需按配体特异校准，结果表明应采用分阶段设计：先池化默认设置，再进行配体特异校准，最后由专家复核。计算评分不能完全替代人工判断。

Abstract: Ligand-based virtual screening depends on choices that are often treated as implementation details, including the similarity threshold, fingerprint setting and atom-invariant scheme. We examined how these choices altered the composition of ranked searches against the Enamine library for four aminergic reference ligands: atomoxetine, bupropion, mirtazapine and venlafaxine. Candidate sets were evaluated by compound-weighted scaffold novelty, normalized Shannon scaffold diversity and three computational estimates of synthetic accessibility. We first identified ligand-specific operating points along cumulative Tanimoto-ranked searches. We then compared five extended-connectivity fingerprint settings at matched retrieval depths and compared ECFP4 with the feature-class analogue FCSFP4. Finally, 240 records, corresponding to 229 unique structures, were scored independently by three chemists who were blinded to the computational scores. No single Tanimoto cutoff described all four searches. ECFP8 provided the most stable pooled setting, although venlafaxine favored ECFP2. ECFP4 was the stronger primary fingerprint in pooled comparisons, whereas FCSFP4 contributed nonredundant chemical space. Agreement among individual chemists was moderate, and the mean rating was more reliable than a single rating. SCScore showed the highest association with the blinded consensus, but performance varied by ligand. These results support a staged screening design in which a pooled default is followed by ligand-specific calibration and expert review.

</details>


### [432] [SaltyMeta: a curated benchmark and protein language model-informed web tool for salty peptide prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16809)
*Wanchao Chen,Wen Li,Yanan He,Yan Yang*

Main category: q-bio.BM

TL;DR: 该论文提出SaltyMeta——一个针对咸味或增咸短肽的标准化基准与在线筛选框架，含580条严格质控肽段，通过相似性分组划分数据，系统评估548种描述符、多种规模ESM2嵌入及融合模型，最佳实用模型测试ROC-AUC约0.715。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过量钠摄入是重大公共卫生问题，咸味及增咸肽可在减钠食品中保留咸感。但现有咸味肽机器学习研究受限于：数据集小、证据标准不统一、负样本标签不确定、序列相似性泄漏等问题，缺乏可信的基准与筛选工具。

Method: 构建SaltyMeta基准：580条肽（280正、300负），统一为2-15个残基的单字母序列，经质控排除非标准残基、完全重复及正负重叠；采用相似性分组划分（训练456、测试124）。评估548种可解释肽描述符、8M/35M/150M三档冻结ESM2嵌入及描述符-嵌入融合模型，并做分组交叉验证。进一步用PCA95降维与ExtraTrees特征重要性过滤优化。

Result: 传统ExtraTrees基线（经训练集分组CV选择）CV ROC-AUC=0.693，留出测试ROC-AUC=0.704、PR-AUC=0.702、F1=0.626、MCC=0.304。最佳初始融合为描述符+ESM2-8M，CV ROC-AUC=0.696，测试ROC-AUC=0.700。优化后ESM2-8M PCA95 top-300实用模型测试ROC-AUC=0.715、PR-AUC=0.703，但重复CV增益有限。

Conclusion: SaltyMeta是透明的肽段优先级筛选工具，而非感官验证替代品。研究提供基准、模型、脚本、GitHub及Streamlit，支持食品源肽段的可复现筛选。模型性能中等，说明咸味肽预测仍需更丰富数据与验证。

Abstract: Excess sodium intake remains a major public health challenge, while salty and saltiness-enhancing peptides offer a potential route to preserve sensory saltiness in reduced-sodium foods. Machine-learning studies of salty peptides, however, are constrained by small datasets, heterogeneous evidence standards, uncertain negative labels, and sequence similarity leakage. Here we present SaltyMeta, a curated benchmark and web-accessible screening framework for salty or saltiness-enhancing short peptides. The benchmark contains 580 peptides, including 280 positive peptides and 300 negative peptides, all standardized to 2-15 residue one-letter amino-acid sequences. Quality control found no non-standard residues, exact duplicates, or positive-negative overlaps. A similarity-grouped split retained 456 peptides for training and 124 for held-out testing. We evaluated 548 interpretable peptide descriptors, frozen ESM2 embeddings at 8M, 35M, and 150M parameter scales, and descriptor-embedding fusion models under grouped cross-validation. The traditional ExtraTrees baseline selected by training-set grouped cross-validation achieved ROC-AUC=0.693 in cross-validation and ROC-AUC=0.704, PR-AUC=0.702, F1=0.626, and MCC=0.304 on the held-out test set. The best initial protein-language-model fusion was traditional descriptors plus ESM2-8M embeddings, with grouped CV ROC-AUC=0.696 and test ROC-AUC=0.700. Advanced optimization using PCA95 dimensionality reduction and ExtraTrees feature-importance filtering yielded a practical ESM2-8M PCA95 top-300 model with test ROC-AUC=0.715 and PR-AUC=0.703, although repeated-CV gains remained modest. SaltyMeta is a transparent prioritization tool, not a sensory validation substitute. We provide benchmark, models, scripts, GitHub, and Streamlit for reproducible screening of food-derived peptides.

</details>


<div id='cs.CR'></div>

# cs.CR [[Back]](#toc)

### [433] [Universal Defenses for Tool-Integrated LLM Agents Against Adversarial Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16098)
*Xiaoyan Li,Yunli Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出统一的工具型LLM智能体防御框架，结合工具级与提示级多层防御，在四类对抗攻击下大幅降低攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具集成的LLM智能体虽在任务完成上表现优异，但易受直接/间接提示注入、记忆投毒与后门攻击，亟需通用、可推广的防御策略。

Method: 在统一框架下整合两类防御：(1) 工具级防御——Attacker Tool Filtering（基于Isolation Forest等异常检测剔除可疑工具）与Normal Tool Recalling（白盒方法，在规划前恢复原始工具集）；(2) 提示级防御——思维链（Chain-of-Thought）提示、自反思（self-reflection）以增强推理，以及任务改写（task paraphrasing）以缓解攻击。

Result: 在四种开源LLM（Gemma2-9B、Qwen2-7B、LLaMA3-8B、LLaMA3.1-8B）与三种专有LLM（GPT-3.5、GPT-4、GPT-5）上，方法显著降低攻击成功率（ASR），多场景达0% ASR，同时保持甚至提升原始任务成功率。

Conclusion: 简单的模块化多层防御能有效增强工具集成LLM智能体的安全性与鲁棒性，代码已开源。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated impressive capabilities across a variety of domains, particularly when integrated with external tools for multi-step task completion. However, they are increasingly vulnerable to adversarial attacks, including direct prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, memory poisoning, and backdoor attacks, which exploit the model's openness to prompt injection and tool manipulation. In this work, we explore practical and generalizable defense strategies within a unified framework across these four attack types. We introduce two universal tool-based defenses: Attacker Tool Filtering, which uses anomaly detection (e.g., Isolation Forest) to identify and remove suspicious tools, and Normal Tool Recalling, a white-box method that restores the agent's original toolset prior to planning. Additionally, we incorporate prompt-based defenses: Chain-of-Thought prompting and self-reflection techniques to enhance reasoning and task paraphrasing to mitigate attacks. Experimental results across both four open-source LLMs (Gemma2-9B, Qwen2-7B, LLaMA3-8B, and LLaMA3.1-8B) and three proprietary LLMs (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, and GPT-5) show that our methods significantly reduce the Attack Success Rates (ASR), achieving 0% ASR in many settings, while preserving or even improving the original task success rate. These findings highlight the promise of simple, modular, multi-layered defenses for strengthening the security and robustness of tool-integrated LLM agents. The code is available at https://github.com/Xiaoyan-Lisa/Defenses-for-Tool-Integrated-LLM-Agents-Against-Adversarial-Attacks.

</details>


### [434] [Permutation-Based Stegomalware in Large Language Models: Threats and Countermeasures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16193)
*Danny Wood,James Stringer*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究基于置换对称性的LLM隐写恶意软件（stegomalware）攻防：防御端实现置换覆盖全部模型参数，攻击端实现理论上无损、无需重训练、无需载荷特定信息的植入，并量化了数值误差带来的性能损失，结果均极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型训练困难且应用广泛，攻击者可将恶意载荷嵌入模型权重形成隐写恶意软件。先前工作虽利用权重中的置换对称性进行防御，但未能对LLM所有参数实现neutralization。

Method: 利用保行为对称性（behavior-preserving symmetries）：防御上改进置换选择以位移全部模型参数；攻击上将恶意软件编码进权重，设计无需重训练、无需提取脚本中载荷特定信息的置换方案；并针对数值误差累积，量化攻防两种场景下的模型性能损失。

Result: 防御方法可置换所有模型参数，克服了以往方法在LLM中残留大量未改动权重的问题；攻击方法兼具理论无损、编码后无需重训练、提取脚本不含载荷特定信息三个特性（此前无单一方法同时满足）；实测因数值误差导致的性能损失极小。

Conclusion: 保行为对称性是抵御隐写恶意软件的有效防御手段，同时也构成被攻击者利用的风险；置换方案在攻防两端均可实现近乎无损，但实际部署需关注数值误差累积对模型行为的影响。

Abstract: The difficulty of training large language models (LLMs), together with their ubiquity, raises the threat of stegomalware, where malicious payloads are embedded into model weights. Recent work has demonstrated the use of permutation symmetry in model weights to mitigate these threats, but failed to show neutralization of stegomalware across all weights for LLMs. In this paper, we demonstrate the full potential of behavior-preserving symmetries as a defense against stegomalware, as well as the risks these symmetries pose when exploited by attackers.
  For stegomalware neutralization, we improve upon previous work, demonstrating that it is possible to select permutations which displace all model parameters. This contrasts with previous methods which left a significant percentage of weights unaltered in LLMs. When used in an attack, we show that permutation symmetries can encode malware into the weights of a model in a way that is theoretically lossless, requires no retraining after encoding, and needs no payload-specific information in the extraction script---a combination of characteristics not previously seen in any single method.
  While theoretically lossless, permutation can in practice alter model behavior due to the accumulation of numerical error. We therefore quantify the loss in model performance associated with applying these methods, for both attack and defense, showing it to be minimal.

</details>


### [435] [Feasibility of Homomorphic Inference for a Genomic Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16211)
*Christos Galanopoulos,Kimon Antonios Provatas,Ilias Georgakopoulos-Soares*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文验证了在客户端辅助的近似同态加密协议下，能否让算力提供商在不接触明文基因组查询值的情况下，完整执行已发布的基因组基础模型推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类基因组序列可识别个体、泄露后不可撤回，且是基因组基础模型的核心输入。因此需要评估算力提供商能否在不解密查询衍生基因组数值的前提下执行模型，以及正确性、内存或成本是否会阻碍完整的加密推理。

Method: 先在三个基因组任务族上复现已发布模型并冻结经过独立验证的数值参考；随后实现客户端辅助的近似同态加密协议：提供商在密文上执行线性代数，持钥数据所有者在固定边界处执行精确归一化、因果softmax与激活函数。非交互式配置只能完成一个已发布权重块，用于组合时超出所测加速器内存上限；客户端辅助配置则执行全部已发布Transformer块与任务头。

Result: 客户端辅助配置对单个留出基因组信号输入在其完整提示长度下完成推理，最终标签与冻结参考一致，加速器内存峰值9,839 MiB，单加速器耗时6,683秒。非交互式配置在用于组合时超出内存包线。

Conclusion: 结果证明了完整分类器的算术可行性；但可重复性、网络传输与私有token索引查找仍未解决。在既定威胁模型下，被服务的基因组模型可处理编码序列而不向算力提供商暴露明文查询衍生激活值。

Abstract: Human genomic sequences can identify individuals, cannot be replaced after disclosure, and are the inputs that genomic foundation models are designed to interpret. We assess whether a compute provider can execute a released genomic foundation model without receiving query-derived genomic values in plaintext and whether correctness, memory, or cost prevents complete encrypted inference. We first reproduce the released model on three genomic task families and freeze an independently validated numerical reference. We then implement a client-assisted approximate homomorphic encryption protocol: the provider evaluates linear algebra on ciphertexts, while the key-holding data owner evaluates exact normalization, causal softmax, and activation functions at fixed boundaries. A noninteractive configuration completes one released-weight block but exceeds the tested accelerator-memory envelope when configured for composition. The client-assisted configuration executes all released transformer blocks and the task head for one heldout genomic-signal input at its full prompt length. It matches the frozen final label, peaks at 9,839 mebibytes of accelerator memory, and completes in 6,683 seconds on one accelerator. These results establish arithmetic feasibility for a complete classifier, while repeatability, network transport, and private token-index lookup remain unresolved. The biomedical significance is that, under the stated threat model, a served genomic model can process an encoded sequence without exposing plaintext queryderived activations to the compute provider.

</details>


### [436] [Analyzing Multi-Factor Authentication Through Cryptographic Security Properties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16214)
*Ryan Tipping,Yousef Tahboub,Krishna Bodige*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该摘要概述了身份验证从单因素（口令、令牌、生物特征）演进到多因素认证（MFA）平台的过程，并指出其中部分策略专注于防御重放攻击（即重用可能已被泄露的认证组件）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代系统需要以身份验证作为抵御未授权访问的首要防线，而单一认证机制（口令、物理令牌、生物特征）存在不足，因此需研究融合多种机制的多因素认证及其防重放攻击能力。

Method: 摘要未给出具体方法，仅以综述性叙述梳理认证机制的发展脉络：从单机制认证到多因素认证（MFA）平台，并聚焦于防止重放攻击（重复使用可能已泄露的组件）的相关策略。

Result: 摘要未报告实验结果或量化数据，仅说明多因素认证平台的现状，并指出其中若干策略以防重放攻击为研究重点。

Conclusion: 认证技术已由单因素演进为多因素平台；防重放攻击是MFA研究中的关键方向，旨在避免重用可能已被攻陷的认证组件。

Abstract: Modern authentication systems use cybersecurity techniques to validate the identity of the person (or applications acting on behalf of the person) as a primary defense against unauthorized access. While initially built around single mechanisms such as usernames/passwords, physical tokens, or biometrics, current systems have evolved into multi-factor authentication (MFA) platforms that combine multiple mechanisms. Among them, several focus on strategies that prevent replay attacks (i.e. the reuse of a component that could have been potentially compromised).

</details>


### [437] [RuleAutoPilot: Synthesizing Deployable Suricata Rules from Network Traffic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16231)
*Mughees Ur Rehman,Aritran Piplai,Murat Kantarcioglu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出端到端智能体框架RuleAutoPilot，直接从恶意软件网络流量生成可部署的Suricata规则，无需先验威胁情报，并通过良性流量指纹与结构化反馈修复机制提升规则质量与成本效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于规则的IDS（如Suricata）是网络安全核心，但规则编写依赖深度专家知识且难以跟上新兴威胁。现有LLM方法或依赖流量artifact出现后才产出的情报，或代价高昂且缺乏质量控制。核心挑战在于网络流量中安全相关流量极少、背景噪声巨大，降低LLM推理质量并推高成本。

Method: RuleAutoPilot包含：1）良性流量指纹（Benign Traffic Fingerprinting）阶段，在LLM处理前剔除已知良性背景流以降低噪声；2）对语法检查失败、未在源流量上触发、或在良性语料上产生误报的规则，利用结构化反馈自动修复；3）执行落地（execution-grounded）验证。

Result: 在1,296个恶意软件PCAP上，执行落地验证将规则F1从0.443提升至0.539。在分层200-PCAP子集上，开放权重模型gpt-oss-120b达到接近前沿水平：F1 0.524，对比Claude Code下Claude Opus 5的0.623，计费token成本低52倍；仅替换骨干为Claude Opus 5时，RuleAutoPilot以0.656 F1超过Claude Code的0.623，token用量少40倍。更强的骨干会提升自身上限，但在同一骨干下，本文scaffold仍优于Claude Code，说明scaffold独立于骨干产生贡献。

Conclusion: RuleAutoPilot证明无需先验威胁情报即可从原始恶意流量生成高质量可部署Suricata规则；噪声过滤与结构化反馈修复是提升LLM推理质量与降低成本的关键；其scaffold设计在不同骨干模型下均能独立带来性能增益。

Abstract: Rule-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) such as Suricata are central to network security, yet crafting effective detection rules demands deep expert knowledge and cannot keep pace with emerging threats. Existing LLM-based approaches can reduce analyst effort, but they either rely on curated threat intelligence that is produced only after the underlying traffic artifacts already exist, or they require costly LLM use without sufficient quality control. We present RuleAutoPilot, an end-to-end agentic framework that generates deployable Suricata rules directly from malware network traffic, with no prior threat intelligence required. A key challenge is noise: network traffic captures often contain a small amount of security-relevant traffic mixed with large volumes of background traffic, which reduces LLM reasoning quality and increases cost. RuleAutoPilot addresses this challenge with a Benign Traffic Fingerprinting stage that removes known benign background flows before LLM processing. Rules that fail syntax checks, do not trigger on the source traffic, or generate false positives on a benign corpus are automatically repaired using structured feedback. Across 1,296 malware PCAPs, execution-grounded verification raises rule quality (F1) from 0.443 to 0.539. On a stratified 200-PCAP subset, RuleAutoPilot on the open-weight gpt-oss-120b reaches near-frontier quality, 0.524 F1 against Claude Opus 5 under Claude Code's 0.623, at 52x lower billed-token cost. Swapping only the backbone to Claude Opus 5, RuleAutoPilot surpasses Claude Code outright, 0.656 F1 against 0.623, at 40x fewer tokens. A stronger backbone raises RuleAutoPilot's own ceiling, but at the same backbone, our scaffold still outperforms Claude Code's, showing the scaffold contributes independently of the backbone.

</details>


### [438] [Exploiting and Securing Docker containers and Kubernetes pods from a MitM attack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16253)
*Henry Kabuye,Ismail Khalid Kazmi,Chunyan Mu,Paolo Modesti*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该研究通过PRISMA系统综述与设计-创建研究，提出面向容器化操作系统的MitM防护框架，融合概念通信模型、AnBxJ安全库及OSI第7层容器防火墙，并在容器场景中成功实现安全机制，识别出关键成功因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Docker容器与Kubernetes Pod中的工作负载面临与非容器环境相同的多种攻击，包括钓鱼、应用漏洞利用与网络入侵。其中间人攻击（MitM）威胁尤为突出，需系统化安全实践与零信任架构来有效防护。

Method: 采用基于PRISMA的Systematic Review（SR）方法，整合同一研究主题的证据；结合设计-创建研究，构建用于表示通信与密码原语的概念模型，并集成AnBxJ Java安全库与运行于OSI模型第7层的容器防火墙，形成MitM防护框架。

Result: 识别出若干成功因素，并在容器化操作系统场景中成功实现了一套安全机制。

Conclusion: 该框架可帮助从业者保护Kubernetes与Docker部署，通过系统化容器安全实践并提供零信任架构，为容器化操作系统抵御MitM攻击提供可操作指导。

Abstract: PURPOSE - Workloads in containers, such as Docker containers and Kubernetes pods, are vulnerable to many of the same attacks as workloads in non-container environments, including phishing, application exploits and network intrusions. This systematic review and design-and-creation study explores techniques for securing containerised-based operating systems against Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attacks. The proposed framework uses a conceptual model for representing communication and cryptographic primitives, together with the AnBxJ Java security library and container firewalls operating at layer 7 of the OSI model. The study addresses the question: How can containerised-based operating systems be effectively secured from Man-in-the-Middle attacks?
